title: Content Writer – Intern
description:
**NC Global Services Pvt Ltd**

***Thhiya***
is powered by NC Global, which provides the leadership, operations, and brand backbone.

You’ll work in an MNC-style environment, writing for an international audience.

**Role**

Research and write clear, accurate legal and compliance content for our brands and US-facing clients: policies, website legal pages, explainers, blogs, social-media posts, and client communications.

* Draft and edit legal and policy content (privacy, terms, compliance explainers, thought-leadership articles)
* Research US and international regulations and turn them into plain, client-friendly English
* Proofread and fact-check content for accuracy, tone and consistency
* Work with the business, marketing, and leadership teams on timelines and revisions

**Who we’re looking for**

* Preferred academics: English Honours, Law (graduate/master’s), International Business or Marketing
* Final-year students and freshers are welcome
* Excellent written English, with strong research and attention to detail
* Comfort with MNC culture and cross-time-zone collaboration with US teams(if required).

**Terms**

* **Duration:**
  12-month internship, with a monthly stipend
* **Schedule:**
  5 days a week, 4–6 hours a day. Preferred hours are 3 PM – 11 PM IST, with Saturday and Sunday fixed off
* **Location:**
  Delhi NCR, with work-from-home available

**To apply:**
Send your CV and one writing sample to hr@ncglobal.in.

title: Tender Manager
description:
**About the Company**

The company is one of the oldest and most established LED lighting companies in India and has successfully executed prestigious projects across the country, many of which were inaugurated by the Prime Minister. It is a turnkey lighting designer and manufacturer and a Class "A" electrical contractor, with extensive experience in internal, outdoor, architectural, façade, and industrial lighting solutions.

Its notable projects include Signature Bridge, Gujarat Bhawan, H.P. Bhawan, Crafts Complex (Vasant Kunj), Vijaya Bhawan (Ministry of Commerce), and over 20 airport projects in the past decade.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Tender Engineer / Tender Manager to handle end-to-end tendering and estimation for EPC lighting and electrical infrastructure projects. The role involves analyzing tender documents, preparing technical and commercial bids, coordinating with internal teams and clients, and ensuring accurate, competitive, and timely submissions. The Tender Manager will also lead the tendering team, oversee bid strategy, and drive profitability through effective risk and cost management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Tender Analysis, BOQs & Risk Assessment:**
  Review the scope of work, technical specifications, drawings, and contract terms; prepare and validate bills of quantities (BOQs) against client specifications; and identify technical and commercial risks and suggest mitigation strategies.
* **Cost Estimation & Vendor Coordination:**
  Prepare cost estimates, pricing, and commercial offers with procurement and engineering teams, and coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors on pricing, technical data, and delivery timelines.
* **Client Coordination & Bid Submission:**
  Coordinate with clients and consultants on pre-bid queries, site visits, and bid clarifications; compile compliant tender documents; and submit bids within deadlines, manually or through portals such as CPPP and GeM.
* **Post-bid Support & Project Handover:**
  Support the business development and sales teams with post-bid clarifications and negotiations, and coordinate handover to the execution team upon contract award.
* **Tender Database Management:**
  Maintain a database of vendor prices, project references, and past tender submissions.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:**
  B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering, or a relevant field, with an electrical background.
* **EPC Project Experience:**
  Prior experience in EPC projects in sectors such as power, electrical substations, renewable energy, water, oil and gas, or infrastructure.
* **Government/PSU Tendering & Portals:**
  Exposure to government and PSU tendering procedures; strong knowledge of EPC contracting and bidding processes; experience with the GeM portal and SITC; and knowledge of IREPS, CPP, and other e-procurement platforms.
* **Technical Proficiency & Standards:**
  Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint) and estimation tools, with an understanding of project drawings and electrical, mechanical, or civil systems, based on specialization. Familiarity with FIDIC, CPWD, NTPC, NBCC, and CPRI norms is a plus.
* **Communication & Negotiation:**
  Strong communication and negotiation skills.

title: Analyst, Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead poisoning is one of India's most significant and most solvable public health challenges. India bears the world's highest burden of childhood lead poisoning, with over 275 million children carry blood lead levels above 5 µg/dL; the national average is 6.2 µg/dL and 23 States exceed the threshold (NITI Aayog and CSIR review, 2022). Lead exposure causes irreversible neurological damage in children, contributes to an estimated one million cardiovascular deaths annually in adults (Larsen et al., 2023), and generates compounding intergenerational risks.
  
  
National Center for Disease Control, as the designated national focal agency under MoHFW, is establishing the National Biomonitoring Programme for Chemical Toxicants (NBPCT). WJCF is embedding a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to serve as the coordination backbone for India's lead mitigation response. This embedded model builds directly on WJCF's track record of high-impact TSU engagements across TB, vector-borne diseases, oxygen, surveillance, and health insurance.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a motivated and analytically rigorous individual to serve as a core member of WJCF's embedded TSU. The incumbent will provide day-to-day technical, coordination, and secretariat support to government counterparts translating high-level intent into structured operational workplans, facilitating inter-ministerial coordination, and helping anchor governance architecture that outlasts individual donor cycles.
  
  
The role demands both policy acumen to navigate a complex multi-stakeholder environment and operational discipline to ensure consistent follow-through. The incumbent will report to the TSU Lead and will function under the programmatic guidance of NCDC for TSU activities.
  
  
**Location**
New Delhi (embedded at NCDC / MoHFW)
  
  
**Travel**
Domestic travel to programme states as required
  
  
TSU Secretariat and Programme Operations
  
  

* Provide day-to-day secretariat support to NCDC for the NBPCT, including preparation of meeting agendas, data-backed workplans, activity plans, and meeting charters across surveillance, capacity building, and enforcement priorities.
* Support NCDC's National Lead Technical Working Group through data synthesis, expert inputs, documentation, and follow-up mechanisms that convert deliberations into actionable outcomes.
* Support integration of state and laboratory surveillance data into the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) and contribute to dashboard and visualisation design for NCDC decision-making.
* Strengthen NCDC's capacity for data-backed decision-making in hotspot identification, laboratory and referral infrastructure mapping, and partner coordination.
* Consolidate and disseminate learnings from state-level engagement through regional and national workshops.
* Support the Programme in convening and facilitating inter-ministerial consultations on lead and chemical toxicants across environment, industry, labour, food safety, water, and mines ministries.
* Prepare technical inputs, briefing materials, and correspondence for senior decision-making within the ministry.

Programme Planning and Monitoring
  
  

* Develop and maintain workplan trackers and milestone dashboards to monitor progress against grant commitments and government-agreed deliverables.
* Support development of costed annual workplans and embed these into the programme's operational budgeting cycle.
* Prepare high-quality progress reports, briefing notes, and strategy documents for donors and government counterparts.

State-Level Engagement
  
  

* Lead WJCF's engagement in focal states in coordination with NCDC and state health departments, tailoring activities to each state's readiness and existing ecosystem.
* Support state-level surveillance system strengthening and feed learnings back into the national platform for wider uptake.
* Facilitate alignment between state health and environment departments on lead-related priorities.

Stakeholder and Partner Management
  
  

* Build and maintain relationships with NCDC, MoHFW senior officials, state health departments, CPCB, FSSAI, and development partners including WHO, UNICEF, Pure Earth, Vital Strategies, and others active in the lead ecosystem.
* Support advocacy efforts in collaboration with strategic partners, ensuring technical assistance and policy advocacy are complementary.

**Required**

* Postgraduate degree in public health, public policy, environmental science, health management, development studies, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative modeling skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationship with internal and external stakeholders, including more senior-level individuals
* Ability to drive forward assigned workstreams effectively (e.g., through thoughtful work planning, priority setting, stakeholder engagement, etc.)
* Entrepreneurial mindset, ability to work independently in ambiguous, semi-structured environments.
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word

**Preferred**

* Experience in environmental health, chemical toxicants, or occupational health programme areas.
* Professional proficiency in Hindi.

To Apply
  
  
Please send your CV and a cover note of not more than one page. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
  
  
***Last date to Apply 8 November, 2026***

description:

Collegedunia is an education portal matching students with the best colleges in India & abroad. We help with college research, exam prep tips, the application process, and insights on campus life. Launched in 2014, we are the highest-ranked portal by SimilarWeb in education.

We were awarded
**Best Educational Portal**

. Collegedunia is fueled by the energy of 1000+ individuals with an average age of ~25 — data analysts, engineers, designers, writers and marketers — growing 10% every month.

📈
**Fastest growth amongst peers —**
₹92 Cr revenue reported in FY20-21,
featured in LiveMint

**Role Overview**

We're looking for an AI Content Engineer: a B.Tech graduate who writes well, builds with LLMs and AI agents, and understands how edtech websites work. You'll design the agents, skills, prompts and pipelines that turn exam notices, college data and expert input into accurate, SEO-ready pages on Collegedunia — from brief to draft, QA and publishing — with minimal manual effort. You'll own both the quality of what we publish and the automated systems behind it.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* **Build with frontier AI, in production:**
  work hands-on with Claude and similar LLMs, agents and skills on workflows that reach millions of students, not demos.
* **End-to-end ownership:**
  take content automation initiatives from idea to launch, with direct access to product, SEO and tech teams.
* **Engineering + editorial in one role:**
  a rare mix that sets you up for AI product, automation and content-strategy careers.
* **Grow fast:**
  a startup scaling ~10% every month means quick expansion into larger AI and product responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Build AI content workflows:**
  design, build and run LLM-powered pipelines (brief → research → draft → QA → publish) for Collegedunia and allied product lines.
* **Create agents and skills:**
  write and maintain reusable AI skills, prompt libraries, templates and agent instructions for recurring page types such as exam dates, syllabus, results, cutoffs and college pages.
* **Structure edtech knowledge:**
  turn exam notifications, admission processes and college data into structured templates and knowledge bases that AI tools can use accurately.
* **Write and edit where judgment matters:**
  research, write and simplify technical and educational content for students and parents, in clear, accurate English.
* **Own quality:**
  set up automated checks (facts, dates, links, formatting, SEO, tone) plus human review so published content stays accurate and consistent.
* **Automate the repetitive:**
  spot manual tasks across content and ops, and automate them using AI platforms, Python scripts or no-code tools (n8n, Zapier, Make).
* **Work across teams:**
  partner with product, SEO, data and design to plan initiatives, and scope and test new AI tools or features end-to-end.
* **Measure and improve:**
  track turnaround time, accuracy and page performance, and keep improving the workflows you build.

**What We're Looking For**

* **B.Tech (any branch) is mandatory,**
  from a reputed college. 2025/2026 graduates are welcome.
* **0–1 year of experience**
  in content operations, AI-assisted content, automation or a related internship. Strong personal or college projects count.
* **Hands-on with LLMs:**
  you use Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini daily and can show prompts, workflows or projects you've built.
* **Familiar with AI agents and skills:**
  you've built or configured agents, custom GPTs, Claude Skills/Projects, or multi-step prompt chains.
* **Strong writing:**
  excellent written English and research skills, and the ability to explain technical topics simply.
* **Understands edtech websites:**
  you know how pages like exam pages, college profiles, rankings and news work on education portals like Collegedunia, and what makes them useful for students and for SEO.
* **Automation basics:**
  working knowledge of Python or no-code tools (n8n, Zapier, Make), APIs and Google Sheets.
* **Startup mindset:**
  comfortable with fast iteration, ambiguity and owning outcomes.

**Good to Have**

* Basic HTML/Markdown and an understanding of how a CMS works
* SEO fundamentals: keywords, search intent, on-page structure
* Experience using LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) or agent frameworks
* A portfolio, GitHub repo or blog showing AI or automation work
* Personal experience with Indian entrance exams (JEE, NEET, CAT, CUET, etc.)

**Hiring Process**

* **Step 1:**
  Resume and portfolio screening
* **Step 2:**
  Take-home task (3–4 hours): build an AI workflow that turns a real exam notification into a structured, publish-ready article, and share your prompts or skill, your output and a short note on how you'd scale it
* **Step 3:**
  Technical and writing discussion: a walkthrough of your task with the AI & Product team
* **Step 4:**
  Final round with leadership

**KEY FOCUS: AI AGENTS, SKILLS & CONTENT AUTOMATION**

*This is a core part of the role, not a nice-to-have. We want someone who thinks in workflows and uses AI to build better systems, not someone who only writes content.*

* **Hands-on experience building AI agents, skills or prompt pipelines is a must-have, not optional**
* Ability to design repeatable AI-assisted workflows that cut manual effort in content production, QA and publishing
* Enough editorial judgment to know when AI output is wrong, and the writing skill to fix it

**Engineer how education content gets made, and shape the future of education one student a**

**Job Title**

: Technical Records & Planning

**Role Overview**
:

The Manager Technical Records is responsible for maintaining, controlling, verifying, and archiving all aircraft maintenance records, technical documentation, and regulatory records in accordance with DGCA CAR-145 requirements, customer requirements, and organizational procedures. The role ensures the integrity, accuracy, traceability, and availability of maintenance records to support airworthiness, regulatory compliance, audits, and aircraft maintenance planning.

The position plays a critical role in ensuring that maintenance activities performed by the organization are properly documented and retained as required by regulatory authorities and customers.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

1. **Technical Records Management**

* Maintain complete and accurate aircraft maintenance records.
* Verify maintenance documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance prior to record closure.
* Review completed work packages, task cards, inspection records, and maintenance release documentation.
* Ensure all maintenance actions are properly recorded and traceable.
* Maintain electronic and hard-copy technical records as applicable.

1. **Aircraft Maintenance Records Control**

* Update aircraft status records including:
* Flying Hours (FH)
* Flight Cycles (FC)
* Calendar-controlled tasks
* Airworthiness Directives (ADs)
* Service Bulletins (SBs)
* Modifications and repairs
* Component installation and removal records
* Ensure records are updated in a timely manner following maintenance completion.

1. **Work Package Reconciliation**

* Review and reconcile maintenance work packages.
* Verify completion of all scheduled maintenance tasks.
* Ensure task cards, inspection sheets, and certifications are properly signed and recorded.
* Coordinate discrepancies with maintenance, quality, and planning departments.

1. **Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure technical records comply with:
* DGCA CAR-145 requirements
* Aircraft Rules and Civil Aviation Requirements
* Approved Maintenance Organization Exposition (MOE)
* Customer requirements
* Aircraft Maintenance Program requirements
* Support DGCA, customer, and internal audits relating to technical records.

1. **Archiving & Record Retention**

* Establish and maintain record retention and archival systems.
* Ensure safe storage and retrieval of historical maintenance records.
* Maintain records in accordance with regulatory retention periods.
* Support retrieval of records during audits, investigations, and customer requests.

1. **Technical Data Management**

* Control and manage technical publications and maintenance documentation.
* Ensure current revisions of manuals, drawings, engineering orders, and maintenance instructions are available.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Planning departments regarding technical documentation updates.

1. **Reporting & Coordination**

* Generate aircraft maintenance status reports and records summaries.
* Support planning activities by providing aircraft maintenance history and status information.
* Coordinate with Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, and Customer Representatives regarding records-related matters.
* Assist in aircraft delivery documentation and customer acceptance packages.

**Essential**

* AME

* Mechanical Engineering
* Aerospace Engineering

Strong understanding of:

* DGCA CAR-145 requirements
* Aircraft Maintenance Programs
* Technical Records Management
* Aircraft Logbooks
* Work Package Management
* Airworthiness Directives (ADs)
* Service Bulletins (SBs)
* Aircraft Modification and Repair Records
* Maintenance Release Documentation
* Aviation Documentation Control Systems

**Job Title**

**Role Overview**

The Training Manager cum Competency Coordinator is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the organization's training and competency assessment system in compliance with DGCA CAR-145 requirements. The role ensures that all certifying staff, support staff, technicians, inspectors, and management personnel remain competent to perform assigned duties through structured training, recurrent training, human factors training, continuation training, and competency assessments.

The position shall maintain training records, competency matrices, authorization controls, and ensure regulatory compliance relating to personnel qualification and competence management within the Maintenance Organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

**Training Management**

* Develop and implement the Annual Training Plan in line with CAR-145 requirements.
* Identify training needs for certifying staff, support staff, technicians, quality personnel, and management personnel.
* Coordinate initial, recurrent, continuation, and specialized technical training programs.
* Manage Human Factors, EWIS, Fuel Tank Safety (FTS), Safety Management System (SMS), and regulatory training programs as applicable.
* Coordinate OEM, aircraft type, equipment, tooling, and vendor training requirements.
* Ensure training syllabi remain current with regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements.

**Competency Management**

* Establish and maintain a competency assessment framework for all relevant personnel.
* Conduct or coordinate practical skill assessments, interviews, observations, and knowledge evaluations.
* Monitor personnel competence before issuance or renewal of company authorizations.
* Develop and maintain competency matrices for all maintenance personnel.
* Identify skill gaps and implement corrective development plans.
* Ensure competency evaluations are conducted at defined intervals.

**Authorization Control**

* Support the issue, renewal, suspension, and withdrawal of maintenance authorizations.
* Verify qualification, experience, competency, and training requirements before authorization recommendations.
* Maintain authorization records and status tracking.

**Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with:
* DGCA CAR-145
* Aircraft Rules and Civil Aviation Requirements
* Approved MOE requirements
* Human Factors training requirements
* Continuation training requirements
* Personnel competency assessment requirements
* Monitor regulatory changes and update training programs accordingly.
* Support DGCA audits and surveillance activities related to training and personnel competence.

**Training Records Management**

* Maintain complete training and competency records for all employees.
* Ensure traceability of qualifications, certifications, licenses, assessments, and authorizations.
* Manage training databases and learning management systems.
* Monitor training validity and expiry dates.

**Audit & Quality Support**

* Support internal and external audits relating to training and personnel competence.
* Provide evidence of compliance during DGCA and customer audits.
* Monitor training-related findings and ensure timely closure.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives.

**Performance Monitoring**

* Analyze training effectiveness using established KPIs.
* Monitor training completion rates and competency trends.
* Report competency status and training compliance metrics to management.

**Qualifications:**

**Essential**

* AME Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, Aviation Management, or equivalent.

**Preferred**

* DGCA Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (AME) License.
* Training & Development Certification.
* Human Factors/SMS Instructor Qualification.

**Knowledge Requirements**

Strong understanding of:

* DGCA CAR-145 Personnel Requirements
* Maintenance Organization Exposition (MOE)
* Human Factors Training Requirements
* Continuation Training Programs
* Competency Assessment Methodologies
* Authorization Systems
* Aircraft Maintenance Practices
* Safety Management Systems (SMS)
* Aviation Regulatory Compliance
* Learning Management Systems (LMS)

**Experience**
:

**Essential**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in one or more of the following:
* Aircraft Maintenance
* Technical Training
* Quality Assurance
* Competency Assessment
* MRO Operations
* Continuing Airworthiness

**Preferred**

* Experience within a DGCA CAR-145 approved maintenance organization.
* Experience in managing training systems and competency programs.
* Experience acting as Instructor, Competency Coordinator, Quality Auditor, or Authorization Officer.
* Exposure to EASA Part-145 training and competency requirements.

* Competency Assessment

* Personnel Authorization Control
* Audit Support

* Analytical Thinking
* Attention to Detail

title: Content Writer
description:
About Verifox

Verifox (verifox.ai) is an email verification and email finder platform, built in-house at Turnix, a software product company in New Delhi. • You use AI tools to research faster, and you edit hard so the result still reads like a human expert wrote it

• You take feedback well, communicate openly and meet your deadlines

• Experience writing about email, sales tools or developer products

• Working knowledge of Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush

Job Details

• Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:30 PM

• 40,000 per month, based on experience and writing samples

How to Apply

Apply here on LinkedIn, then email verifox.ai@gmail.com with the subject line "Content Writer" and include:

1. Links to 2 or 3 technical articles you wrote yourself

2. A 60-second voice note or Loom introducing yourself

Applications without writing samples will not be considered.

title: New Product Investigation Engineer
description:
**NPI Engineer – PMA Candidate Research & Analyst**

**Industry:**
                   PMA / Aerospace / Aviation Engineering

**Company:**
                 Aviation Component Solutions (ACS)

**Location:**
                   India (remote), supporting the NPI (New Product Investigation) team in Cleveland, Ohio, USA

**Employment type:**
Full-time

About ACS

Aviation Component Solutions is an FAA-regulated aerospace company that designs, certifies, and supplies PMA (Parts Manufacturer Approval) replacement parts for regional and large commercial aircraft. Our PMA parts give airlines a cost-effective, FAA-approved alternative to OEM parts. We are growing our new product pipeline and need a dedicated engineer to find, screen, and qualify the next generation of PMA candidates.

Role Summary

The NPI Engineer will own the front end (potential product development projects) of our PMA development pipeline, from building the master part number list to presenting fully vetted candidates to the NPI review team. You will harvest part data from technical manuals and industry databases, apply financial and technical screening criteria, estimate market usage, and prepare the business case (Red-Green analysis) for each part that moves forward. The goal is a steady flow of about five well-researched candidates to each weekly NPI meeting, roughly ten parts per month into development.

What You will Do

·        Extract part numbers from CMM and IPC numerical indexes across supported aircraft platforms, separating replaceable parts from NHAs.

·        Expand the part list using industry databases/marketplaces (Fulcrum360, Avref, ILS, Partsbase) and deduplicate against inhouse investigation database.

·        Obtain reference pricing from market databases and customers and improve pricing coverage over time.

·        Screen candidates against ACS criteria: price range, consumption data, customer type (and past purchasing history of the customer), ACS’s past experience of similar parts, pipeline status, minimum usage, and minimum annual sales.

·        Categorize parts from illustrations and photos and reject those outside ACS's current or near-term capabilities.

·        Estimate market potential potential from fleet size of eligible aircraft models, MROs associated with LRU, replacement rates, ATA approval or restrictions by customers and ACS sales history.

·        Perform preliminary NPI evaluation (in coordination with the team) for sample availability, reverse engineering capability, PMA path, sourcing, and sales potential.

·        Flag safety-critical, life-limited, or high-risk parts early, and recommend OEM sample purchases when data is insufficient.

·        Prepare Red-Green analyses and approval documents, and follow up with signatories to shorten review cycles.

·        Presenting about 10 vetted candidates to the NPI team (which includes Sales, Engineering and Procurement team) each week.

Qualifications

Required:

·        Bachelor's degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, or Mechanical Engineering (or a closely related field).

·        3+ years of experience in the aviation industry (MRO, OEM, airline engineering, or aftermarket parts).

·        Ability to read and navigate (hands on experience with) CMMs, AMMs, and IPCs, including numerical indexes, figure/item structures, and effectivity.

·        Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, filtering large datasets) and comfort working with databases.

·        Analytical and commercial mindset, comfortable making order-of-magnitude estimates and defending assumptions.

·        Clear written and verbal English for working with a US-based team.

·        Willingness to work remotely in the US time zone- Eastern Time (EST).

Preferred

·        Solid understanding of aircraft system architecture and where parts are installed (mandatory).

·        Procurement or reliability background: Experience in procurement, spares planning, or reliability analysis team at an airline, MRO, or aviation company. Familiarity with component removal rates, MTBUR/MTBF data, and which parts and assemblies are replaced frequently versus rarely (preferred).

·        Materials knowledge: Understanding of aerospace materials (aluminum and titanium alloys, stainless steels, elastomers, composites, plastics) and their specifications, enough to judge whether a part's material and process requirements would make sourcing a reverse-engineered part difficult (preferred).

·        Failure modes and criticality awareness: Working knowledge of FMEA and part criticality concepts, so that safety-critical and high-risk parts are identified and screened out early (preferred).

·        Familiarity with FAA PMA requirements (14 CFR Part 21, Subpart K) or the reverse engineering and certification process (preferred).

·        Experience with Airtable or similar relational database tools (preferred).

Why Join Us

·        Hands-on exposure to real-world PMA and aerospace engineering and FAA related processes.

·        Opportunity to develop specialized expertise in aviation eligibility and compliance.

·        Collaborative team environment with mentorship and growth opportunities.

·        Direct impact on engineering decisions and product development.

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
  
  
****About The Role****
We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production.
  
  
This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
  
  
Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
  
  
This role is highly hands-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long-term architecture for AI-native development.
  
  
The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development**

* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**

* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**

* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**

* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**

* Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without

**Shape the Future of the Product**

* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

**You may be a fit if**

* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.
  
  
At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.
  
  
UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.
  
  
Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.
  
  
**For every child, the right to Education**
**How can you make a difference?**
*The consultant will provide independent technical review and advisory support to strengthen the PARAKH Rashtriya Sarvekshan (PRS) as a national, system-level assessment of school education.*
**The Assignment Will Focus On**

* reviewing the current PRS approach and relevant previous NAS cycles;
* assessing opportunities to strengthen the technical quality, comparability and inclusiveness of PRS;
* providing recommendations on how PRS can generate more actionable evidence on learning gaps, misconceptions and factors associated with learning outcomes;
* identifying pathways through which PRS evidence can better inform education system improvement, including curriculum, textbooks, teaching-learning processes, teacher development, assessment practices and teaching-learning resources; and
* developing a practical technical pathway for consideration in strengthening the PRS 2027 cycle.

*The role will be to review existing approaches, identify gaps and opportunities, provide technically sound options and recommendations, and propose practical pathways for consideration by the Department of School Education and Literacy (DoSE&L), Ministry of Education, and PARAKH, NCERT.*
**Background**
India has established a national large-scale assessment system through the National Achievement Survey (NAS), which has evolved into the PARAKH Rashtriya Sarvekshan (PRS).
  
  
PRS provides system-level evidence on student learning and is intended to support understanding of the status of learning and areas requiring improvement across the school education system.
  
  
The PRS approach includes assessment of student learning alongside contextual information intended to provide insights into factors associated with learning outcomes.
  
  
The existing operational framework positions PRS as a standardised, equitable and inclusive national assessment and as a tool for understanding the health and performance of the education system.
  
  
UNICEF has supported the strengthening of national assessment and evidence systems in collaboration with PARAKH/NCERT.
  
  
Previous national discussions and technical reviews have highlighted areas for continued strengthening, including comparability across assessment cycles, competency mapping, identification of learning gaps and misconceptions, inclusive assessment, analysis of contextual factors, and improved use of assessment evidence for system improvement.
  
  
The next PRS cycle provides an opportunity to consider how existing assessment evidence can be further strengthened and translated into more actionable information for education system improvement.
  
  
**Rationale**
While PRS provides important information on learning outcomes, there is an opportunity to strengthen the extent to which the assessment can generate diagnostic and actionable system-level evidence.
  
  
In particular, there is value in examining how PRS can better support understanding of:
  
  

* what students are able or unable to do at different competency levels;
* common learning gaps, misconceptions and response patterns;
* changes in learning outcomes across assessment cycles;
* equity and inclusion across different groups of learners;
* factors associated with variations in learning outcomes; and
* implications of assessment findings for curriculum, textbooks, pedagogy, teacher development, assessment practices and learning resources.

The assignment therefore requires specialised international expertise in large-scale educational assessment, assessment design and analysis, comparability, inclusive assessment and use of assessment evidence for education system improvement.
  
  
The assignment will not involve primary data collection, field visits or implementation of assessment activities.
  
  
**Scope of work**
The consultant will undertake a desk-based review of relevant PRS/NAS documentation, previous technical recommendations and relevant international assessment practices and prepare a Technical Note on Strengthening PARAKH Rashtriya Sarvekshan.
  
  
**The Technical Note Will Cover The Following Areas**

* Review of the current PRS approach

**The Consultant Will**
1.1 Review relevant PRS and previous NAS documentation, including the assessment framework, domains and competencies, test design, sampling, contextual questionnaires, analysis and reporting.
  
  
1.2 Review relevant recommendations from previous national technical discussions and relevant international assessment practices and approaches.
  
  
1.3 Identify key strengths, gaps and opportunities for further strengthening PRS as a national/system-level assessment.
  
  

* Identify priority areas for technical strengthening

Based on the review, the consultant will provide technical recommendations and possible pathways in the following areas:
  
  
**2.1 Assessment Framework And Competencies**
Opportunities to strengthen assessment of what students know and can do across competencies, including application and higher-order competencies where appropriate.
  
  
**2.2 Comparability Across Assessment Cycles**
Approaches to strengthen comparability and interpretation of changes in learning outcomes over time, including linking, anchor items and scaling, where appropriate.
  
  
**2.3 Inclusive Assessment**
Approaches to strengthen participation, accessibility, accommodations, analysis and reporting for diverse learner groups, including children with disabilities and other potentially under-represented groups.
  
  
**2.4 Learning Gaps And Misconceptions**
Approaches for identifying and reporting competency-level learning gaps, common errors, misconceptions, proficiency levels and response patterns.
  
  
**2.5 Contextual And Explanatory Evidence**
Opportunities to strengthen the use of contextual information to understand factors associated with variations in learning outcomes, including relevant student, teacher, classroom and school factors.
  
  
**2.6 Analysis And Interpretation**
Approaches for generating more actionable evidence on competencies, equity, learning gaps, misconceptions and relevant factors associated with learning outcomes.
  
  

* Identify pathways for using PRS evidence for education system improvement

The consultant will examine how PRS evidence can better inform education system improvement, including:
  
  

* curriculum and curricular expectations;
* textbooks and learning materials;
* teaching-learning processes and pedagogy;
* teacher development;
* assessment practices; and
* teaching-learning resources.

The consultant will propose an assessment-to-system-improvement pathway that links PRS evidence and identified learning gaps and misconceptions to their diagnosis, implications for the education system, and appropriate system level responses.
  
  

* Develop a technical pathway for strengthening PRS 2027

Based on the review and analysis, the technical note will:
  
  
4.1 Identify and prioritise technical areas that could realistically be considered for the PRS 2027 cycle.
  
  
**4.2 For Each Priority Area, Outline**

* the issue/opportunity;
* rationale;
* possible technical options;
* recommended pathway for consideration;
* key methodological considerations;
* implications for data, instruments and analysis;
* technical expertise/capacity requirements; and
* key decisions required from PARAKH/NCERT and DoSE&L, MoE.

4.3 Distinguish between improvements that could be considered for PRS 2027 and areas requiring further technical development or longer-term consideration.
  
  
4.4 Present a consolidated set of recommendations and a practical technical pathway for consideration by PARAKH/NCERT and DoSE&L, MoE.

Fluency in English is required.

title: Scientific Writer
description:
**Title: Scientific Writer**

**Location: Gurugram**

**Reports to: R&D Head**

**The Role**

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Scientific Writer to support our R&D division. This role sits at the intersection of research, intellectual property, and business development, requiring the ability to distill complex scientific concepts into impactful written communication. The candidate will be responsible for writing and reviewing research articles, patents, invention disclosures, white papers, technical reports, and business-oriented presentations. They will collaborate closely with R&D scientists, patent attorneys, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely dissemination of scientific knowledge, intellectual property protection, and technical communication for internal and external stakeholders.

The role will include the following :

* Draft, edit, and review research articles, review papers, white papers, and technical reports for publication and internal circulation.
* Ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and compliance with journal/editorial standards.
* Collaborate with R&D scientists to translate experimental findings into manuscripts, presentations, and technical documentation.
* Draft invention disclosures, patent applications, and related IP documentation in coordination with external patent attorneys and internal R&D teams.
* Support timely IP filings and management of intellectual property databases.
* Prepare scientific and business-oriented presentations, posters, and conference materials.
* Contribute to grant applications, marketing pitches, and technical proposals for business development.
* Develop and maintain scientific content repositories, literature reviews, and competitive intelligence summaries.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams including R&D, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Legal.

**Who are we looking for**

* Master’s/PhD in Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, or related field.
* 2–6 years of experience in scientific writing (academic or industry).
* Experience in patent/IP management and working with attorneys preferred.
* A strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of molecular biology, synthetic biology, protein engineering, or related domains.
* Knowledge of Indian and international patent processes and IP management tools.
* Proficiency in literature databases (PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, etc.).
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, concise documents.
* Strong project management and coordination skills.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of science, innovation, and intellectual property.
* Be part of a dynamic biotech R&D team driving next-generation solutions.
* Exposure to research publications, patents, grant writing, cross-functional collaborations, and marketing initiatives.

Knowledge Systems Manager
  
  
We're looking for a technically capable Knowledge Systems Manager to build, administer and evolve our knowledge management ecosystem on Zendesk. This is a hands-on role: you'll build tools and apps directly on the platform, work alongside engineers on integrations and UX, and take ownership of authentication and API-level troubleshooting, while also maintaining the knowledge base and the documentation that keeps it useful. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering and Support to make self-service, search and AI-assisted knowledge experiences genuinely work.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Zendesk Platform Development
  
  

* Design, build and maintain custom applications on Zendesk App Builder (e.g. dashboards, content management tooling, publishing workflows).
* Own configuration of Zendesk Guide: themes, article templates, content presentation and publishing workflows.
* Work directly with developers/engineers on Zendesk UX and UI translating requirements into technical specs and reviewing implementation.
* Support and extend AI and automation features within Zendesk.

APIs, Authentication & Integrations
  
  

* Build and maintain integrations between Zendesk and other enterprise systems (e.g. Zendesk API with Microsoft Teams, for querying the knowledge base directly from Teams).
* Work confidently with APIs: authentication, requests, troubleshooting failures end-to-end.
* Understand and troubleshoot OAuth, SSO and SAML authentication patterns, including recurring cross-brand/cross-tenant auth issues.
* Partner with platform administrators and developers on new integrations and system enhancements.

Knowledge Base Management & Content
  
  

* Maintain the day-to-day health of the knowledge base, applying the information architecture, taxonomy and content standards set by the Knowledge Director.
* Create and maintain user-facing documentation for product features, workflows and releases.
* Support knowledge strategy and self-service initiatives set by the Knowledge Systems Director; surface opportunities and risks from day-to-day platform work.

AI-Powered Knowledge Management
  
  

* Use AI tools to accelerate content creation, maintenance and knowledge discovery, within the agent/pipeline architecture set by the wider team.
* Optimise knowledge content for AI retrieval and generative AI / agent experiences.

Analytics & Insights
  
  

* Analyse knowledge base usage, search behaviour and content performance to find gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Produce regular reporting to feed into the wider knowledge strategy and roadmap.

**Essential**
Required Skills & Experience
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Zendesk Guide/App Builder or a comparable platform, including custom app development and day-to-day configuration.
* Working knowledge of APIs and authentication concepts (OAuth, SSO, SAML) with the ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently.
* Experience delivering integrations between a knowledge/support platform and other enterprise systems.
* Experience creating technical documentation and user-facing guidance.
* Comfortable working directly with engineers on technical requirements, UX/UI, and implementation.
* Experience using AI tools for content or workflow purposes.
* Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills.
* Ability to analyse data and turn it into concrete improvement recommendations.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Zendesk Administration & App Builder
* API integration & troubleshooting
* OAuth / SSO / SAML
* HTML, CSS, JSON (low-code development)
* Taxonomy & metadata management
* Workflow automation
* AI prompt engineering
* Analytics & reporting

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with generative AI implementations and RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) concepts.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting AI-powered customer support solutions.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)
  
  

* Shipped at least one new Zendesk App Builder tool or integration that measurably improves a workflow (e.g. content ops, publishing, cross-system querying).
* Reduced reliance on engineering support for common Zendesk configuration, integration and auth issues.
* Improved knowledge base search success and content discoverability.
* Established measurable knowledge governance processes, with content quality and freshness improved across the KB.
* Delivered actionable insights through knowledge analytics and reporting.
* Supported AI initiatives that make effective use of organisational knowledge.

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**

title: Operational Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
**Locations**
: Gurgaon | London
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology-enabled, global organization.
  
  
Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology & AI deployments to end-to-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
  
  
We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward-thinking design.
  
  
**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**

* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication & engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation

What You'll Bring
  
  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus

Who You'll Work With
  
  
The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You’re Good At**

* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* Learning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement

*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.*

title: Executive/Senior Executive – Communication & Branding
company: UDIT - University of Design, Innovation and Technology
description:
**Designation:**
Executive/Senior Executive – Communication & Branding

**Name of the Institution:**
University of Design, Innovation & Technology (UDIT)

**Location:**
University of Design, Innovation & Technology, Gurugram, Sector 68 – 122101.

**Working Conditions**

**Timings:**
09.00 am – 06.00 pm (Monday to Friday)

10.00 am – 05.00 pm (Saturday), 2 Saturdays off

**Work Experience:**
02+ years of experience in the field of content, marketing, blog & email marketing, social media, etc.

**Education:**

Graduate/Post Graduate with good writing and communication skills.

Additional diploma/certifications in the field of marketing, SEO, content writing, Adobe Photoshop would be considered a plus.

**Reporting:**
Head – Communications Team/COO

**About the Role**

We're looking for someone who can write, shoot, edit, design, think, curate, and move fluidly between storytelling formats and platforms. Someone who understands that communication for a design university isn't just about captions or calendars — it's about cultural literacy, visual fluency, and the ability to craft seamless narratives that reflect what's happening in the world and on campus.

You'll wear multiple hats here: writer, photographer, video editor, designer, event coordinator, creative collaborator, trend spotter. If you're deeply curious, perpetually online in the best way, can hold a conversation about everything from Satyajit Ray to street style to semiotics — and know how to frame a shot and cut a story together — keep reading.

**What you will do**

● Write and edit across all platforms: social media, website copy, press releases, campaign scripts. Your writing should adapt to the medium and audience — Instagram captions aren't blog intros aren't press releases.

● Shoot and edit content: You'll be on the ground capturing moments — events, campus life, student work, faculty interviews. Then you'll edit those into Instagram Stories, Reels, YouTube videos, or whatever format the story demands. You should know composition, lighting basics, and how to make a phone or DSLR work for you.

● Design when needed: Create social media posts, story graphics, email headers, or quick visual assets using Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator. You don't need to be a senior designer, but you should have an eye for layout, typography, and brand consistency.

● Curate video and visual narratives: Work with internal and external design and video partners to develop concepts, write briefs, and ensure the final output has both aesthetic integrity and narrative clarity. You should know what a good edit looks like and be able to articulate why.

● Manage events with a storytelling lens: From Convocation to campus visits to the Graduate Show — you'll help plan, coordinate, document, and amplify. You're not just logistics support. You're thinking: What's the story here? How do we capture and tell it before, during, and after?

● Stay contextually aware: You should know what's trending, what's being talked about, what movements are shaping culture — and how (or whether) IIAD should respond. Pop culture, design discourse, social issues, global and local — all of it informs how we communicate.

● Generate ideas, not just execute them: We need someone who can pitch concepts for campaigns, suggest content series, and spot opportunities to insert IIAD into larger cultural conversations. You're not waiting for a brief — you're co-creating it.

● Collaborate across departments: Regular touchpoints with faculty, students, admissions, program heads, and external agencies. You're gathering stories, aligning messaging, and ensuring that what we say actually reflects what we do.

● Track, analyse, refine: Monitor engagement, performance, and sentiment across platforms. Use insights to evolve our approach — what's resonating, what's not, and why.

**Who You Are**

You're a cultural omnivore.

You read books. You watch films (and not just the ones everyone talks about). You notice design in everyday spaces. You have opinions about typography, about casting choices, about how cities are planned. You're curious about history, geography, mythology, subcultures. You connect things that don't obviously connect.

You're a natural storyteller across mediums.

You can craft a narrative arc across platforms — an Instagram Reel isn't just a video, it's part of a larger conversation. You understand pacing, tone, visual rhythm, and context. You know when to be formal and when to be conversational. You know how a story changes when it's written vs. filmed vs. designed.

You're contextually switched on.

You know what's happening — culturally, socially, politically. You can spot a meme reference, understand a design movement, explain why something went viral. You're online, but critically so.

You're exhaustingly multi-skilled.

Writing? Yes. Photography and video? Absolutely. Basic graphic design? Of course. Event coordination? Sure. Video ideation, shooting, and editing? That too. Giving feedback to external designers? Yes. Spotting a typo in a 40-slide deck at 6pm? Unfortunately, also yes.

You're a self-directed learner.

You don't wait to be taught. You pick up tools, platforms, and skills as needed. If tomorrow we need to figure out a new platform, a new tool, or a new format — you're the person who dives in first.

**Technical skills you MUST have:**

● Fluent writing and editing in English

● Photography skills (phone + DSLR/mirrorless)

● Video shooting and editing (Instagram Stories, Reels, YouTube — basic to intermediate level)

● Graphic design software: Canva (essential), Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (strong plus)

● Social media platforms and native analytics (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube)

● MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Technical skills that are a BIG plus:**

● Advanced video editing (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut)

● Motion graphics (After Effects basics)

● Figma or other design collaboration tools

● Email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, etc.)

● Understanding of SEO, content strategy, and digital storytelling

**Salary:**
25-35k (Negotiable and commensurate with skills and qualifications.)
