title: Global L&D Senior Coordinator
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The Global L&D Senior Coordinator role sits at the intersection of reporting and analytics, audit and governance, and change management. This role owns end-to-end transformation, process redesign, audit, and governance across our entire curriculum, learning journeys, and programs, using data-driven insight and structured governance frameworks to ensure consistency, quality, and continuous improvement and plays a critical part in driving L&D transformation through evidence-based decision-making
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Reporting & Analytics: Own the end-to-end reporting and analytics engine for transformation and learning delivery: build and maintain dashboards tracking milestone progress, risks, variances, and engagement trends across projects and learning journeys
* Audit & Governance: Lead process audit and governance across the full curriculum, learning journeys, and program lifecycle. Design and enforce quality control frameworks, conduct periodic audits for consistency and compliance, and own the continuous improvement roadmap that emerges from audit findings.
* Project & Transformation Delivery: Manage end-to-end strategic transformation initiatives with a governance lens, tracking milestones, dependencies, and scope against a structured reporting cadence. Coordinate cross-functional workstreams and escalate risks or variances through formal governance reviews with the core team.
* Stakeholder Management: Partner with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior leaders, using reporting outputs and audit insights as the backbone of influence and alignment, ensuring transparency and accountability across the business.
* Tools & Platforms: Apply strong technical expertise across learning platforms and AI tools (SABA, Docebo, SFMC, and others) primarily to extract, structure, and analyze data for reporting, audit trails, and governance documentation.
* Operations: Support the team on run-the-business activities and ad hoc projects as and when needed, stepping in flexibly to ensure continuity and momentum across priorities.

We are looking for someone who has the potential to fulfil the above, with genuine interest and passion for this topic. Someone who can handle uncertainty and help shape the future direction of the role.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* Proven Track Record: 10+ years of progressive experience in change, transformation, Operations redesign, with at least 4+ years spearheading large-scale digital or organizational transformation initiatives.
* Tech Savviness: Deep functional knowledge of modern HR/L&D systems (e.g., Workday Learning, Degreed, EdCast, Cornerstone) and automated content creation tools.
* Audit & Governance Expertise: Demonstrated experience designing or operating within audit, quality control, or governance frameworks, with a track record of turning findings into measurable process improvement
* Analytical Fluency: Comfortable working with large or messy data sets, building dashboards, and translating trends into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
A passionate and dedicated Learning & Development team, who are currently spread across the globe. You will be part of the Operations team that oversees the overall orchestration of Learning at BCG. As a complex matrix structured organization, you will work with broader L&D colleagues and other functional teams. You will establish strong relationships across our people functions and beyond to successfully learn, educate and influence others.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
You’re Good At
  
  

* Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Ability to synthesize complex data sets and business objectives into clear, decision-ready insights and capability strategies
* Governance & Rigor: Exceptional attention to detail and structured thinking, able to design audit frameworks and quality controls that hold up across a large, matrixed organization
* Influencing Through Evidence: Strong communication skills to build consensus among diverse, cross-functional stakeholders, using data and audit findings as the foundation for influence rather than authority alone
* Resilience & Agility: Comfortable navigating high ambiguity, shifting priorities, and large organizational matrix structures.
* Leading Change with Data: Skilled at driving large-scale process redesign and adoption, using reporting and audit insights to build the case for change and bringing stakeholders along through structured, evidence-based change management.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Practice Consultant (Sustainability, Digital & AI)
description:
**Practice Consultant (Sustainability, Digital & AI)**

**New Delhi**

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll join Bain’s Sustainability Practice, which helps our clients make critical decisions at the core of their business strategy. Our work spans sustainability strategy, the environmental and social impact of operations, stakeholder engagement, and sustainability-related growth and cost opportunities.

We help ensure sustainability efforts are grounded in business fundamentals, demonstrate a clear return on investment, and become firmly embedded within our clients’ strategies and operations.

As part of the Sustainability Practice, you’ll collaborate globally with colleagues across Bain, including client-facing teams and digital and technical specialists, to develop innovative perspectives, products, and solutions that help our clients achieve results.

  

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

As a Practice Consultant focused on Sustainability, Digital & AI, you’ll be a critical member of our Sustainability Practice. From day one, you’ll bring analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management, and leadership skills to help advance the practice’s annual and longer-term goals.

You’ll support case teams in delivering results for clients, help build new intellectual property and solutions, and contribute to global collaboration and our external visibility and differentiation.

A key part of your role will be exploring how AI, digital tools, automation, and emerging technologies can strengthen our sustainability solutions. You’ll work with technical specialists and practice colleagues to translate sustainability hypotheses and business needs into practical tools and prototypes.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

Solution design, development, deployment, and delivery

• Own and maintain the Sustainability Practice’s intellectual property and solution backlog, supporting competitive research, gap identification, and research into ecosystem offerings, partners, and emerging AI and digital tools.

• Conduct analysis and support business case development for solution investments.

• Develop intellectual property, including global reports, research briefs, market overviews, and solution- and topic-specific materials tailored to sectors and industries.

• Identify issues, develop hypotheses, execute analyses, translate data into meaningful insights, and present recommendations to key decision-makers.

• Support the day-to-day implementation of transformation projects, with a focus on delivering and operationalizing strategic initiatives that create meaningful business outcomes and impact.

• Provide hands-on support to clients and case teams in leveraging technology and AI solutions.

• Lead or contribute to the design and prototyping of AI-enabled tools and minimum viable products, working with technical specialists and our Production Engineering team to translate sustainability hypotheses into working prototypes that can be piloted with case teams and clients.

• Develop training materials that help colleagues use the latest intellectual property, AI capabilities, and digital tools.

• Surface new ideas, share learnings from pilots, and champion emerging technologies across the practice.

• Monitor developments in AI and emerging technologies and translate them into practical insights, tools, and training opportunities for colleagues.

• Identify opportunities to embed automation, analytics, and emerging technologies into our work to enhance delivery and impact.

Practice strategy, planning, and reporting

• Support win/loss learning and feedback loops for Sustainability Practice pitches and proposals, incorporating insights into our competitive knowledge base.

• Support planning for the commercialization of intellectual property and solutions, including developing investment business cases, ROI models, impact assessments, and commercialization plans.

• Support the development of sustainability diagnostic tools and frameworks, as applicable.

• Provide direct support for proposals.

• Support the collection, maintenance, and analysis of data relating to experts and commercial materials.

Practice communications and teaming

• Work effectively across practices and functions, proactively sharing and seeking information while focusing on the implications that matter most.

• Serve as a bridge between the Sustainability Practice and digital and technical teams, helping ensure AI-driven solutions align with business and sustainability impact goals.

• Support impact tracking and feedback loops for piloted tools and intellectual property to inform iteration and broader scaling.

• Train and informally coach junior team members, as appropriate.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

You bring:

• 5–8 years of top-tier management consulting experience, or equivalent experience such as product management or strategy roles at a technology firm, plus an undergraduate degree; or 4–5 years of relevant experience with an MBA or master’s degree.

• Experience, expertise, or a strong interest in sustainability, including applying AI and digital technologies to sustainability solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear insights and recommendations.

• The ability to drive a piece of work end-to-end with limited direction and perform complex, accurate analysis.

• A continuous-learning mindset and the ability to translate experience into thoughtful recommendations for improvement.

• Strong communication skills, including the ability to structure impactful presentations and updates and clearly communicate insights and implications.

• The ability to lead effective small meetings and contribute confidently in discussions with senior stakeholders.

• A track record of inspiring, motivating, and developing junior team members.

• A passion for sustainability and for deploying innovative techniques and tools that help clients accelerate growth and reach their full potential.

• Deep familiarity with AI and machine-learning technologies and tools, such as Python, R, and OpenAI APIs, and an applied understanding of how they can create business value.

• Comfort using AI technologies and tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok, with an applied understanding of how they can create business value.

• Demonstrated product thinking, with the ability to translate product hypotheses and user needs into focused, testable prototypes; rapidly execute them using AI solutions; inform feature prioritization; and guide digital solution development in partnership with technical and practice teams.

• The ability to communicate technical and digital concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

• The ability to design, build, and deploy AI-enabled minimum viable products, connecting large language model and third-party APIs into working application flows.

• Hands-on experience prototyping with modern data and AI tools, such as Replit, V0, Codex, Claude Code, SQL, retrieval-augmented generation, or large language model-based workflows, without requiring production-engineering depth.

• An interest in the technology industry, including digital transformation and disruptive business models.

• Fluency in English.

Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams—including engineers, product managers, and sustainability experts—is beneficial. Experience in fast-evolving, ambiguous environments such as internal innovation teams or digital incubators, as well as familiarity with machine-learning workflows such as model training, evaluation, or deployment, would also be valuable.

You’ll need flexibility in your working hours to collaborate with our global team and will follow local office and Product, Practice & Knowledge in-office guidelines.

title: Freelance Public Relations Consultant
description:
Hiring: Freelance PR Consultant — Remote, Delhi NCR
  
  
Aim Alloys LLP is a ferroalloy manufacturer in Khushkhera, Rajasthan. We atomize ferrosilicon into engineered powders for welding consumables and dense media separation, supplying customers in Europe and India. Our current development work upcycles solar scrap into high-specification engineered powders.
  
  
That solar scrap work is the story we want told. We are looking for a consultant to run a 24-month thought-leadership programme around it. The objective is speaking platforms and technical media — not publicity volume.
  
  
Scope
  
• A 24-month roadmap built around the solar scrap upcycling narrative, with quarterly themes mapped to the conference calendar and our technical milestones
  
• Pipeline of conferences, symposia and panels where solar scrap recovery and materials circularity are live subjects — metals, welding, powder metallurgy, solar manufacturing and industrial sustainability, in India and abroad; own the call-for-papers calendar and pitch programme committees through to confirmation
  
• Speaker abstracts and session proposals on the solar scrap work, plus briefing notes and Q&A prep
  
• Bylined articles, technical commentary and interviews placed in trade media, anchored on solar scrap recovery and engineered powder metallurgy
  
• Executive LinkedIn content on a set cadence, carrying the same narrative
  
• Monthly report: pitches issued, placements and slots secured, submissions pending
  
  
Requirements
  
• 5+ years in PR, corporate communications or trade journalism
  
• A real record of securing conference speaking slots — we weigh this most heavily, so lead with it
  
• Trade-press placements, ideally B2B industrial, metals or energy
  
• Ability to absorb technical material and write it clearly for a business audience
  
• Works independently against a brief; we are a manufacturing business, not a comms department
  
• Based in Delhi NCR, remote, occasional in-person meetings
  
  
Terms
  
Freelance monthly retainer against an agreed scope. 24 months, reviewed at six. Start November 2026. Other clients fine, no conflict in ferroalloys or welding consumables.
  
  
To apply
  
Email info@aimalloys.in, subject "PR Consultant", with: your approach to the first 90 days, two or three speaking slots you have secured (client and platform named), two or three media placements, and your retainer expectation. Shortlisted applicants hear back within two weeks.

title: Senior Specialist, Pharmacovigilance System
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
The
**Senior Specialist, Pharmacovigilance System**
serves as the strategic and operational bridge between the Pharmacovigilance (PV) business/operations teams and the technical organization. This individual acts as the
**system champion, business representative, and end-to-end accountability owner**
for one or more pharmacovigilance platforms and integrated solutions — ensuring these systems meet regulatory, operational, and quality standards throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a unique blend of deep PV domain expertise, systems thinking, stakeholder management, and a forward-looking understanding of emerging technologies including AI. This person ensures those technical workstreams are effectively directed and aligned to business needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Ownership and Governance
  
  

* Serve as the accountable business system owner for PV-related platforms, including safety databases, signal management tools, medical information systems, literature monitoring solutions, and reporting platforms
* Own and maintain the system roadmap, prioritizing enhancements, upgrades, and new feature rollouts in alignment with business strategy and regulatory requirements
* Lead and manage system lifecycle activities — from business requirements definition, UAT, deployment, through to retirement — ensuring timely and quality delivery of all system milestones
* Maintain and govern all business-owned system documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, SOPs, user guides, and validation plans (in close collaboration with validation/QA teams)
* Drive business sign-off and acceptance for all system changes, releases, and validation activities

Business–IT Liaison and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as the primary point of contact for all system-related matters between PV Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality Assurance, and the Technical/IT organization
* Translate complex business and regulatory needs into clear, actionable technical requirements for IT developers and vendors
* Facilitate regular forums, governance meetings, and working groups to ensure alignment across business and technical stakeholders
* Manage relationships with external system vendors and platform providers, including participating in vendor performance reviews, roadmap discussions, and contract input where applicable
* Escalate risks, issues, and decisions through appropriate channels with clear business impact framing

System Champion and Change Enablement
  
  

* Serve as the internal ambassador for PV systems — promoting best practices, driving adoption, and advocating for user-centric design
* Lead change management efforts for system rollouts and upgrades, including communication planning, training coordination, and stakeholder engagement
* Represent the PV systems landscape in cross-functional forums, steering committees, and process improvement initiatives
* Champion the adoption of innovative technologies — including AI/ML-assisted capabilities — within the PV ecosystem, evaluating feasibility and business value in partnership with IT

Compliance, Quality & Regulatory Alignment
  
  

* Ensure all systems under ownership comply with applicable global regulatory frameworks, including ICH E2B(R3), EMA EVMPD, FDA requirements, and GVP modules
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance to ensure systems are maintained in a validated state in accordance with GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11
* Support and participate in internal and external audits and regulatory inspections related to PV systems
* Monitor the regulatory landscape and proactively identify impacts to systems from evolving guidance, communicating these to relevant stakeholders
* Ensure data integrity, traceability, and audit trail standards are upheld across all system interactions

Operational Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Identify and implement process optimizations at the intersection of business workflows and system capabilities
* Support business continuity planning related to system downtime, data recovery, and disaster recovery scenarios
* Contribute to strategic planning for the PV systems portfolio, including build/buy/partner evaluations and technology investment recommendations

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Health Informatics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* 3–5 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety, or a closely related discipline
* Demonstrated experience owning or managing PV systems or technology platforms in a business capacity
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end life science lifecycle, from case intake through aggregate reporting and signal management
* Experience working in a regulated GxP environment and with validated systems

Key Skills and Competencies
  
  
Business and Stakeholder Skills
  
  

* Exceptional cross-functional communication — able to speak both "business" and "technology" fluently
* Strong project and program management skills; ability to manage multiple system workstreams simultaneously
* Proven ability to influence without authority across organizational levels and functions
* High-level analytical and critical thinking — able to assess complex problems and drive solutions
* Skilled in requirements gathering, business process mapping, and gap analysis
* Effective vendor management and negotiation capabilities
* Comfortable presenting to and engaging senior leadership

Personal Competencies
  
  

* Detail-oriented with a quality-first mindset
* Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable operating with ambiguity and autonomy
* Collaborative and empathetic — a natural team enabler and culture carrier
* Adaptable to a rapidly evolving technology and regulatory landscape
* Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in a patient safety context

Technical Knowledge Requirements
  
  
PV Safety Databases & Case Management
  
  

* Hands-on familiarity (business user level) with leading safety databases.
* Understanding of E2B(R3) case data structure, ICSR processing workflows, MedDRA coding, and regulatory submission timelines (e.g., 7/15-day reporting)

Reporting & Analytics Tools
  
  

* Experience with PV reporting platforms and dashboards, Power BI or equivalent BI tools for operational metrics CIOMS and PSUR/PBRER report generation workflows
* Ability to define and validate KPI reporting requirements in collaboration with data teams

Signal Detection & Management Tools
  
  

* Familiarity with signal management platforms.
* Understanding of disproportionality analysis (PRR, ROR, EBGM) and signal workflow from detection through evaluation and escalation
* Knowledge of EudraVigilance and FDA FAERS database structures and access

Literature Monitoring & Search Tools
  
  

* Experience with or oversight of systematic literature search tools.
* Understanding of ICSR extraction from literature, deduplication, and integration with safety databases.
* Awareness of AI-powered literature monitoring solutions and automation capabilities in this space

Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies
  
  

* Awareness of AI/ML applications in pharmacovigilance, including: AI-assisted case narrative generation and MedDRA auto-coding NLP for literature monitoring and social media surveillance Predictive analytics for signal detection and risk assessment Large Language Models (LLMs) and their responsible use in PV workflows

* Understanding of AI governance requirements in GxP contexts (data lineage, explainability, auditability)

* Familiarity with ICH E2A, E2B, E2C, E2D, E2E guidelines
* Understanding of audit trail requirements, data integrity standards (ALCOA+), and inspection readiness

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, nursing, public health, epidemiology, regulatory affairs, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, epidemiology, risk management, scientific consulting, regulatory affairs, or a related field required. **Objective Of The WHO Programme/Department**
The overall objective of the Digital Health Technical Unit in Department of HSD is to support the Member States to improve health for everyone, everywhere by accelerating the development and adoption of appropriate, accessible, affordable, scalable and sustainable person centric digital health solutions to prevent, detect and respond to epidemics and pandemics, developing infrastructure and applications that enable countries to use health data to promote health and well-being, and to achieve the health-related Sustainable Development Goals. WHO-SEARO is harnessing the power of digital technologies and health innovation to accelerate global attainment of health and the well-being. Translating latest data, research, and evidence into action: this means promoting standards for interoperability and data sharing and supporting implementation of digital solutions that contribute to informed decision making. Enhancing knowledge through scientific communities of practice: enabled by new technologies and no longer limited by the need for physical meetings or hard copy peer review journals, WHO brings together top expert voices around topics of clinical and public health significance. Systematically assessing and linking country needs with supply of innovations. WHO-SEARO takes a proactive, systematic approach to identify, promote, co-develop, and scale innovations that are based on country needs of the South East Asia Region. Also, to recognize the successful digital health initiatives and the urgent need to address the major impediments faced by least-developed countries of the region through implementing digital health technologies, to promote the appropriate use of digital technologies for health and to strengthen health systems by introducing digital technologies.
  
  
**Objective Of JPP**
The JPP will support the Digital Health Technical Unit at WHO-SEARO in advancing digital health and the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) across the South-East Asia Region. The JPP will provide technical support to Member States in the development, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of national digital health strategies, action plans and priority initiatives, aligned with regional priorities and universal health coverage (UHC).
  
  
The JPP will also contribute to regional digital health strategy and action planning, support the implementation and scale-up of digital health and AI initiatives, facilitate country-level technical assistance and capacity building, and help strengthen sustainable, interoperable and context-appropriate digital health ecosystems across Member States.
  
  
**Supervisor**
First Level: Dr Karthik Adapa, RA-DH
  
  
Second Level : Mr Manoj Jhalani, Director-HSD
  
  
**Terms of reference**

* Support WHO-SEARO and Member States in the development, implementation, monitoring and review of digital health strategies, action plans, roadmaps and priority initiatives
* Provide technical and coordination support for regional and country-level work on digital health architecture, interoperability and standards, digital public infrastructure for health (DPI-H), capacity building.
* Support engagement and consultations with Member States, WHO departments and Regional/Country Offices, development partners, civil society, academia, technology stakeholders, healthcare workers and other relevant partners, including preparation of technical materials, agendas, meeting reports and follow-up actions.
* Engage technical and development partners, academia, civil society and other relevant stakeholders to facilitate strategic partnerships for Member States.
* Contribute to the development, review and strengthening of technical guidance, policy documents, reports, concept notes, knowledge products and other technical materials related to digital health.
* Support capacity-building, workshops, consultations and knowledge-exchange activities for Member States, including identification of country needs, priorities, implementation challenges and opportunities for technical assistance.
* Undertake evidence reviews, research and technical analysis to inform WHO-SEARO’s digital health portfolio and support the translation of global and regional guidance into country-level implementation.
* Support the documentation, monitoring and dissemination of country and regional digital health initiatives, implementation experiences, lessons and good practices to facilitate learning across the South-East Asia Region.
* Undertake other related activities assigned by the Regional Adviser, Digital Health, in alignment with the priorities of HSD and WHO-SEARO.

**Experience**
**Essential:**

* Minimum one year of experience embedded within national and/or subnational government systems, partnering directly with public health leadership to drive large-scale health reforms.
* In-depth knowledge of government-centric digital health implementation and large-scale digital health solution deployments for national and subnational public health systems.
* Proven track record in drafting high-impact national and state-level policies.
* At least one year of experience in managing and engaging diverse stakeholders at the subnational, national, and global levels across multilaterals, donors, governments, non-profits, academia, and/or private partners.

title: Product Sustainability, Managing Consultant
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Managing Consultant - Product Sustainability**
, you will support ERM’s global Product Sustainability delivery by providing senior-level expertise in product safety, hazard communication, and regulatory compliance. Working closely with global Product Stewardship, EHS, R&D, Supply Chain, Legal, and business stakeholders, you will ensure accurate product safety information, regulatory compliance, and high-quality delivery across regions. This role is critical in maintaining data integrity, supporting compliant product commercialization, and driving consistency, efficiency, and continuous improvement across ERM’s global product sustainability services.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Lead complex Safety Data Sheet (SDS) authoring, reviews, and hazard classification activities, ensuring globally compliant product safety documentation.
* Interpret and apply global product safety and chemical regulations, supporting compliance across multiple regions and markets.
* Drive data quality, governance, and audit readiness within product safety systems, ensuring accurate and reliable regulatory information.
* Serve as a subject matter expert by providing technical guidance and mentoring team members on product stewardship and compliance requirements.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve complex product safety challenges and implement continuous process improvements.

**What will you bring?**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Sciences, Toxicology, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science or a related scientific discipline; an advanced degree is advantageous
* 7-12 years of relevant experience in Product Sustainability, Product Safety, Product Stewardship, Hazard Communication, EHS or chemical regulatory compliance, including experience handling complex global product-safety work.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP EHS, including CG\* transactions and product-safety data management.
* Strong knowledge of UN GHS and EU CLP regulations, with demonstrated experience applying classification and hazard-communication requirements to substances and mixtures.
* Experience creating and governing SDS/product safety documentation and performing senior-level quality or peer reviews.
* Strong analytical judgement, stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex regulatory topics to non-specialists and work effectively across global teams.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills & Competencies**

* Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations, including IATA, ADR, RID, ADN, IMDG and US 49 CFR.
* Broader knowledge of chemical/product regulations such as REACH, TSCA, RoHS, OSHA HazCom or regional equivalents.
* Experience with regulatory notifications/submissions, multilingual SDS/label governance, SAP EHS implementation/enhancement projects, compliance reporting or system testing.
* Experience coaching or mentoring junior colleagues in product safety, regulatory or SAP EHS processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complex SDS authoring, review and maintenance activities across products and regions, ensuring scientific accuracy, regulatory compliance and consistent hazard communication.
* Perform and review advanced substance and mixture hazard classifications using UN GHS and EU CLP principles, resolving complex or ambiguous classification cases and documenting the technical rationale.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for SAP S/4HANA and SAP EHS product safety processes, including relevant CG\* transactions, data governance, troubleshooting and quality controls.
* Interpret regulatory changes and translate them into practical impacts for SDS, classifications, labels, SAP EHS data, procedures and stakeholder actions.
* Lead complex product safety and regulatory queries, coordinating inputs from global stakeholders and ensuring clear, defensible and timely responses.
* Provide technical guidance and peer review to specialists, promoting consistent standards, strong documentation practices and capability development across the team.
* Partner with Product Stewardship, EHS, R&D/technical, supply chain, legal and business stakeholders to support compliant products, launches and business continuity.
* Drive data-quality, audit-readiness and continuous-improvement initiatives, including SAP EHS enhancements, UAT/regression testing, reporting, templates and workflow improvements.
* Support or lead regulatory submissions, notifications and compliance documentation where required, maintaining complete and traceable records.

**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**
Please note that the deadline for receipt of applications indicated above reflects your personal device's system settings.
  
  
**Objective Of The WHO Programme/Department**
The overall objective of the Digital Health & AI Technical Unit in Department of HSD is to support the Member States to improve health for everyone, everywhere by accelerating the development and adoption of appropriate, accessible, affordable, scalable and sustainable person-centric digital health & AI solutions to prevent, detect and respond to epidemics and pandemics, developing infrastructure and applications that enable countries to use health data to promote health and well-being, and to achieve the health-related Sustainable Development Goals. WHO-SEARO is harnessing the power of digital technologies and health innovation to accelerate global attainment of health and the well-being.
  
  
Translating latest data, research, and evidence into action: this means promoting standards for interoperability and data sharing and supporting implementation of digital solutions that contribute to informed decision making. Enhancing knowledge through scientific communities of practice: enabled by new technologies and no longer limited by the need for physical meetings or hard copy peer review journals, WHO brings together top expert voices around topics of clinical and public health significance. Systematically assessing and linking country needs with supply of innovations. WHO-SEARO takes a proactive, systematic approach to identify, promote, co-develop, and scale innovations that are based on country needs of the South East Asia Region. Also, to recognize the successful digital health & AI initiatives and the urgent need to address the major impediments faced by least-developed countries of the region through implementing digital health technologies, to promote the appropriate use of digital technologies for health and to strengthen health systems by introducing digital technologies.
  
  
**Objective Of JPP**
The JPP will support the Digital Health & AI Technical Unit at WHO-SEARO in strengthening the responsible development, evaluation, implementation and scale-up of artificial intelligence for health ecosystem across the South-East Asia Region.
  
  
The JPP will provide specialized technical support to Member States across the AI lifecycle, including identification and prioritization of health-system problems suitable for AI applications; assessment of data readiness and technical requirements; development and review of AI approaches; validation and evaluation of AI-enabled technologies/programs; deployment and integration within health systems; and post-deployment monitoring and scale-up.
  
  
The JPP will also contribute to regional and country-level work on AI governance, safety, ethics, equity, technical standards, technology assessment, capacity building and evidence generation, helping Member States translate advances in AI into safe, effective, equitable and context-appropriate health applications.
  
  
**Supervisor**
First Level: Dr Karthik Adapa, RA-DH
  
  
Second Level : Mr Manoj Jhalani, Director-HSD
  
  
**Terms of reference**
Under The Overall Guidance Of The Director, Department Of Health Systems Development (HSD) And The Direct Supervision Of The Regional Adviser, Digital Health, The JPP Will Provide Support In The Following Areas
  
  

* Provide technical support to WHO-SEARO and Member States on AI enabled solutions, strategies and implementation.
* Support the Strategy for AI in Healthcare for India (SAHI) implementation, operationalization, developing State AI Readiness Index, and AI health work related to SAHI.
* Support the technical assessment, validation, evaluation of AI-enabled health technologies/programs.
* Support Member States in assessing AI readiness, including data availability, quality, representativeness, infrastructure, computational requirements, interoperability, workforce capacity and institutional readiness.
* Support the development and application of AI evaluation frameworks and methodologies
* Contribute to AI governance and responsible AI frameworks
* Support development of conceptual frameworks, technical guidance, strategic plans, policy proposals, technical specifications, reports and knowledge products related to AI in health.
* Undertake evidence reviews, technical analyses and horizon scanning on emerging AI technologies and their potential applications, risks and implications for health systems.
* Support technical implementation and integration of AI applications within existing digital health ecosystems, including consideration of interoperability, APIs, data standards, digital public infrastructure and existing health-information systems.
* Support Member States in developing technical and institutional capacity for AI in health, including technical workshops, training programmes, and practical capacity-building activities.
* Facilitate technical engagement with Ministries of Health, WHO Country Offices, academic and research institutions, technology developers, regulatory institutions, development partners and other stakeholders involved in AI development, evaluation and implementation.
* Support documentation and dissemination of AI implementation experiences, evaluations, lessons and good practices across the South-East Asia Region.
* Undertake other related technical activities assigned by the Regional Adviser, Digital Health, in alignment with WHO-SEARO priorities.

**Education**
**Essential:**
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, Computational Sciences, or another closely related technical discipline relevant to artificial intelligence, machine learning, or data science.
  
  
**Desirable:**
Masters/PhD strongly recommended in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Public Health, or a related field, with demonstrated interdisciplinary education and/or experience at the intersection of health and technology development/application.
  
  
Additional academic training, certification or demonstrated technical expertise in health law, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, health informatics, biomedical data science, AI evaluation or responsible AI would be an asset.
  
  
**Experience**
Essential: At least two years of experience working on digital health, artificial intelligence, or machine-learning projects, including direct experience in AI for health involving the development, testing, validation, deployment, evaluation, or scale-up of AI-enabled health technologies.
  
  
**Desirable**

* Experience in AI technology assessment, product development, clinical or public-health AI evaluation, AI safety, health informatics or digital health architecture.
* Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with governments, Ministries of Health, academic and research institutions, technology developers, NGOs, development partners and/or global funders, particularly in low- and middle-income countries or the Global South.
* Relevant experience working with UN agencies, in particular WHO.
* Knowledge of any/multiple SEA Regional languages is an asset.

**Age:**
Below 35 years
  
  
This Vacancy Notice is only applicable to nationals of South-East Asia Region Member States i.e., Bangladesh, Bhutan, DPR Korea, India, Maldives, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Timor-Leste

**Skills required for the assignment:**

* Proficiency in spoken and written English;
* Strong technical understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science and statistical modelling.
* Deep understanding on DPIs, DPI-Health, Reference Architecture
* Deep understanding of the AI development lifecycle
* Ability to critically assess and evaluate AI models and products
* Deep understanding of SAHI, National AI health strategies globally
* Understanding of health data, health information systems and the technical considerations involved in integrating AI into digital health environments.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into recommendations for policymakers, health-system leaders and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, scientific writing and technical communication skills.

Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change. With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. We are unique in our focus on finance, our ability to get the right people to the table, and our analytical rigor.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a communications associate who will primarily be responsible for supporting content development and editing across our India programs. You will possess the ability to translate economics, finance, and policy analysis into clear, concise, and accessible insights for investors and policymakers. You will align CPI content with the most recent trends in climate finance and policy, in ways that directly speak to our target audiences and ensures that CPI expertise provides actionable guidance to decision makers at the highest levels.
  
  
The ideal communications associate will have a strong interest in sustainable business, investment, finance, and economics, and dedication to CPI’s mission and impact.
  
  
You will report to the India Communications lead, and will closely collaborate with program teams in India, as well as the global communications team. You will also work with external stakeholders including partner NGOs and the media.

Includes the following and other duties as assigned:
  
  

* Develop and carry out integrated, external communications plans that are aligned with directly influencing the intended audience and have measurable KPIs
* Guide content development from concept to publication—including storyboards, key messaging, structure, and editing—of CPI research products, presentations, op-eds, social media campaigns, and other written content.
* Ensure adherence to CPI’s in-house style guide, brand, and citation standards.

title: Sr. Associate- Tech
description:
**Job Description**
The Asia Group is now accepting applications for a Sr. Associate, Technology Policy to join our South Asia practice in New Delhi. This position will support the South Asia practice based across New Delhi, Mumbai, and Washington D.C. 
  
  
Headquartered in Washington, D.C., The Asia Group (“TAG”) is a strategic and capital advisory firm that positions clients – ranging from Fortune 100 multinationals to innovative startups – for success in established and emerging markets across the Indo-Pacific region. Our diverse team possesses decades of government and private sector experience with a work ethos that emphasizes teamwork, collegiality, creativity, entrepreneurialism, and mentorship. 
  
  
Sr. Associate will work closely with the technology team and play key roles in supporting the firm’s research, analysis, and engagement with stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have substantive experience and expertise in the Indian technology and AI policy landscape. In addition, a successful candidate will have a strong command of the political, regulatory, and macroeconomic environments in India, demonstrating the ability to distill these trends into actionable insights. Excellent writing skills, the ability to communicate professionally with external stakeholders, and a genuine desire to learn are pre-requisites.  
  
  
All interested candidates must submit a cover letter, resume, and references via the application portal on our website. Due to the volume of applications received, responses from our recruiting team may be delayed. No phone calls or emails and whatsApp messages, please. 
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Support the South Asia team in servicing global clients through execution of high-value added deliverables with a focus on emerging technologies, including AI, fintech, gaming, electronics, digital public infrastructure, and digital platforms
* Conduct meticulous industry and political research and analysis, and business due diligence
* Lead the drafting of high-quality executive memos, reports, briefing materials, and other written products for external (client) and internal (TAG) consumers, often under short deadlines
* Actively participate in regular client engagements, including briefing sessions and workshops, alongside senior staff
* Track market, policy, and industry developments impacting client equities, particularly in the AI and broader tech policy landscape
* Represent the firm at relevant industry/policy events and forums by actively projecting the firm's expertise, relationships, and market leadership.
* Provide logistical and event support for client engagements in New Delhi
* Support stakeholder engagement and facilitate the management of executive visits
* Conduct policy research, develop advocacy strategies, create knowledge products, while supporting the senior team in managing diverse client engagements
* Build and nurture networks with policy stakeholders, key opinion leaders, civil society and media experts.
* Develop research and thought leadership products for TAG AI, showcasing insights and expertise on emerging trends and policy issues

**Job requirements**

* Master’s degree or equivalent academic/practice experience related to India/South Asia economic, industry, and policy issues
* 3-6 years of prior work experience, preferably including in a client-servicing industry or government experience
* Strong understanding of and interest in emerging technologies, including AI, fintech, and digital policy strategies
* Outstanding research, analytical, and writing skills
* Strong grasp of business strategy fundamentals, particularly in emerging markets
* Strong attention to detail and excels under tight deadlines
* Proficiency in Microsoft applications – demonstrated fluency in Microsoft Excel and other statistical languages
* Sector-specific expertise in AI, tech and/or fintech in India
* Experience in data visualization and design a plus
* Genuine desire to learn, including through feedback from senior team members and peers
* Team player with eagerness for professional development
* Demonstrated familiarity with Indian market dynamics and/or private sector experience, including industry, consulting, or other sectors

  
We value professionals who are proactive in exploring new ways to work smarter. Ideal candidates will be comfortable using artificial intelligence tools — or excited to learn how — to increase efficiency, enhance analysis or deliverables, and generate innovative solutions. Familiarity with generative AI platforms or a growth mindset toward emerging technologies is a plus.   
  
  
Candidates must be eligible to work in India and are expected to work in-person at the TAG New Delhi office five days per week. 
  
  
**Job Benefits**
TAG provides competitive benefits with regular training opportunities available to its employees.

title: Project Associate
description:
**About Peepul**

6.5 million students. 291,000 teachers. 90,000+ schools. That’s the scale of what Peepul is changing — and this role sits at the centre of it. Peepul is an education non-profit working with state governments in Delhi and Madhya Pradesh to drive systemic reform at scale. We’ve received international recognition — including the Commonwealth Education Award for Innovation — and are backed by India’s leading CSR funders and global partners. Our model is simple: embed, deliver, measure anchored in system-level change, in partnership with governments. We are a growing organisation with an ambitious strategy and a strong evidence base. Join us in our mission to create a world where every child has equal access to high-quality education. Learn more about our transformative work at http://peepulindia.org

**About the role**

The role of the
**Project Associate/Senior Project Associate - DIB on Assessment Reforms**
is critical to the success of the continued partnership with erstwhile MCD towards achieving quality education for all, and to Peepul’s strategic objective of supporting quality improvement in the public school system in India.

This is therefore an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated individual to play a key role in a flagship reform initiative with enormous potential impact. To enable programme’s success, we are required to rapidly roll-out and scale our support to reach all teachers officials in the MCD.

The
**Project Associate/Senior Project Associate**
will be an excellent team player, who will drive design and delivery of interventions towards stronger support and accountability of teachers and academic officials of the MCD. The ideal candidate should be able to bring together e
**ducation expertise, creative problem-solving and stakeholder management,**
towards the creation, implementation, and impact tracking of high-quality initiatives towards improvement of the quality of education in the MCD.

**Responsibilities would include (but not be limited to):**

**To support the design and delivery of the DIB – Assessment Reforms project and build a coalition of support around them.**

• Support the instructional design of FLN based training content, including the
**creation of engaging, need-based, relevant, and rigorous training modules**
for teachers, School Leaders and other stakeholders.

• Design high quality needs-assessment and post training assessments to
**track the impact of the capacity building interventions.**

• Build consensus within all levels of government and other stakeholders, towards the vision and objectives of the programme

• Apply content knowledge and classroom experience in developing the interventions that will lead to shifts in teacher mindset, knowledge, and practice

• Support the program manager in implementing the pilot of interventions, documenting learning, and evolving the design to have greater impact at scale

**To manage best-in-class project implementation**

• Plan and sequence the implementation of Training modules for teachers in close coordination with the Program manager

• Design and facilitate training sessions for teachers, school leaders and other key stakeholders.

• Conduct classroom observation to understand the impact of the trainings on ground and
**drive an effective implementation of the learnings of training**
through sharing feedback to the teachers

**To be a strong team collaborator, manage cross-functional relationships and engage effectively with key government stakeholders**

• Effectively work in a matrixed environment with programme team, monitoring and evaluation team and field staff

• Develop and maintain strong operational relationships with government partners, providing leadership and putting in place mechanisms to
**support collaboration and cross-organisational working.**

• Design and build effective, fully aligned partnerships to leverage external expertise

• where appropriate given Peepul’s in-house skill-set

• Build capacity within government teams to
**ensure ongoing, sustainable organisational self-improvement**
after the formal end of the projects / the broader programme

Requirements

**Qualifications and Role Requirements:**

At Peepul, we seek talented professionals passionate about driving educational transformation and making a positive impact. We are looking for individuals who possess the following qualifications and meet the role requirements:

**• Educational Background:**
A relevant educational background in Education or related disciplines is highly preferred.

**• Work Experience:**
We value both professional and personal experience. Candidates with at least 3-5 years of experience in teaching, mentoring or education-related work would be preferred. Demonstrated knowledge and skills in assessment design and facilitation is required.

•
**Other Skills:**
Excellent interpersonal skills to support and influence stakeholders and ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse group of individuals.

**• Language Proficiency:**
English and Hindi

**How to apply**

To apply for a position, click on the application link here.

You will be required to upload:

**• Your CV:**
Please ensure that your CV provides relevant information about your professional and personal experience and details of your academic qualifications. CVs can be one to two pages in length.

**• A cover letter:**
We highly encourage you to use your cover letter to showcase your specific interest in working for Peepul and demonstrate how your qualifications align with the role you are applying for. A tailored cover letter holds significant importance in Peepul's recruitment process as it enables us to comprehend your motivations for the position, your relevant skills, and the clarity of your writing.

For any further queries related to our hiring process and timelines, please contact us at recruitment@peepulindia.org.

title: Course design expert
description:
We're Hiring: Course Design Expert | Dr. Shroff's Charity Eye Hospital (SCEH), Delhi

Dr. Shroff's Charity Eye Hospital (SCEH) is building a portfolio of courses and training programs designed to become the benchmark for eyecare education — not just within our organisation, but across the sector, in India and globally.

We're looking for a Course Design Expert to make this happen.

What you'll do:

This role sits within our Talent Management & L&D team but works across the SCEH group — partnering with Medical Education, Allied Ophthalmic Personnel, Public Health, and clinical/administrative departments. You'll take the deep expertise of senior clinicians and program leads and convert it into structured, world-class courses: clear objectives, defined competencies, sound pedagogy, and content that holds up against global standards.

The role has two halves:

Architect — partnering with departments to define what a course should achieve and how it should be structured

Developer — working hands-on with internal and external faculty to build, sequence, and refine the actual content

Who we're looking for:

6–10 years of experience in curriculum or course design

Strong background in eyecare hospitals, healthcare NGOs, or non-profit/trust training environments — you understand clinical and support-function content, and the sector we serve

A PhD or postgraduate qualification in instructional design, education, curriculum development, adult learning, or a closely related field

Proven experience converting clinical/technical expertise into structured, learner-centered courses

Comfort working with SMEs who are brilliant at their craft but not trained educators — and the patience to bridge that gap

Solid grounding in competency-based education, outcome-based curriculum design, and adult learning theory

Why this role matters:

You won't just be designing courses — you'll be setting the quality bar for eyecare training across an entire sector. If you've spent your career translating clinical or field expertise into training that actually changes practice, we want to hear from you.

Location: Delhi

Full-time | Cross-departmental role

How to apply:

Send your resume to recruitmentdelhi@sceh.net

title: Associate- Vector(Commercial CD)
description:
**About Us**
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
This role is based in the Vector Center of Excellence (Vector CoE), part of Bain’s broader “Data & Technology” umbrella within the BCN. The Vector CoE provides specialized support on Tech Strategy, Transformation, and Roadmap projects for Bain clients across industries. The Vector CoE team acts as the analytical and delivery arm of Bain’s ET Practice, providing expertise in:
  
  

* Building and deploying Enterprise Technology diagnostics
* Delivering core technology products for consulting teams
* Working directly with clients to support technology transformations
* Integrating new and emerging technologies such as AI and automation into diagnostics

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute significantly to proposal development - from initial drafting and value proposition formulation to final submission and follow-up
* Work with senior leadership to translate the company’s capabilities and asset base into a crisp, client-specific commercial narrative
* Craft executive-level briefing materials and dashboards that position Bain's expertise ahead of key client conversations - synthesizing relevant trends, competitive dynamics, and Bain's angle into a sharp, senior-ready output
* Design and maintain Bain's case experience and asset base into a suite of client development materials - including credentials decks, capability overviews, and sector-specific one-pagers - that can be deployed across pitches, RFPs, and senior client meetings
* Work under the guidance of a Project Leader / Team Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s overall answer and final materials, client communication, work planning, and team management
* Provide thought leadership and sound business judgment to drive innovation, product ideation and development
* Display strong execution ability, along with the ability to pressure-test insights and conduct thorough validation and sense checks
* Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations
* Ensure timely, high quality, zero-defect delivery, analysis and output produced by the analysts/associates
* Ability to deliver client-ready outputs with actionable, implementable solutions
* Display excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, driving teams toward practical and pragmatic solutions
* Deliver clear and professional presentations to the team/team leaders/managers/ clients
* Consistently seek and provide meaningful and actionable feedback in all interactions; recognize different skills and development needs in oneself and work towards it

**About You**

* Candidates should be graduates / post-graduates with strong academic record
* Work experience range in case highest qualification is undergraduate studies – 2-5 years of relevant experience in a professional services context
* Work experience range in case highest qualification is postgraduate studies – 2-3 years of relevant experience in a professional services context
* Ideal candidates have a strong consulting mindset and have contributed to client-facing engagements
* Should be able to develop high-quality, original thought leadership - including points of view, market overviews, whitepapers, and executive briefings - on priority ET topics such as Enterprise AI Strategy, Data Architecture, AI and Technology Transformation, etc.
* Adept at designing and executing primary research initiatives (expert interviews, practitioner surveys, case-based synthesis) to generate proprietary insights that set Bain's perspective apart in the market
* Should be able to conduct rigorous secondary research across industry reports, academic literature, analyst publications, and emerging technology signals - with fluency across leading platforms such as Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and technology-specific sources
* Experience in translating complex technical and strategic content into sharp, senior-ready narratives that drive decision-making at the C-suite and board level
* Display and apply deep understanding of enterprise technology domains - including AI strategy, cloud platforms, data architecture, application modernization, and digital product development - to pressure-test the rigor, relevance, and differentiation of every asset produced
* Have a good hold over Excel, PowerPoint, Alteryx and other analytical tools
* Possess advanced numerical and modeling skills, with a strong focus on maintaining high data quality standards
* Be good with breaking business objectives into smaller tasks and building project plans
* Possess excellent analytic, communication, and team player skills with ability to multi-task and work under pressure
* You’ll help design and deploy scalable technology solutions, leveraging advanced LLMs, and implement autonomous agents to drive measurable business value

**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**

title: Applications Engineer
description:
**Overview**
At Lutron, we are passionate about creating exceptional experiences through innovative lighting, shading, and control solutions. We are looking for an Application Engineer to join our team in Gurgaon. As a member of our training team, you will design and deliver impactful learning experiences that empower customers, partners, and employees to successfully implement and support Lutron solutions.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with talented colleagues across global teams, develop deep technical and product expertise, and make a meaningful contribution to maintaining Lutron's leadership in the smart building and luxury residential markets.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and deliver training programs and learning content for solution providers, designers, architects, and customer-facing professionals
* Conduct product and system demonstrations, providing hands-on instruction and explaining the technical and functional capabilities of Lutron systems.
* Design, administer, and manage certification programs for Lutron solution providers across the residential, commercial, and hospitality market segments.
* Own and manage the Customer Experience infrastructure and facilitate customer walkthroughs at the Lutron Gurgaon office.
* Serve as a technical expert on Lutron solutions across the product portfolio, providing guidance and support to internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain and update training programs and content to reflect new products, solutions, and industry standards.
* Gather feedback, evaluate training effectiveness, enhance learning materials, and manage relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, distributors, and solution providers.
* Support sales teams by delivering technical training, product presentations, and solution demonstrations to prospective clients.
* Coordinate and schedule training sessions, manage training delivery, and track participant progress and certification status.
* Prepare reports on training effectiveness, analyze learning outcomes, and monitor industry trends to drive continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering with a minimum, aggregate of 60%.
* 4+ years of experience in lighting control solutions, lighting design, architecture, or interior design.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively in English, including delivering presentations, preparing written documentation, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders
* Experience working with cross-functional teams, customers, consultants, contractors, or channel partners in a professional environment
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work flexible hours, including occasional weekends, to support business requirements
* Ability and willingness to travel extensively (up to 70%) across India, Maldives, Sri Lanka, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia

**Desired Skills**

* Knowledge of lighting design, lighting control systems, and automated shading solutions.
* Experience developing and delivering technical training, certification programs, and training materials.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Effective stakeholder engagement, customer support, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Enhanced analytical, problem-solving, and adaptability skills to address technical challenges and evolving business needs.

Lutron Electronics’ position as the worldwide leader in innovative lighting control and shading solutions has enabled consistent, annual growth. Our company has cultivated a reputation of unsurpassed quality, a broad range of technologies and product offerings, and a strong commitment to servicing our worldwide customers. This has allowed the company to invest in developing new technologies and services, expand our technical capabilities and global presence, and to find and retain the best talent. Build your career with Lutron where you will enjoy competitive compensation and benefits while exploring many options for continued growth and education. Make a difference every day in our dynamic, people-centric, technology-driven organization. For more information, view our website at www.lutron.com.

Capital Business Park, Unit No 1104, 11
th

  Define, review, and approve supplier testing protocols (environmental, electrical, and mechanical stress tests) for analog/digital circuits and drive systems.

  in Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Instrumentation / Mechatronics.

title: Analyst-Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
Marketing Campaigns are critical drivers of American Express strategy to acquire, engage and retain customers. Marketing teams across international need best in class tools and processes to enable flawless and timely delivery of their campaigns to unlock the value for our customers and prospects. The I nternational Campaign Solutions & Execution Team within International Marketing Experiences (IMX) is responsible for supporting campaign targeting, execution, delivery and fulfillment.
  
  
The Analyst, International Campaign Solutions & Execution team, will play a key role in driving process excellence, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation across campaign targeting and execution processes for international markets. This role will serve as a trusted consultant to marketing stakeholders by providing insights, recommendations, and innovative solutions that enhance marketer experience, improve operational effectiveness, and accelerate speed to market. * Support process improvement and change management initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness and drive adoption of new capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, eliminate inefficiencies, and implement innovative solutions that improve marketer experience and business outcomes.
* Actively challenge the status quo by bringing forward new ideas, data-driven recommendations, and creative approaches to solve business problems.
* Partner with stakeholders across functions to drive alignment, facilitate decision-making, and ensure successful execution of operational initiatives.
* Support the implementation and adoption of system enhancements, automation opportunities, and emerging technologies, including AI-powered solutions.
* Coordinate and support operational control activities, risk assessments, internal-audits, and process documentation to strengthen the control environment.
* Analyze operational performance & market landscapes and identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities to drive continuous enhancement.
* Contribute to transformation and automation initiatives across international markets through collaboration, testing, process design, and stakeholder engagement.
* Support team members by sharing knowledge, mentoring peers, and contributing to a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

**Qualifications**




+ Proven experience in stakeholder consultation, business problem solving, and process improvement.
+ Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build credibility, influence outcomes, and work effectively across diverse teams.
+ Self-motivated and proactive, with a demonstrated ability to take ownership, drive initiatives independently, and deliver results.
+ Strong change management mindset with experience supporting operational or technology-driven transformations.
+ Ability to identify process inefficiencies and develop practical, scalable solutions that improve effectiveness and reduce risk.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience translating insights into actionable recommendations.
+ Experience leveraging AI tools, automation technologies, and data-driven approaches to improve operational processes and business outcomes.

2-6 years of relevant work experience
