title: Senior Solution Implementation Specialist
description:
Software Implementation (SWI) Engineer
**Location:**
India
**Team:**
Software Implementation (SWI)
**Travel:**
Willingness and ability to travel internationally, including to the United States
**Experience:**
3–8 years preferred About the SWI Team The
**Software Implementation (SWI) team**
is responsible for ensuring the successful implementation, integration, testing, and deployment of GreyOrange software and automation solutions at customer sites. SWI engineers work at the intersection of
**software, testing, automation, and customer implementation**
. The role involves working closely with GreyOrange products, simulations and emulations, customer systems, and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure solutions are thoroughly validated and successfully transitioned into production. This is a highly technical, hands-on role for engineers who enjoy
**troubleshooting complex software issues, testing APIs and integrations, writing automation scripts, and working directly with customers**
. Key Responsibilities Software Testing & Validation
  
  

* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing of GreyOrange products and solutions.
* Execute simulation and emulation testing to validate system behavior before and during customer implementations.
* Develop and execute detailed test scenarios, test cases, and validation plans.
* Identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and document software defects and integration issues.
* Perform log analysis and root-cause investigation of complex technical issues.
* Validate system performance, reliability, and interoperability across multiple software and hardware components.

Customer Implementation & Deployment
  
  

* Work directly with customers throughout the implementation lifecycle, including:

+ SIT (System Integration Testing)
+ UAT (User Acceptance Testing)
+ HAT (Hardware Acceptance Testing)
+ Go-Live
+ Post-Go-Live Support

* Collaborate with customer IT, engineering, and operations teams to troubleshoot and resolve implementation issues.
* Support software configuration, integration validation, deployment readiness, and production cutover activities.
* Participate in on-site customer deployments and provide hands-on technical support during critical implementation phases.
* Communicate technical issues, risks, status, and resolutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Troubleshooting & Automation
  
  

* Use Python, Unix/Linux, SQL, JSON, REST APIs, and Postman extensively for testing, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Write and maintain shell scripts to automate testing, diagnostics, deployments, and repetitive operational tasks.
* Analyze application and system logs to identify problems and isolate root causes.
* Debug API, database, integration, configuration, and environment-related issues.
* Develop utilities and scripts that improve testing efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Validate data flows between GreyOrange products and customer systems.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong software testing and debugging fundamentals.
* Python – scripting, automation, debugging, and test utilities.
* Unix/Linux – strong command-line skills, troubleshooting, process management, logs, permissions, networking basics, etc.
* Shell scripting – ability to write, understand, and debug Bash/shell scripts.
* SQL – ability to query databases, validate data, troubleshoot data issues, and perform complex queries.
* JSON – strong understanding of JSON structures and data manipulation.
* REST APIs – strong understanding of API-based integrations and troubleshooting.
* Postman – ability to create, execute, and troubleshoot API collections and test scenarios.
* Strong understanding of software integration and distributed-system concepts.
* Experience with log analysis and systematic root-cause analysis.
* Familiarity with source control systems such as Git.
* Ability to quickly understand new products, architectures, APIs, and technical environments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with warehouse automation, robotics, logistics, fulfillment, or enterprise software implementations.
* Experience testing complex distributed systems or highly integrated software platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD and automated testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with messaging systems, databases, networking, and cloud environments.
* Experience working with customer-facing implementation or professional services teams.
* Experience supporting production systems and critical go-live events.
* Knowledge of test automation frameworks such as PyTest or similar tools.
* Exposure to Docker/Kubernetes or other modern deployment technologies is a plus.

What We're Looking For We are looking for
**strong hands-on engineers—not just manual testers**
. The ideal candidate:
  
  

* Is technically curious and enjoys solving difficult problems.
* Can independently investigate an issue from a customer symptom down to the underlying technical root cause.
* Is comfortable working from the Linux command line and writing scripts to diagnose problems.
* Can use Python, SQL, APIs, Postman, and shell scripting as everyday engineering tools.
* Has strong analytical and debugging skills.
* Can work effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving implementation environments.
* Is comfortable interacting directly with customers and explaining technical issues clearly.
* Takes ownership of problems through resolution rather than simply reporting defects.
* Can work collaboratively with Software Engineering, QA, Product, Solutions, and Customer teams.
* Is willing to travel internationally, including extended on-site assignments in the United States, based on project requirements.

Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
* 3–8 years of relevant experience in software testing, QA automation, system integration, implementation, production support, or a related engineering role.
* Candidates with exceptional technical skills and relevant hands-on experience are encouraged to apply regardless of exact years of experience.

Why Join the SWI Team? The SWI team offers an opportunity to work on
**real-world, mission-critical automation implementations**
and see software solutions move from development and simulation all the way through customer acceptance and production. You will work across
**engineering, testing, automation, integration, and customer deployment**
, gaining exposure to complex systems while playing a direct role in delivering successful customer outcomes.
**If you are an engineer who loves debugging, automation, APIs, Linux, and solving problems in the real world—and you're excited to work directly with customers and travel internationally—we'd like to hear from you.**

title: COAA Authors Engagement Lead
description:
**Job Description**
The COAA Authors Engagement Lead is responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with Clinical Outcome Assessment (COA) authors, copyright holders, academic institutions, and scientific organizations to support the creation, maintenance, and continuous growth of the Clinical Outcome Assessments Accelerator (COAA) platform.
  
  
This role serves as a primary point of contact between IQVIA and the global COA community, facilitating the collection, validation, and maintenance of information required to ensure the quality, completeness, and accuracy of COAA records. The position plays a critical role in supporting portfolio expansion initiatives by engaging directly with authors and stakeholders involved in the development and ownership of Clinical Outcome Assessments.
  
  
Working closely with COAA Content, eCOA Library, Licensing Services, Product Management, and other cross-functional teams, the COAA Authors Engagement Lead helps ensure that COAA remains the industry's most comprehensive and trusted source of COA information.
  
  
**Essential Functions**
Author Engagement and Relationship Management
  
  
Establish, develop, and maintain professional relationships with COA authors, copyright holders, academic institutions, and scientific organizations worldwide.
  
  
Serve as a primary point of contact for author engagement activities supporting COAA.
  
  
Build long-term collaborative relationships that facilitate ongoing information sharing and data maintenance.
  
  
Represent IQVIA and the COAA platform within the broader COA community.
  
  
Content Development and Record Creation
  
  
Contribute to the identification of priority assessments for inclusion within COAA.
  
  
Conduct outreach activities to collect information required for the creation of new COAA records.
  
  
Coordinate with authors and stakeholders to obtain instrument documentation, metadata, publication information, and related materials.
  
  
Support the development and onboarding of new content into the COAA platform.
  
  
Data Maintenance and Quality
  
  
Maintain ongoing communication with authors to identify instrument updates, revisions, new publications, and changes impacting existing records.
  
  
Coordinate periodic reviews of COAA content to ensure information remains accurate and current.
  
  
Investigate and resolve content discrepancies, missing data, and data quality issues.
  
  
Support overall COAA data governance and maintenance activities.
  
  
Strategic Portfolio Support
  
  
Support initiatives aimed at expanding COAA coverage across therapeutic areas and assessment types.
  
  
Identify emerging assessments and opportunities to enhance the COAA portfolio.
  
  
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support content growth priorities and strategic objectives.
  
  
Contribute insights regarding author engagement trends and opportunities.
  
  
Operational Excellence
  
  
Maintain tracking systems and documentation related to author engagement activities.
  
  
Monitor key performance indicators related to record creation, maintenance activities, and author responsiveness.
  
  
Develop and improve author engagement processes and best practices.
  
  
Support continuous improvement initiatives across COAA operations.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Education
  
  
Bachelor's degree required.
  
  
Degree in Life Sciences, Psychology, Public Health, Health Outcomes Research, Healthcare, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
5+ years of experience in stakeholder engagement, content development, scientific data management, clinical research, healthcare consulting, or related fields.
  
  
Experience interacting with external experts, academic researchers, healthcare professionals, or scientific organizations preferred.
  
  
Understanding of Clinical Outcome Assessments (COAs), patient-centered outcomes research, healthcare data, or related scientific content highly desirable.
  
  
IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com
  
  
IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

:

  **evaluate program effectiveness using feedback, data, and impact metrics**
  and recommend enhancements to improve learner outcomes and business ROI.

This entry-level role focuses on learning and development while assisting with post-award activities, such as creating or reviewing bill of materials, drawings, infrastructure requirements, network coordination, and preparing installation and commissioning documentation. Additionally, you will perform system testing and troubleshooting under supervision.
  
  
You will work closely with the project team to ensure tasks are completed accurately and efficiently. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented, flexible individual eager to build technical skills and gain hands-on experience in the AV field. Supervision from more-senior engineers and mentorship opportunities will guide your professional growth.
  
  
**Who We Are**
AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.
  
  
Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. We believe that success starts with a sound team and that an inclusive and diverse workplace moves us all forward.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As an Associate Project Engineer, you will contribute to the successful execution of AV integration projects by supporting your senior engineers and project managers. This entry-level role focuses on learning and development while assisting with post-award activities, such as creating or reviewing bill of materials, drawings, infrastructure requirements, network coordination, and preparing installation and commissioning documentation. Additionally, you will perform system testing and troubleshooting under supervision.
  
  
You will work closely with the project team to ensure tasks are completed accurately and efficiently. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented, flexible individual eager to build technical skills and gain hands-on experience in the AV field. Supervision from more-senior engineers and mentorship opportunities will guide your professional growth.
  
  
**Day-To-Day Responsibilities**

* Design and Documentation Support
* Assist in reviewing preliminary project design documents, such as Scope of Work (SOW) and contracts, to validate completeness and feasibility.
* Serve as a go-to peer review resource for engineers by ensuring accuracy and clarity in drawings and change orders.
* Help create and update engineering project documents, including infrastructure drawings, equipment placement diagrams, and riser diagrams, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Generate cable pull sheets and assist with calculations, such as heat and power requirements.
* Project and Change Order Assistance
* Assist fellow engineers with large change order work by preparing and updating necessary design and documentation.
* Help assemble technical closeout documentation, including "as-built" drawings and programming files.
* Field Support and Flexibility
* Act as a backup to support the primary Project Engineer on large projects as needed.
* Collaborate with the commissioning and programming team to create deployment andcommissioning guides.
* Travel to job sites as needed to support the installation team and gain hands-on field experience.
* Perform additional tasks, responsibilities, and projects as needed to support the team and organization, ensuring flexibility in adapting to evolving priorities and objectives.
* Items to Consider:
* AVI-SPL reserves the right to alter work hours and work location as necessary. Work hours may vary based on client requirements and may include travel to various locations in support of the account.
* This position will generally work on customer sites and may deal with a construction site type of work environment.

**Must-Haves**
**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* A proactive approach to self-learning and improvement, with a willingness to take on new challenges.
* Flexibility to adapt to shifting priorities and support multiple projects effectively.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Basic familiarity with AV systems, IT networking, or related technologies.
* Effective communication skills for collaborating with teammates and supervisors.
* Valid driver’s license and a motor vehicle record that meets company standards.
* Employees operating company or personal vehicles for business purposes must be legally authorized to drive, maintain a valid driver’s license and provide proof of coverage, meeting all minimum required insurance coverage as a condition of employment.
* Employees driving fleet vehicles must meet eligibility requirements; comply with all guidelines, including telematics monitoring, vehicle maintenance schedules, proper use of assigned fuel and toll devices.

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Formal education in Electronics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* AV integration experience, especially field installation or service, is a plus but not required.
* Familiarity with industry standards such as AVIXA (CTS certification) or networking concepts.
* Experience with DSP or control system programming tools is a plus.
* Previous experience in a technical support or field-related role is a plus but not required.
* Proficiency with basic design tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Bluebeam Revu) and willingness to learn more advanced tools.

**WHY YOU’LL LIKE WORKING HERE**

* Medical benefits, including vision and dental
* Paid holidays and PTO
* Enjoyable and dynamic company culture
* Training and professional development opportunities

**More About Us**
AVI-SPL is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability status, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state, or local law. AVI-SPL is an AA/Disabled/Veteran Protected Employer VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

title: Senior Analyst, Practice Operations
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

 

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**Job Summary**

Bain’s Airlines, Logistics and Transport (ALT) sector is part of the Advanced Manufacturing & Services (AMS) Practice. The Operations Senior Analyst role sits at the intersection of client relationship management, knowledge management, and AI enablement. You will help sector leadership and account teams improve client engagement, strengthen commercial execution, and scale best practices and IP — and you will build and maintain a growing library of AI-powered tools, skills, and automations that case teams can pull off the shelf. Working closely with partners, knowledge management, and product teams globally, your mandate is to take routine analytical and administrative work off case teams’ plates so they can focus on higher-value activities.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

**Client and Account Support**

* Support the smooth operation of Bain’s CRM tool (“Cortex” on a Salesforce platform) for approximately 30 key accounts, ensuring data integrity and consistent usage.
* Monitor client engagement patterns and surface signals that indicate opportunities for timely partner outreach.

* Build and maintain recurring dashboards and reports (e.g., account status, activity, pipeline signals) to help client heads proactively manage relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Design and maintain a centralized repository (on Bain approved platforms) for pitch materials, proposals, case examples, and templates; ensure content is searchable, appropriately tagged, and version-controlled for reuse.
* Partner with Knowledge Management to develop microsites using established frameworks, improving speed and consistency of content access for teams.
* Partner with other sector/practice PPK teams to cross-pollinate IP.
* Contribute to sector IP development by participating in the creation of new IP as opportunities arise.
* Support IP deployment and commercialization by assisting the Regional Sector Leaders with go-to-market planning (timing, channels, and enablement materials).
* Maintain and update sector affiliate and expert lists (in coordination with relevant internal teams) to improve access to expertise when needed.

**AI Enablement**

* Build and maintain a practice-level repository of reusable AI assets — including Claude skills (SKILL.md files), artifacts, prompts, and agent configurations — that case teams can pull off the shelf to accelerate recurring analytical and content tasks. Own the taxonomy, documentation, access, and version control of these assets, and drive adoption through onboarding materials and light coaching of case teams.
* Develop purpose-built AI tools that turn sector data sources into fast, case-ready outputs — for example, skills that analyze Cirium Diio schedule data or IATA MarketIS booking data to produce quick market sizing, competitive dynamics, route economics, or network-change analyses on demand for case teams.
* Set up and maintain recurring AI-driven insight generation pipelines that combine licensed data subscriptions (e.g., Cirium Diio, IATA MarketIS) with public and scraped sources to produce regular sector pulses, trend updates, and proprietary points of view the practice can push to partners and clients.
* Identify routine, repetitive tasks across the practice — administrative, reporting, research, or data-prep — and design AI automations, freeing up time for client-facing and judgment-heavy work. Deploy automations responsibly with appropriate confidentiality, data handling, and access controls.
* Catalogue and maintain the sector’s library of hosted proof-of-concept apps built for proposals and pitches — capturing what each app does, the client and proposal context it was built for, where it is hosted, its current status, and the internal owner — so the practice can quickly surface, demo, or repurpose prior POCs in new pitch situations. Coordinate with partners and product teams to retire stale apps and promote proven ones into reusable assets.

  

**Qualifications**

Required

* 2-5 years of professional experience, ideally in professional services, consulting, technology, or data-driven roles.
* Quantitative undergraduate degree (or equivalent analytical training).
* Hands-on familiarity with Claude and/or other leading GenAI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot). Comfortable designing effective prompts, applying LLMs to real work tasks such as document synthesis, content drafting, and data extraction, and critically evaluating outputs to improve quality. Genuine interest in going beyond day-to-day usage to author and share reusable AI assets — prompts, custom GPTs, Claude skills, and artifacts — that other people can pick up and run with.
* Light analytics and data skills, including advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, dynamic arrays, chart-building) and basic SQL or Python for querying, cleaning, and transforming data. Comfortable structuring datasets, performing exploratory analysis, and producing clear, insight-driven outputs for non-technical audiences.
* Ability to drive work end-to-end with limited direction; strong organization and attention to detail.
* Effective stakeholder management skills, including the ability to steer small working meetings and contribute thoughtfully with senior stakeholders.

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboarding, including building custom reports, configuring dashboards for different user personas, and working with report types and filters. Strong CRM and data-quality habits — including ownership of data hygiene routines, deduplication, consistent taxonomy and tagging, and proactive identification of gaps or inconsistencies that could affect downstream reporting.
* Experience with knowledge management tools such as SharePoint, Google Drive, or Confluence, including setting up structured content libraries, applying metadata and tagging schemas to aid discoverability, and managing access and permissions across user groups. Familiarity with basic content governance and versioning practices — including lifecycle management (draft, approved, archived), naming conventions, and periodic content review cycles to ensure materials remain current and reusable.
* Automation experience using tools such as Power Automate, Zapier, or n8n, Salesforce flows and process builders, or light scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Apps Script) to connect systems and streamline repetitive tasks. A track record of shipping reusable AI assets that others have adopted is a strong plus, as is experience identifying high-friction processes and replacing them with automated solutions that demonstrably freed up time.

description:
Job Type
  
  
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About Birdeye**
Birdeye is the leading agentic marketing platform for multi-location brands.
  
  
Companies like H&R Block, Aspen Dental, and Caesars Entertainment use Birdeye to manage marketing across thousands of locations — from how they get found, to how they convert, to how they retain customers. Our platform replaces disconnected point tools with AI agents that execute work at the location level — responding to reviews, updating listings, publishing content, and driving conversions.
  
  
Backed by Marc Benioff, Jerry Yang, and Accel-KKR, Birdeye was named to G2’s 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list — appearing alongside the world’s leading AI companies. We’re expanding rapidly into enterprise, with growing adoption across large, multi-location brands.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Come thrive at Birdeye and help build the future of Experience Marketing. As a BDR Enablement Manager, you will be the primary owner of enablement for Birdeye's global BDR India organization. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What will set you apart?**

title: Project Associate - High Potential Students
description:
**Central Square Foundation**
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non-profit philanthropic organization working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. The development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills by Class 3 can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable, and effective so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life.
  
  
Read more about our work here: www.centralsquarefoundation.org
  
  
**About High Potential Students Workstream At CSF**
India’s school education system serves ~25 crore children. Many of these students come from underserved communities and face systemic gaps in identification and support. With most interventions beginning only after Grade 10, much of this potential remains untapped and underdeveloped.
  
  
To bridge this gap, CSF introduced a new workstream in 2025, High Potential Students (HPS), to support India’s bright young minds from underprivileged backgrounds in becoming future innovators, researchers and leaders. By 2030, we aim to transform the learning journeys of 1 lakh students by equipping them with the skills, support and exposure needed to thrive in higher education and high-growth careers. Through this work, we are committed to advancing equity and excellence, empowering young minds from every corner of India to realise their full potential.
  
  
CSF is working with government model school systems to strengthen pathways for high-potential students (HPS) from underserved communities. The work focuses on designing and implementing initiatives within government model schools to support students’ academic, socio-emotional, and career development. Key areas include programme planning and implementation, partner and government coordination, field engagement, documentation, and evidence generation. The work also supports effective classroom practices, academic enrichment, structured advanced learning opportunities, career pathways, and overall student progression.
  
  
**Position Summary**
CSF is seeking a Project Associate to join the High Potential Students workstream in Delhi and support the planning and implementation of HPS programme. The Project Associate will be responsible for supporting assigned programme priorities, managing day-to-day implementation, maintaining trackers and documentation, supporting review and reporting processes, conducting field visits, analysing implementation data, and identifying risks that require course correction. The role requires strong project management skills, comfort with data, clear written communication, field orientation, and the ability to work in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  
  
**The Core Areas Of Contribution Are**
**Programme Implementation and Coordination**

* Support the execution of key programme priorities under the High Potential Students workstream, especially across model schools.
* Build and manage working relationships with diverse stakeholders, including regional government teams, school leaders, programme partners, educational nonprofits, vendors and internal CSF teams.
* Coordinate with implementation partners to monitor and review programs across EdTech, assessments, academic enrichment, and career pathways, ensuring effective progress tracking, timely identification of gaps, and appropriate follow-through on action items.
* Support stakeholder convenings, partner check-ins, review meetings and government updates by collating data, preparing materials, documenting discussions and tracking next steps.

**Project Management, Reviews and Reporting**

* Maintain programme trackers, timelines, meeting notes, action-item logs, data templates and other tools required for day-to-day monitoring and review.
* Manage timelines and deliverables for assigned workstreams to ensure that activities are on track and aligned with project objectives.
* Prepare clear written outputs, including field visit notes, meeting minutes, update emails, review notes, progress summaries, presentations, reports and internal briefing documents.
* Provide timely updates to internal teams and CSF leadership on implementation progress, key insights, risks, opportunities and areas for course correction.

**Data, Field Insights and Documentation**

* Support rigorous data cleaning, validation and analysis to identify trends, implementation gaps, inconsistencies and areas requiring follow-up or course correction, while also supporting the development and maintenance of dashboards, trackers and other data platforms for programme monitoring and review.
* Conduct targeted field visits to schools and institutions to gather operational and academic insights, understand implementation realities and document observations.
* Document key learnings, field insights, implementation challenges and emerging practices to inform reviews, reporting, programme improvement and future scale-up.

**Problem Solving and Agile Support**

* Identify, assess and escalate implementation risks and bottlenecks in partner delivery, school-level execution, data availability or communication, while supporting proactive issue resolution.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth project delivery, timely communication of progress and follow-through on agreed priorities.
* Support emerging priorities and time-sensitive tasks that may arise from government stakeholders, programme partners or internal teams, with the ability to respond quickly, organise next steps and drive closure in a dynamic work environment.

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities**
We are looking for a young professional who brings:
  
  

* 0 to 2 years of post-qualification work experience for the Project Associate role, preferably in the education sector, development sector, programme management, EdTech implementation, assessments, school-system reform, or government-facing projects.
* Strong project management skills or demonstrated ability to manage timelines, trackers, follow-ups, action items and multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good writing and oral communication skills, with proficiency and fluency in English and Hindi.
* Good project delivery skills, including the ability to coordinate with partners, schools, government teams and internal colleagues to drive execution and ensure closure on deliverables.
* Ability to work with student-level, school-level, assessment, platform usage or programme monitoring data to derive implementation insights and support reviews.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills, including the ability to prepare meeting notes, progress updates, field visit reports, review materials and concise internal briefs.
* Strong growth and learning mindset, with attention to detail, ownership of assigned tasks, problem-solving orientation, agility to take up emerging priorities, and willingness to travel across implementation schools within/outside of Delhi NCR.

* Contribute to and support internal and external communications to disseminate project results and research findings to both PxD and government audiences, including briefs, blogs, reports, and presentations
* Contribute to PxD's institutional knowledge management and internal learning efforts

**What You’ll Bring**

* Master's degree or PhD in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, or a closely related field
* Professional experience working on at least three large projects involving the design and management of rigorous research and/or evidence-based programs in LMIC countries, ideally including government or public-sector settings
* Ability to draw inferences from data to identify pathways for program improvement
* Adept at consuming large amounts of academic and scientific literature as well as other technical information, synthesizing key findings, and applying takeaways to program and research design
* Deep understanding of economics and randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata or R or similar software for data analysis
* Experience in survey design using SurveyCTO/ODK or similar tools
* Strong grasp of the research & program life cycle and ability to supervise all activities on the ground, including within government systems and processes
* Experience managing program and/or research staff
* Experience managing partnerships with an implementing organization or government agency
* Comfort operating within government bureaucratic structures, protocols, and decision-making processes
* Understanding and application of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Strong writing and oral communication skills in English, with attention to detail and advanced writing and presentation skills
* Willingness to travel to field sites in India, including government offices and field locations

**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.  Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.
  
  
Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
  
  
Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
  
  
The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications.  The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting & regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1) understanding the Change, (2) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams & Users until implementation of the Change.  It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements.  The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements.  This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc.  Collaborate with the Users & procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in-house GRIFFIN & AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology & Testing Teams where relevant.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
  
  
Certifications If Any - AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
  
  
**Experience Range\***
5 to 8 years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced, every-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)

**Desired Skills**

* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day-to-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge & ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)

**Work Timings\***
11:30 am to 8:30 pm
  
  
**Job Location\***
Gurugram/Mumbai

title: AI-Native Founder’s Office Intern
description:
Focus: Strategy | Product | Investments | Growth | Automation

Location: Gurgaon, in-office

Duration: 3–6 months, preference for 6-month commitment

Stipend: ₹10,000/month

Eligibility: Final-year students only

Opportunity: Potential full-time role after graduation

We are looking for an AI-native, high-agency generalist to work directly with the Founder across technology, product, investments, strategy and growth.

This is not a conventional internship with a fixed daily task list. You could be researching an investment opportunity in the morning, building an AI workflow in the afternoon and helping put together a product or GTM idea by evening.

What you will work on

• Use AI tools extensively for research, analysis, automation and execution

• Research startups, founders, sectors, technologies and investment opportunities

• Identify and continuously build a pipeline of relevant investment and deal leads

• Maintain trackers for companies, founders, investors, conversations and follow-ups

• Prepare quick company analyses, investment notes, market maps and competitive research

• Understand basic business models, financials, valuations and investment-banking concepts

• Research potential investors, strategic partners, customers and acquisition opportunities

• Support product thinking — features, user journeys, competitive products and new ideas

• Build quick websites, landing pages, prototypes and internal tools using AI/no-code tools

• Work comfortably with data, spreadsheets, dashboards and large amounts of information

• Experiment with AI agents and automation to eliminate repetitive Founder’s Office work

• Help with pre-sales — company research, meeting preparation, proposals and follow-ups

• Create presentations, briefs, website content and decision notes when required

• Track important developments across AI, startups, investments and technology

• Take unstructured information and convert it into something the Founder can make a decision on

Who should apply

You are a final-year student based in Gurgaon/Delhi NCR and can work from Gurgaon.

You should be genuinely AI-native. ChatGPT/Claude should feel like an everyday working environment, not something you occasionally use to write an email.

You don’t necessarily need to be a hardcore coder, but you should be technically comfortable enough to figure out how to build, automate or prototype something using AI tools.

You should have a genuine interest in at least a few of these areas: AI, product, startups, venture capital, investment banking, strategy or technology.

You should be good at research, but more importantly, know how to zero down from 100 pieces of information to the five that actually matter.

You should be comfortable jumping between technology and business. One problem may require understanding APIs and AI tools; another may require looking at a company’s financials or finding the right investor.

We value curiosity, speed and resourcefulness over perfect credentials.

If you don’t know something, your instinct should be to figure it out using AI, research, people and tools rather than waiting for someone to explain it.

Commitment

This is a 3–6 month in-office internship, with a strong preference for candidates who can commit for 6 months.

We are specifically looking at final-year students because the objective is to identify exceptional people who can potentially transition into a full-time Founder’s Office role after graduation.

* Please do not apply if you are looking for a remote internship, only a certificate, or a conventional internship with narrowly defined responsibilities.

description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Product Consultant, you act as the critical bridge between global frontline support [across PTGSB segments], Product Engineering, and Center of Excellence (CoE). You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.
  
  
In addition to consults from the frontline support, the Technical Product Consultant will also handle escalations from the Sales team to resolve high priority tickets. You will also support new product launches (Closed and Open Beta) from resolving technical issues for clients, creating new content for launches, and capturing and disseminating knowledge gained on new features to the broader team across GOC and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
****Position Responsibilities**
**:****

* You are responsible for resolving the most critical technical consults, architecting the knowledge management framework for new product launches (Beta), and upskilling GOC and partner teams to ensure high-quality support. You don't just solve problems; you perform root-cause analysis to implement long-term fixes that improve the product for everyone.
* Advanced Technical Resolution: Act as the final point of escalation for the most critical and complex technical consults, ensuring end-to-end ownership and resolution for Google customers.

You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.
  
  
In addition to consults from the frontline support, the Technical Product Consultant will also handle escalations from the Sales team to resolve high priority tickets. You will also support new product launches (Closed and Open Beta) from resolving technical issues for clients, creating new content for launches, and capturing and disseminating knowledge gained on new features to the broader team across GOC and partners.

****Position Responsibilities**
**:****

title: Executive Presentations Lead
description:
**Overview**
Inovalon is looking for an Executive Communications Lead (Principal Creative Services Manager) who can translate complex business narratives into presentations that survive Board scrutiny. You will own the strategy, design, and execution of CEO-facing and Board material like investor decks, strategic initiatives, M&A narratives, and quarterly business reviews. This role is not about PowerPoint mechanics. It is about understanding how executives think, what moves their conviction, and what will withstand cross-examination in the boardroom. This role reports to the Head of Business Performance (ELT member) and is a standalone individual contributor.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and execution of Board materials, investor presentations, and executive strategic communications. This includes intake conversations with C-level stakeholders, narrative development, design iteration, and stakeholder management through final delivery.
* Develop airtight business cases and strategic narratives. Interrogate assumptions, pressure-test logic, identify weak spots, and restructure arguments before executives walk into the room. You will serve as the internal challenge partner, not just a designer.
* Design for stakeholder scrutiny. Anticipate questions, build defensive depth into decks, and ensure every slide can stand alone under cross-examination. Know how investors, Board members, and PE sponsors think.
* Lead the visual and narrative architecture of presentations. You will define the story spine, establish visual logic, and ensure consistency across executive materials—from 3-slide executive summaries to full 40-slide investor roadshow decks.
* Manage stakeholder feedback cycles. Synthesize input from multiple executives, prioritize conflicting perspectives, and drive toward decision without losing narrative coherence. You are the keeper of the story.
* Establish presentation standards and playbooks for business. Over time, you will document best practices, create templates, and mentor other leaders on how to think like an executive communicator.

**Experience & Background**

* 7–10 years of professional experience in high-stakes, scrutiny-driven environments where presentations move decisions
* Previous experience in one or more of the following environments: management consulting visual/strategy teams (McKinsey VGS, BCG Design Studios, Bain specialist practices); investment banking pitchbook or M&A execution (bulge bracket or elite boutique); Big Four deal advisory presentation teams; or an internal CEO/executive communications function at a large enterprise. Candidates from VC/PE investor relations backgrounds with demonstrated board-level narrative experience will also be considered.
* Production level proficiency with:

+ Presentation design software: PowerPoint (advanced), Keynote, or equivalent presentation platforms
+ Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop): nice to have; not a requirement for candidates from consulting or banking backgrounds
+ Design and prototyping tools (Figma, Sketch): advantageous but not required; the emphasis is on narrative architecture and executive-grade output, not design-system tooling
+ Ability to create clear, decision-driving charts and infographics; advanced Excel charting is the baseline expectation.

* Stakeholder psychology: understanding what moves a C-suite, what triggers investor confidence or skepticism, and how Board members evaluate risk. Ability to anticipate objections before they arrive.
* Executive presence & credibility: ability to challenge assumptions respectfully and own the outcome of your work.
* Visual thinking & design discipline: understanding that visual hierarchy and design choices are arguments, not decoration.
* Bias toward clarity over polish: ability to prioritize comprehension and decision-driving over aesthetic excess.
* Operating under pressure: ability to manage ambiguity, evolving briefs, and tight turnarounds without compromising quality.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*
*Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.*

title: Specification Data Technician
description:
**TMS Global**
is a wholly owned subsidiary of
**DS Smith PLC**
, a leading multinational packaging and display manufacturing business. TMS Global specialises in outsourcing retail display, print and packaging solutions and operates across 97 markets worldwide.

Our global community consists of more than 300 colleagues working across APAC, LATAM, EMEA and North America, collaborating to deliver innovative solutions for some of the world's leading brands.

**About the role**

TMS Global is seeking a
**Specification Data Technician**
to join our Shared Services Centre on a
**12-month fixed-term contract**
. Working on a
**hybrid**
basis and supporting European business hours, you will play a key role in managing product specifications and Point of Sale (POS) data across multiple materials and product categories.

**We would welcome applications from graduates who have gained practical experience using CAD software and Adobe Creative Suite through their studies, placements, internships or previous employment.**

The role focuses on maintaining accurate specification databases, supporting data collection activities, creating and reviewing 2D and 3D CAD drawings, and ensuring technical documentation is completed accurately and on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collect, maintain and update specification and POS data from customers, suppliers and internal development teams.
* Create, update and validate 2D and 3D CAD drawings and keylines, ensuring accuracy and compliance with customer and supplier requirements.
* Provide technical data support to procurement and wider business stakeholders.
* Monitor and maintain KPIs related to specification and POS data accuracy and delivery timelines.
* Support the ongoing maintenance and improvement of specification databases and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure data integrity and process efficiency.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* Fluency in written and spoken English. Additional language skills relevant to the supported region would be advantageous.
* Experience using CAD software, ideally Artios CAD or a similar package, with the ability to create and interpret 2D and 3D retail display specifications and keylines.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite or similar designing software and Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills and a methodical approach to data management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, resolve data discrepancies and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience within retail, print, packaging or display manufacturing environments would be advantageous.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively within a global team.

As a Specification Data Technician, you will bring technical expertise, a collaborative mindset and a commitment to accuracy, helping to ensure the successful delivery of projects for our clients across multiple markets.

This role may also suit candidates with experience as a CAD Technician, Packaging Technician, Packaging Designer, Structural Designer, Artwork Technician, POS Designer or Specification Technologist.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive and international team, further develop your CAD and technical data management skills, and contribute to projects for some of the world's most recognised brands across multiple global markets.

**Apply today and become part of the TMS Global team.**

*“To achieve our aim of being among the most successful, sustainable and responsible companies in the world, we aim to build a diverse, motivated, and engaged workforce. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion where everyone is treated fairly, differences are valued, and everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed.*

*Our people come from diverse backgrounds, bring different perspectives, ideas and experiences to generate unique solutions focused on present and future sustainability challenges. We welcome all candidates to apply, even those not meeting all criteria.”*

title: Sr Product Management Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented product marketing professional with a strong blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and execution excellence. The ideal candidate will be capable of working with cross-functional teams, influencing stakeholders, and driving profitable business growth through effective planning and execution.
  
  
Candidates should have significant experience in the CCTV industry, with a strong understanding of customer requirements and video surveillance technologies. The role requires the ability to translate customer insights into product concepts, technical requirements, and commercial solutions. The successful candidate will own the entire product lifecycle—from customer discovery and innovation through prototyping, productization, and business scaling.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
New Product Development
  
  
Define & own the Product and Technology roadmap for the portfolio. Have a strong sales & customer connect to analyse customer problems, market needs and technology trends to create on-time, on-cost differentiated offerings that earn significant ROI for the business.
  
  
Understand the different needs of target segments and ensure that the portfolio, channel and competency is aligned to win in the market
  
  
Carry out Make vs Buy decisions for NPI development. Liaison with Engineering, Sourcing, QA teams to execute NPIs. Meet 100% say/do ratio on all NPIs. Align with Regional & Global counterparts for cross-learning and roadmap alignment.
  
  
Integrate inputs to develop distinctive product plans with outstanding financial outcomes; be competent in VOC, research and analysis and basic marketing toolkit [market definition and sizing, segmentation, value management, targeting and positioning, pricing].
  
  
Product Portfolio Management
  
  
Regular Voice of Sales and Voice of Customer survey to understand the Product Gaps and execute action plan to address the gaps
  
  
2
  
  
Ensure correct Pricing and Positioning for all the products in the portfolio, with timely revisions as per the market demand
  
  
Manage Gross Margins for the portfolio by putting the right pricing strategies in place
  
  
Effectively manage the product launches and phase-outs. This would also include adherence to a detailed Product launch plan and effective launch communication
  
  
End to end brand ownership and product lifecycle management (product phase-in/out, etc). Ensure portfolio is always relevant to the market with optimal brand mix to ensure all target segments are served profitably with minimal conflict and cannibalization.
  
  
Product Competency Building
  
  
Drive Product knowledge & Value based sales competency among internal teams (Sales, Marketing & Product Support) and channels (System Integrators, Distributers) through regular, structured trainings
  
  
Support Sales team in effectively communicating the value proposition of the portfolio to external ecosystem including System Integrators, Distributers, Consultants and End Users
  
  
Keep the team updated on solution offerings and arm them with specification points, differentiators, USPs, comparisons, selectors & other sales tools
  
  
Marketing Communications
  
  
Engage with Marcom team for all new product launches w.r.t. branding, launch plan, events, collaterals, etc to ensure effective communication internally and externally
  
  
Coordination with Marcom and Partner Connect team to ensure timely update of Website and ePortals
  
  
Competition Mapping
  
  
Develop strong market network to gather market intelligence and update competition activities on regular basis. Use this knowledge to create means to effectively compete and continuously upgrade the portfolio
  
  
Track competition pricing to understand Market Operating prices of products and align our pricing with market on regular basis
  
  
Personality
  
  
Hands on: Ability to work with cross-functional teams, spread across different cities and backgrounds. Get into the deepest detail and just get the job done
  
  
Ownership mindset: Takes personal ownership of the tasks and pro-actively connects with anyone required to get it done. Never say “its not my job”. Ability to work in chaotic, unstructured environment, often with limited information available.
  
  
Result-Oriented: A driver who possesses the ability to take actions and implement effective solutions in a timely manner
  
  
3
  
  
Leadership: A confident, mature person with the ability to connect with others
  
  
Ethics: Highest level of professional integrity and honesty as well as personal credibility.
  
  
Problem Solver: A creative yet pragmatic problem solver. Methodical and hands-on as well as detail-oriented. Should be able to structure a problem irrespective of domain.
  
  
Analytical Thinking and Decision-Making: A strong understanding of market trends/issues who can then integrate that thinking into marketing and business strategies. Decisive and logical at thoroughly evaluating issues. Excellent planning, execution and project-management skills.
  
  
Teamwork and Interpersonal Skills: A team player, receptive to ideas from others. Shares information and keeps team members and partners informed. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and manage conflict with the team. Builds strong trust based relationship with peers and customers.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Education: Graduate in technical field (Engineering/Science/Computers)
  
  

* Experience: 8+ years of Product Management, sales & marketing experience in a B2B company or relevant start-ups and involved in new product development, portfolio management and value pricing of products
* Industry: Experience in CCTV, Video Analytics, Electronic Security mandatory. Experience in Fire Detection, Access Control, HVAC, Building Automation industry is preferred but not mandatory. Customer facing experience in Technology/Solutions businesses is highly preferred.

Results driven track record – proven ability to translate strategies into action and results
  
  
Start-up / Entrepreneurial experience welcome – should have created a business or product line from scratch
  
  
Excellent written, oral, and technical communication skills, including presentation experience to large and diverse audience.
  
  
Possess strong working knowledge
  
  
**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: ServiceNow ITSM Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
To support the Service Automation team within Siemens Energy's Digital Core, this role is established to backfill capacity and address the increased workload from expanded responsibilities and upcoming strategic Energy Now initiatives. Operating at the Experienced Professional (P2) level in India, the consultant will ensure operational stability, service excellence, and successful execution across key service areas. To address these business aims, the role focuses on ServiceNow ITSM solution design, platform configuration, and stakeholder collaboration. These core areas ensure alignment between business processes and technical implementations while driving out-of-the-box (OOTB) adoption and minimizing platform customizations.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* ServiceNow Solution Design & Implementation

+ Design and deliver scalable, upgrade-safe solutions across ServiceNow ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management) leveraging out-of-the-box (OOTB) capabilities.
+ Configure core platform architecture, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, custom scripting, and third-party tool integrations (e.g., Snowflake, Jira, Salesforce).
+ Implement and manage technical integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and Import Sets, ensuring alignment with platform security models and ACLs.
+ Promote OOTB adoption, minimize unnecessary customizations, and leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities to deliver efficient solutions.

* Functional Consulting & Stakeholder Management

+ Conduct discovery workshops and sessions with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into functional specifications.
+ Prepare comprehensive design documents and define acceptance criteria to guide technical teams and review final solution designs.
+ Provide strategic recommendations on ServiceNow best practices, process optimization, and alignment with CMDB, CSDM, and SPM modules.

* Project Delivery & Operational Support

+ Collaborate within Agile/Scrum and SAFe delivery environments to support the execution of strategic EnergyNow projects and initiatives.
+ Perform acceptance testing, validate solutions against requirements, and coordinate deployment activities with delivery partners to ensure operational stability.

**What You Bring**

* 6 to 8 years of professional experience in ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno-functional consulting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM).
* ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno-functional consulting experience.
* ServiceNow Core Architecture & Administration.
* Flow Designer & IntegrationHub Configuration.
* ServiceNow Scripting & Customization Best Practices.
* Integration Technologies (REST, SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets).
* IT Service Management (ITSM) Process Design.
* Common Service Data Model (CSDM) & CMDB.
* Requirement Gathering & Business Systems Analysis.
* Solution Architecture & Design Documentation.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Communication.
* Agile/Scrum & SAFe Methodologies.
* Analytical Problem-Solving.

**About The Team**
Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards / Benefits**

* Opportunities to work with a distributed, global team.

title: LBSIM - (Knowledge Associate - PPK) - Batch of 2027
description:
**Bain & Company**

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 67 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

  

**Bain Capability Network**
Bain Capability Network was established in 2004 in New Delhi, and now has nodes in India, Warsaw and Mexico. We are an expert client delivery (ECD) team at Bain & Company that collaborates closely with global leadership and clients, offering expertise across various industries and capabilities. We offer three delivery model archetypes – off-shore, on-site and hybrid for seamless integration with case teams and practice areas. From developing Intellectual Property to delivering end-client solutions, we house dedicated teams across all industries including Consumer Products, Retail, FS, Healthcare, etc., and specialize in core capabilities such as Private Equity, Pricing, Corporate Finance and Strategy, Data and Insights, etc.

  

**Who you’ll work with**

  

\*You’ll join the Product, Practice and Knowledge (PPK) department as part of the Knowledge Management team that support a range of industry and capability practice areas. 

  

\*The global PPK group is a key function, which helps to identify, create, and leverage “best of Bain” content, expertise, and also helps Bain practice areas develop commercial strategies.  

  

\*The Knowledge Management team is critical to harnessing the best of our consulting staffs’ individual and collective expertise, making it possible for us to deliver extraordinary results for our clients. 

  

**What you’ll do**

Associate, Knowledge Management support global knowledge management within an industry or capability Practice by:

  

\*Managing and preparing content contributions to the global knowledge base

  

\*Removing confidential information from client engagement materials and standardizing those as per Bain standards (sanitizing & disguising) 

  

\*Writing abstracts and tagging materials to ensure Bain case teams can find the right content easily within Bain’s internal knowledge base

  

\*Posting content on Bain’s internal knowledge base so that the materials can be leveraged by global teams working on similar topics

  

\*Ensuring case teams follow compliance guidelines when submitting case summaries, proposals etc.

  

\*Overseeing the sanitizing & disguising efforts performed by the Junior Knowledge Associate team for the practice, coaching on practice-specific requirements and ensuring quality requirements are met  

  

\*Managing the quality of content by identifying duplicative content, storylining content and archiving lower usage content from the knowledge base

  

\*Supporting the creation and periodic refresh of select practice content, credentials, and the Practice area pages overall

  

\*Supporting Senior Knowledge Specialists with answering straightforward requests and knowledge capture tasks like taking and uploading notes from calls with consulting teams

  

\*Perform practice analytics using tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Excel, and AI-enabled tools to provide insights for KM / Practice operational activities

  

\*Supporting Senior Knowledge Specialists to create and distribute regular newsletters to Practice affiliates on latest cases, proposals, practice knowledge and IP developments 

  

\*Maintaining Practice trackers, databases and affiliate lists/profiles

  
  
Please note: This role is only open for 2027 LBISM PG pass-outs.

description:
