Medical Writer II (MLR Reviewer)
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  
  
Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

* Mentors less experienced medical writers on projects, as necessary.
* Performs E2E process related scientific writing that includes but not limited to manage workflow in PubConnect, create publication plan, author approvals, pre-submission queries, submission activities etc.
* Veeva Vault document management - Creates placeholders, upload versions, reference linking, anchoring and linking, monitors the workflows/task completion.
* Reviews documents intended for Veeva submission and ensures they are fully MLR‑ready by proactively identifying and highlighting content changes needed per standards and guidelines, verifying claims against referenced sources, and streamlining the MLR review process to support first‑round approval.
* Compiles, writes, and edits medical writing deliverables, and serves as a medical writer within and across departments with minimal supervision.
* Develops or supports a variety of documents that include but not limited to:
* Clinical journal manuscripts, clinical journal abstracts, posters, and oral presentations.
* Reviews statistical analysis plans and table/figure/listing specifications for appropriate content, and for grammar, format, and consistency.
* Interacts with department head and staff members in data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs as necessary to produce writing deliverables.
* Serves as peer reviewer on internal review team. Addresses team comments accurately to ensure document scientific content, clarity, overall consistency, and proper format.
* Adheres to established regulatory standards, including but not limited to congress/journal guidelines, as well as Company Standard Operating Procedures, client standards, and Company and/or client approved templates when completing medical writing projects, on-time and on-budget.

Performs on-line clinical literature searches, as applicable
  
  

* Familiarity with publication planning software e.g. Datavision and PubConnect (VeevaVault PromoMats or Medcomms).
* Continues professional development to keep pace with regulatory guidance and client expectations in medical writing that affect medical writing.
* Stays aware of budget specifications for assigned projects, working within the budgeted hours and communicating changes to medical writing leadership.
* Completes required administrated tasks within the specified timeframes.
* Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
* Minimal travel may be required (less than 25%).

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com

Serves as medical writer on clinical study or regulatory or publication project teams. Assists in writing, editing, and coordinating content for clinical/regulatory/scientific documents with dependent staff roles to ensure satisfactory completion of all writing projects.

Researching and content exploring skills to collect and maintain all the good quality, free to use content sources available for State Board curriculums/ NCERT/ Any other Board
  
  
Possess good grip on Google suite as this work will majorly happen in Excel and Word Files, one needs to be very comfortable operating these with attention to minute details.
  
  
Be adept with developing assessments as and when required
  
  

* Key Responsibilities & Deliverables
* To assist Team Leads in regularly tracking and monitoring updates, revisions, and changes in Maths curriculum across different State Boards.
* To develop a strong understanding of Maths syllabus and State Board curriculum, including subjects, courses, grade-wise learning requirements, and content expectations.
* To support the identification, collection, and maintenance of high-quality, credible, and free-to-use Maths content and OER (Open Educational Resources) from reliable sources.
* To regularly monitor Government, partner, and other credible educational sources for updates, new resources, and changes relevant to Maths content.
* To develop a thorough understanding of the existing Maths content library across different State Boards, grade levels, and regional language requirements.
* To verify and review the sources used for Maths content to ensure that they are credible, relevant, appropriate, and aligned with the required curriculum.
* To identify alignment gaps, inaccuracies, and content errors and support the team in resolving them effectively.
* To review, improve, and polish curriculum alignment and the OER added to ensure accuracy, relevance, and quality.
* To regularly update, add, replace, or revise Maths content in the State Board master sheets based on curriculum changes and identified requirements.
* To review and finalize corrected and aligned Maths content, ensuring that it is accurate, complete, and ready for delivery across all platforms.
* To work effectively in a fast-paced and continuously evolving environment, respond to changes promptly, and provide timely feedback on deliverables to ensure issues are resolved within defined timelines.
* To collaborate closely with Team Leads and other members of the iDream Education team to ensure the development and delivery of high-quality Maths content, products, and solutions for learners and users.

**Education:**
Masters or Bachelors degree in Maths
  
  
**Experience:**
3-5 years of experience in education domain (teaching experience with product use case/edtech domain)
  
  

* Key Skills & Competencies
* Strong knowledge of Maths as a subject and understanding of concepts involved, for classes K-12 of CBSE/NCERT
* Proficient in MS Excel / Google Sheets/Google Suite
* Proficient in Hindi and English (Read, Write and Speak)
* Excellent research skills and have an eye for detail
* Sharpness in understanding assignments and proactively handle responsibilities
* Excellent in terms of quick and effective communication and coordination
* Have very keen observation skills and ability to sift through content and find the most relevant one.
* Strong hold on AI tools like Claude, Gemini, Chatgpt and can solve problems quickly using AI
* What We're Looking For — Values & Culture Fit
* Integrity - Ensures all content is factually accurate, curriculum-aligned, plagiarism-free, and supported by credible academic sources.
* Excellence - Delivers high-quality, learner-centric content with strong subject expertise, clear explanations, and continuous quality improvements based on feedback.
* Collaboration - Works effectively with curriculum, content, QC, design, and product teams to create engaging, pedagogically sound learning experiences and resolve feedback proactively.
* Efficiency- Works with high speed and looks at closing deliverables within assigned timelines while not compromising on qualitative output.
* Problem Solving: Has an attitude and aptitude for Problem solving.
* Why Join Us

This is a high-impact role where your work will directly shape engaging and curriculum aligned learning experiences for millions of K–12 learners. You will own the development and quality of Maths content, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and have the opportunity to contribute to large-scale educational initiatives while growing your expertise in curriculum design and digital learning.

title: Senior Product Support Specialist
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
  
  
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
  
  
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. Creators are the engine of Roblox. When something breaks for them, whether it is a broken publish flow, a payout that didn't land, an asset that won't upload, how quickly and how well we resolve it directly shapes whether they keep building with us.
  
  
You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Senior Product Support Specialist on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll own the hardest escalations end to end, drive root cause analysis with engineering and product partners, and then close the loop by turning what you learn into support content that scales for both our human agents and our automated support experiences.
  
  
Additionally, you will serve as a product expert working closely with the Product Support Management team, providing detailed synthesis of new and existing issues our users experience to prioritize and enable engineering teams to improve the platform. You'll operate with a high degree of independence.
  
  
**You Will**
**Support health and proactive gap identification**

* Co-monitor the health of creator support: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where creators are getting stuck.
* Mine ticket, content, and automation data for patterns: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, product gaps and surface them proactively with a recommendation attached to the PSM.
* Independently own root cause analysis for complex, high-impact, and ambiguous creator issues including ones that cross product, platform, and policy boundaries..
* Get ahead of launches: review upcoming product and policy changes, pressure test them from a support perspective, and make sure content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before creators feel the change. Support PSM in preparing RCA or post launch report to surface to all concerned stakeholder (engineering, product, operations etc)
* Report clearly and regularly to support and product leadership on where creator support is strong, where it's degrading, and what you propose to do about it.
* Drive operational excellence in how creator support runs: hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling, and treat every process change as something to be measured rather than assumed. Where the current way of working is the bottleneck, you name it and fix it.
* Product Feedback Loop: Partner directly with Product Managers (PMs) during alpha/beta testing phases to provide a "Supportability Scorecard" for major upcoming platform features.

**Knowledge & Support Content**

* Author and maintain the authoritative internal knowledge base agents rely on which includes but is not restricted to troubleshooting guides, decision trees, macros, policy interpretations and keep it accurate as the product changes underneath it.
* Own creator support content, which includes (but is not limited to) intent-ready articles, structured resolution paths, and clear, unambiguous source material for support agents to rely on.
* Build automation and self-service experiences, supplying the content and acting as a subject-matter judgment behind them, and flagging where automation is producing wrong or incomplete answers.
* Serve as a senior point of contact during high-severity creator-facing incidents, coordinating across support, engineering, and comms, when needed
* Raise the bar on escalation quality across the team by setting the standard for what a well-formed escalation looks like, and reduce the volume that shouldn't have escalated in the first place

You Have
  
  

* 7+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
* A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues.
* Excellent written communication. You have the ability to explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer and to a frustrated creator.
* Comfort with ambiguity and genuine self-direction. You choose your own problems, defend your prioritization, and close things out without being managed.
* Strong cross-functional influence without authority, you can get engineering and product to care about a support problem.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that your content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
* Experience writing or structuring content balancing automation driven human in the loop support, self-service, etc.
* Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience rather than a general consumer base.
* Working knowledge of Roblox as a creation platform; Studio, Lua, the developer economy or comparable experience with a UGC platform.
* Data & Diagnostic Proficiency: Comfortable querying datasets (SQL, Tableau, or similar BI tools) and analyzing diagnostic logs to isolate bugs before routing to engineering.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
  
  
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
  
  
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
In a world where data is critical to BCG's success, we are building first-class, foundational capabilities and products across the firm. Within this vision, LEAP is delivering BCG's new Learning platform to power the firm's learning and development needs.
  
  
Initially, you’ll work within the Data Product squad to build a custom data product in Snowflake as part of a broader transformation program of BCG’s learning technology. The data product will help enable AI-driven learning and make learning data accessible to other teams and systems, including, for example, staffing and analytics. When the program has ended, you’ll be part of a Learning squad with RtB as its scope.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**

* Develop well-structured Agile user stories and acceptance criteria that enable effective solution delivery, and owning your area of backlog
* Analyze processes and data needs, contributing to solution design and identifying practical approaches to business problems.
* Coordinate functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
* Support release readiness and implementation, identifying issues and working with technical teams to resolve them.
* Elicit, document, and validate requirements by engaging multiple stakeholder groups and subject matter experts.
* Write clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria understandable by both technical and functional colleagues.
* Create, update, and maintain requirements documentation (e.g., PRDs / functional specifications).
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, anticipating questions and translating technical details into plain language.
* Manage and triage support requests in a query management system (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Proactively flag risks and dependencies, keeping learner impact and business value as the priority.

What You'll Bring
  
  
***Education***

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 5–8 years of experience as a business / systems analyst, ideally supporting or configuring enterprise applications.

**Experience / Knowledge**

* A bachelor’s degree and 5-7 years of experience with Learning or HR applications.
* Experience with learning management or experience platforms; Docebo experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with data products, third-party platforms, and SaaS technology solutions.
* Working technical fluency with Snowflake, querying databases, and querying APIs to understand and validate data.
* Strong Agile experience, including writing user stories and working with Jira, sprints, and ceremonies.
* Experience developing and executing functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience using AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
The Business Analyst is a role within the Data Product Squad, part of LEAP in BCG's digital products organisation. Reporting to the IT Director, you will work day-to-day with your Product Owner, Chapter Leads, Scrum Master, and squad members, as well as functional business partners, subject matter experts, and IT colleagues. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to analyse, configure, and evolve BCG's new Learning platform, supporting both day-to-day operations and transformative change.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You're Good At**

* Translating learning and business needs into product requirements — asking the right questions and pushing past surface-level answers.
* Writing clear, well-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements documentation.
* Communicating clearly, both verbally and in writing, with all staff levels including leadership; excellent listening skills.
* Engaging and managing stakeholders across business, functional, and IT groups, and collaborating remotely with global experts.
* Being outcome-focused — keeping learner impact and business value front of mind.
* Owning your workstream — taking responsibility for your area of the backlog and delivery, proactively flagging risks.
* Managing data definitions and basic governance — flagging when a decision has governance implications.
* Working within an Agile framework.

*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Associate Consultant - S&O
description:
**Job Description**
#KGS
  
  
As one of fastest growing practice in DAS, Infrastructure and Climate Advisory (ICA) team at KGS invites like-minded professionals to help us drive progress and change. At KGS ICA practice, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team across a range of industries to assist public and private sector organizations involved in infrastructure to deliver desired outcomes, whether for society or for businesses. We are the Centre of Excellence for KPMG’s Global practices, helping our clients better understand evolving policy and regulatory environment, business and commercial risks, as well as providing commercial and strategic advice on complex infrastructure and capital projects. You will work on wide range of infrastructure sectors including transport, energy, digital infrastructure as well as social infrastructure, with diverse clientage such as public sector entities, infrastructure owners, project developers, large corporates, contractors, equity investors and financers.
  
  
The role will be based out of KPMG’s Gurugram, Mumbai and Bengaluru offices and liaise cross-functionally with leaders across the business to drive internal and external engagement.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support senior members in engagements through out the life cycle of Infrastructure projects (strategy, development, and performance) for clients in the government & public sector, corporates, institutional investors and infrastructure developers
* Conceptualize & develop reports on topics such as organizational policies, market assessment, market sizing, business plans, feasibility studies, business case evaluations and capital investment plans
* Contribute to thought leadership, white papers and point of views to develop market intelligence and sector knowledge
* Support Global Infrastructure advisory teams on business development initiatives, including preparation of proposals, pitches
* Conduct research, synthesize insights and develop presentations for end client deliverables
* Manage relationships with key stakeholders independently across various member firms

**Qualifications**
**Educational qualifications**

* Post-graduates/MBAs from a leading Indian/International educational institution
* Candidates holding professional certification relevant to the requirements are preferred, but not mandatory.

**Work Experience**

* Relevant experience (1-3 years) in strategy gained through corporate roles, consulting, or public sector organizations

**Mandatory Technical & Functional Skills**

* Exposure to and working experience in any Infrastructure sector (Transport, Oil & Gas, Broadband, Real Estate or Utilities etc.) sector is mandatory
* Understanding of the infrastructure asset lifecycle and how it impacts strategy and operations within various sectors
* Experience in strategic planning and operational frameworks to assess market trends, identify opportunities, and develop strategies to optimize project outcomes
* Strong analytical capabilities including to be able to conduct data analysis, risk assessments, market studies and provide recommendations for improvements
* Be proficient in Microsoft office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and in making presentations for senior level stakeholders with effective story boarding skills
* Having familiarity with data analysis tools like Alteryx, visualization tools like Power BI, Visio. Moreover, experience of application of Gen AI based tools would be an advantage

title: Functional Consultant - HRMS Implementation (India / MENA Region)

+ Analytical and can solve problems on-the-go.
+ Diligent and can track action items, follow-up, ensure smooth delivery, and manage project documentation.
+ A people’s person who communicates effectively and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders across functions to drive successful outcomes.

title: Manager-Financial Systems (EDMCS)
description:

title: Principal Instructor
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
  
  
*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You'll Do**

* Deliver practical and theoretical technical training sessions, taking an active and responsive mentoring role in developing and disseminating knowledge to internal and external technical global audiences, which may include partners, customers, and end users.
* Build and maintain deep knowledge of the entire SOTI One Platform product portfolio, not limited to MobiControl and inclusive of other MDM/EMM platforms as applicable.
* Deliver exceptional presentations, using advanced communication and interpersonal skills, exhibiting a high degree of professionalism as a representative of Global Training and SOTI.
* Communicate with excellent command of the English language, in both writing and speech — this role regularly engages global stakeholders, produces documentation used across regions, and represents SOTI to international audiences, making clear, professional English communication essential, not optional.
* Consistently demonstrate a positive attitude to ensure high-quality outputs, consistent delivery of commitments, and a rich learning experience for students.
* Demonstrate the technical fluency to clearly explain complex technical terminology; not just execute a process, but describe each step's purpose, what fails if it's skipped, and how to walk through it without reading from a script.
* Make sound decisions, remain agile and flexible, and exercise good judgment when circumstances don't go as expected.
* Maintain solid awareness of the different contractual relationships between partners and SOTI, and the limitations/operational parameters governing what can be shared with each partner, to protect confidentiality and integrity.
* Collaborate closely and proactively with Global Training team members — including regional peers and the India/APAC lead Principal Instructor — and take direction from the Manager of Principal Instructor Operations to create, manage, and deliver training plans for global and regional audiences.
* Demonstrate flexibility to travel extensively across India and the broader APAC region to deliver Instructor-Led Training, and the ability to organize Web-Based Training and self-learning strategies where in-person delivery isn't practical.
* Have flexibility with working hours, including starting later in the day where needed, to accommodate coordination and delivery across global time zones (APAC and EMEA) as required by the business.
* Oversee training quality for locations not visited in person, by building strong working relationships with in-region personnel.
* Act as a lead facilitator for training initiatives, ensuring world-class delivery and that the learner experience is never compromised — across a region spanning multiple languages, markets, and levels of technical maturity.
* Bring an audience-focused facilitation approach, adapting delivery style and pacing to a wide range of technical backgrounds and English proficiency levels among learners.
* Actively apply a continuous improvement process to close the loop on feedback, addressing trainer issues and negative comments with a solutions-first mindset.

**Impact and Contribution**

* The candidate's role will encompass individual managing contributions, setting and maintaining standards, and ensuring others adhere to Global Training's policies, processes, and procedures to be considered eligible to deliver training.
* Assess trainer readiness to deliver and facilitate training to a SOTI quality standard is critical to the credibility and overall success of our products and programs. Trainer authorization is a prerequisite to authenticating a SOTI trainer.
* Trainer to be certified on SOTI product certifications and other applicable certifications important to understanding MDM & EMM environments and adjacent platforms.
* SOTI Certified Trainer certification is maintained and recertified every 2 years in keeping with Global Training's evolving training techniques and digital learning standards.

**Collaboration & Cross-Functional Teams**

* Act as an SME for product knowledge intake, contributing solutions and assisting the Content Manager with deliverables and materials, aligning needs with Programs and Project training plans.
* Represent facilitation, working with product owners/managers to deliver training for new product introductions (NPI), including special events and training requests as supported by Global Training's business model/mandate.
* Communicate proactively and in writing on status, blockers, and process changes — this is a collaborative team, not a set of independent operators, and visibility across the group is expected as a standard, not an exception.

**Experience You'll Bring**

* Adult learning education background/post-secondary education equivalency.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills — essential given the global, cross-regional nature of this role.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively across culturally and linguistically diverse audiences.
* Exceptional presentation skills, proficient in MS Office Suite.
* Very comfortable working, participating and communicating in a highly collaborative team environment.
* Proven partner relationship management experience.
* Strong knowledge and experience with MDM/EMM products and solutions.
* Advanced knowledge of emergent technologies, Windows Modern management, and Apple products.
* 3-5 years of related work portfolio experience.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across India and the broader APAC region.

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

title: Technical Support Engineer- AIML (Gurugram) IRC300786
description:

GlobalLogic is looking for a highly skilled and customer-focused AIML Technical Support Engineer with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies, along with hands-on experience in Technical Support and any Cloud platform.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of AIML concepts and technologies, excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, and the ability to support customers in resolving complex technical issues. Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Microsoft Azure is required.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, and/or equivalent practical experience.
* 1+ years of experience in Technical Support, troubleshooting, or a related technical field.
* Strong knowledge or understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIML), Chatbots, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI.
* Preferred experience or knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Basic understanding of cloud or hybrid cloud environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues effectively.
* Strong customer support capabilities with a customer-focused approach.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to understand customer concerns, empathize with customers, and handle issues with care and professionalism.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions to customers with varying levels of technical knowledge.
* Willingness to work from the office in a 24×7 rotational shift environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and adapt to a fast-paced support environment.

Job responsibilities
  
  
  

* Engage with customers through email, chat, and phone to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues related to AIML products, solutions, and cloud environments.

* Identify recurring issues and trends and recommend preventative actions or process improvements to enhance product quality and customer experience.
* Clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions to customers and internal stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise.

title: Workday Integration Specialist
description:
**About Us**
Dyson is a global technology enterprise. We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. We’re growing fast and our ambition is huge – more categories, more locations and more people.
  
  
Pioneering technology takes more than just inventive engineers. At Dyson, we take a problem-solving approach to everything we do. And across our support teams, we’re proud to be different. And importantly, we support change to maintain our rapid growth
  
  
Digital HRIS function organization provides process and service excellence to support Dyson’s growth ambitions with a goal of innovating and enhancing employee services over time to meet the changing needs of the business.
  
  
**About The Role**
Part of a team of functional managers and specialists, the role is fundamental to supporting and advancing Dyson’s usage of the core Human Capital Management system (Workday). This role will serve as an HR Technology point of contact for HR functional areas and assists HR subject matter experts to identify, plan and implement systems and process improvements. The specialist will have responsibility for the successful implementation, integration, configuration, and support of Workday applications from project initiation to production roll-out.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will strive to deliver a 'best in class', efficient service and will be a valued member of the wider People and Dyson Business Services communities at Dyson.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support global business users and HR by troubleshooting system issues, resolving defects, maintaining system data structures, assisting with ad-hoc reporting requests, and administering biannual Workday-related processes.
* Take ownership of queries and actively manage them, providing best-in-class technical solutions and stakeholder support while ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) with deep knowledge of Workday integrations and modules, including configuration, testing, and implementation across HCM, Reporting & Analytics, Compensation, Talent and Performance, Absence Management, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Security, and related areas.
* Conduct working sessions with stakeholders to gather, understand, and analyze business and technical requirements, recommending solutions based on best practices and feasibility.

* Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
* Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
  
  
**Organizational Context**
UNDP has been working in India since 1951 in almost all areas of human development. Together with the Government of India and development partners, we have worked towards eradicating poverty, reducing inequalities, strengthening local governance, enhancing community resilience, protecting the environment, supporting policy initiatives and institutional reforms, and accelerating sustainable development for all.
  
  
With projects and programmes in every state and union territory in India, UNDP works with national and subnational government, and diverse development actors to deliver people-centric results, particularly for the most vulnerable and marginalized communities. As the integrator for collective action on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) within the UN system, we are committed to supporting the Government of India’s national development vision and priorities and accelerating the achievement of the SDGs for the people and the planet.
  
  
UNDP India’s New Country Programme (2023-2027) Builds On Our Prior Work And Aims To Provide An Integrated Approach To Development Solutions In Three Strategic Portfolios
  
  

* Strong, accountable and evidence-led institutions for accelerated achievement of the SDGs.
* Enhanced economic opportunities and social protection to reduce inequality, with a focus on the marginalized.
* Climate-smart solutions, sustainable ecosystems and resilient development for reduced vulnerability.

South-South cooperation, gender equality and social inclusion are promoted across the pillars. The programme is supported by a framework of renewed partnerships and blended finance solutions, strategic innovation and accelerator labs, and data and digital architecture.
  
  
You are invited to join a team of future-smart development professionals to support India in achieving the national and globally agreed goals. **Main Purpose**
The position will support the Senior Economist and the Policy Unit in advancing UNDP India’s strategic priorities through the formulation and implementation of integrated policy initiatives and programmes. * Collaborating closely with the country office programme teams and external counterparts to identify new policy ideas in line with the UNDP’s priorities, initiate project concepts; lead the consultations on project formulation;
* Coordinating closely with technical advisors at the UNDP/Bangkok Regional Hub (BRH), governmental and other institutions to ensure an effective formulation process leading to the approval of the projects;
* Ensures a strong relationship between UNDP India’s programmatic work and policy initiatives, with oversight on quality of published policy documents.

**2- Provides oversight and management of initiatives in UNDP Policy Unit through:**

* Effective application of Result Based Management (RBM) tools in project management; establishment of management targets and monitoring achievement of results;
* Performance of the functions of project manager in Atlas as defined and participation in recruitment processes for projects;
* Proactive financial and substantive monitoring and evaluation of the projects, identification of operational and financial problems, development of solutions; timely escalation of issues and challenges, follow-up on audit and other recommendations;

**3- Engages In Partnership Building And Resource Mobilization Through**

* Coordination of activities and communications with all relevant stakeholders to build new, and strengthen existing relationships with partners and relevant government counterparts;
* Identification of capacity building and institutional development needs and implementation of appropriate interventions to enhance capacity and skills at the local level for programme/project development and resources mobilization;
* Scanning of funding windows and any other potential sources, preparation of substantive briefs on possible opportunities for project finance and co-finance in particular with a focus on private sector, financial institutions and Government cost-sharing;
* Representing UNDP in relevant meetings and for a when directed by the supervisor;
* Contribution to the UN’s work in India and actively participate in the UNCT Result Groups and fora.

**4- Ensures Facilitation Of Knowledge Generation And Management Through**

* Formulating and developing best lessons learnt products and tools;
* Leading the preparation of knowledge products with relevance for UNDP’s policy priorities;
* Identifying, synthesizing and sharing lessons learnt and good practices directly linked to programme country policy goals;
* Identifying sources of information related to policy-driven issues; and quality contribution to knowledge networks regionally and globally to support the provision of quality advisory services and facilitation of knowledge building and management.

**5- Supports the Senior Economist (in his/ her capacity as the head of the Policy Unit)**
in people management, knowledge management, partnership building/ resource mobilization, and any other task as assigned by the supervisor.

title: Fuels Associate Researcher or Researcher, India
company: The International Council on Clean Transportation
description:
The International Council on Clean Transportation (ICCT) is an award-winning, independent, global, non-profit research organization that provides data-driven research to advance policies that reduce the health and environmental impacts of the transportation sector. The ICCT offers a mission-driven and culturally diverse workplace where intelligence, flexibility, transparency, and good humor are highly valued. Join our team of talented researchers and operations staff with offices in Beijing, Berlin, New Delhi, San Francisco, São Paulo, and Washington D.C.
  
  
The ICCT has an immediate opening for a highly motivated and committed Associate Researcher or Researcher in the Fuels program who will work on low-GHG energy alternatives for the marine and aviation sectors. This is a full-time position based in ICCT’s New Delhi office and will report to the Fuels Program Lead, working regularly with the India Regional Lead.
  
  
The Associate Researcher or Researcher will conduct robust research and analyses and develop policy recommendations, communicating actionable findings to policymakers, industry, and other stakeholders. This person will focus on Indian policies and programs, such as the National Green Hydrogen Mission and the Aviation Turbine Fuel Order, but the person may also work on fuels policies in other countries in Asia and elsewhere. Representative work can be seen at the ICCT’s
  
  
Fuels program page.
  
  
**You Will**

* Analyze the cost, life-cycle GHG emissions, and availability of low-GHG renewable fuels, such as renewable hydrogen derivatives and biofuels.
* Write clear and concise technical reports, policy briefs, and articles including informative but easy-to-understand figures to summarize ICCT’s research for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Present findings in public and private forums.
* Help organize outreach activities such as briefings, meetings, and workshops.
* Collaborate effectively with the ICCT’s global Fuels team and colleagues in India, as well as with external partners, policymakers, and industry stakeholders.
* Other responsibilities as assigned.

**You Have**

* Associate Researcher: A bachelor’s or master's degree in environmental science, biology, chemistry, ecology, engineering, environmental policy or related discipline, in addition to at least two years of related experience, or alternatively a PhD degree

OR
  
  

* Researcher: A master’s or PhD degree in engineering, environmental science, environmental policy, energy and resources, or another relevant subject, in addition to at least three years of related experience.
* Excellent and demonstrated quantitative, analytical, and research skills
* The ability to work independently with limited supervision, being highly organized and strategic in problem-solving
* Strong interpersonal and English communication skills, both written and verbal, plus reading and
* writing proficiency in a second language strongly preferred;
* Superior proficiency with MS Office including Excel required; programming experience with Python or R preferred; and
* Experience with life-cycle assessment and/or techno-economic analyses preferred

To be successful in our environment, you must be intellectually curious, self-directed, and able to work effectively with people from across the globe. You must be able to connect research to policy and translate technical information to stakeholders. This position will be based in New Delhi. Some travel within India and international travel may be required.
  
  
Our Benefits
  
  
This full-time position will be based in our New Delhi office. We also offer an excellent benefits package, including opportunities for professional development.
  
  
To Apply
  
  
Please include a resume, a cover letter, writing samples or relevant technical research publications primarily written by the applicant (in English), and two to three professional references. Preference will be given to candidates who submit a complete application and who directly address the position being offered. Please include your ideal start date. The position will remain open until filled.  Specific combinations of academic degrees and highly relevant work experience will be considered when deciding whether the candidate is suitable for the Associate or Researcher level.
  
  
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, colour, sex, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, ancestry, physical/mental disability, medical condition, military/veteran status, genetic information, marital status, ethnicity, alienage or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace.

description:
**Job Description**
**Tiered Approach**
In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby
  
  

* Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
* Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
* Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
  
  
**Organizational Context**
UNDP has been working in India since 1951 in almost all areas of human development. Together with the Government of India and development partners, we have worked towards eradicating poverty, reducing inequalities, strengthening local governance, enhancing community resilience, protecting the environment, supporting policy initiatives and institutional reforms, and accelerating sustainable development for all.
  
  
With projects and programmes in every state and union territory in India, UNDP works with national and subnational government, and diverse development actors to deliver people-centric results, particularly for the most vulnerable and marginalized communities. As the integrator for collective action on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) within the UN system, we are committed to supporting the Government of India’s national development vision and priorities and accelerating the achievement of the SDGs for the people and the planet.
  
  
UNDP India’s New Country Programme (2023-2027) Builds On Our Prior Work And Aims To Provide An Integrated Approach To Development Solutions In Three Strategic Portfolios
  
  

* Strong, accountable and evidence-led institutions for accelerated achievement of the SDGs.
* Enhanced economic opportunities and social protection to reduce inequality, with a focus on the marginalized.
* Climate-smart solutions, sustainable ecosystems and resilient development for reduced vulnerability.

South-South cooperation, gender equality and social inclusion are promoted across the pillars. The programme is supported by a framework of renewed partnerships and blended finance solutions, strategic innovation and accelerator labs, and data and digital architecture.
  
  
You are invited to join a team of future-smart development professionals to support India in achieving the national and globally agreed goals. As part of the UNDP team, your focus will be to work with diverse stakeholders to find country-specific solutions that lead to sustainable development and reach those furthest behind first.
  
  
**Office / Unit/ Project Description**
The Policy Unit leads UNDP India’s research and advocacy on Global Goals and the national development agenda, with a special focus on environment and climate change, skill development, inclusive growth and strengthening systems for SDG localization.
  
  
**Scope of Work**
**Main Purpose**
The position will support the Senior Economist and the Policy Unit in advancing UNDP India’s strategic priorities through the formulation and implementation of integrated policy initiatives and programmes. It will contribute to strengthening linkages between policy and programme priorities, supporting partnerships and resource mobilization, and promoting knowledge and evidence to inform UNDP’s development interventions.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
**1- Support the formulation, development, and design of new integrated policy initiatives in UNDP priority areas through:**

* Preparing substantive inputs to key strategic and policy documents, which direct and guide UNDP interventions on climate change, livelihoods, health, gender, and localization of SDGs.
* Collaborating closely with the country office programme teams and external counterparts to identify new policy ideas in line with the UNDP’s priorities, initiate project concepts; lead the consultations on project formulation;
* Coordinating closely with technical advisors at the UNDP/Bangkok Regional Hub (BRH), governmental and other institutions to ensure an effective formulation process leading to the approval of the projects;
* Ensures a strong relationship between UNDP India’s programmatic work and policy initiatives, with oversight on quality of published policy documents.

**2- Provides oversight and management of initiatives in UNDP Policy Unit through:**

* Effective application of Result Based Management (RBM) tools in project management; establishment of management targets and monitoring achievement of results;
* Performance of the functions of project manager in Atlas as defined and participation in recruitment processes for projects;
* Proactive financial and substantive monitoring and evaluation of the projects, identification of operational and financial problems, development of solutions; timely escalation of issues and challenges, follow-up on audit and other recommendations;
* Preparation and contribution to the regular reports on outputs and outcomes as required.

**3- Engages In Partnership Building And Resource Mobilization Through**

* Coordination of activities and communications with all relevant stakeholders to build new, and strengthen existing relationships with partners and relevant government counterparts;
* Identification of capacity building and institutional development needs and implementation of appropriate interventions to enhance capacity and skills at the local level for programme/project development and resources mobilization;
* Scanning of funding windows and any other potential sources, preparation of substantive briefs on possible opportunities for project finance and co-finance in particular with a focus on private sector, financial institutions and Government cost-sharing;
* Representing UNDP in relevant meetings and for a when directed by the supervisor;
* Contribution to the UN’s work in India and actively participate in the UNCT Result Groups and fora.

**4- Ensures Facilitation Of Knowledge Generation And Management Through**

* Formulating and developing best lessons learnt products and tools;
* Leading the preparation of knowledge products with relevance for UNDP’s policy priorities;
* Identifying, synthesizing and sharing lessons learnt and good practices directly linked to programme country policy goals;
* Identifying sources of information related to policy-driven issues; and quality contribution to knowledge networks regionally and globally to support the provision of quality advisory services and facilitation of knowledge building and management.

**5- Supports the Senior Economist (in his/ her capacity as the head of the Policy Unit)**
in people management, knowledge management, partnership building/ resource mobilization, and any other task as assigned by the supervisor.
  
  
The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization
  
  
**Institutional Arrangements**

* Reporting To: Country Economist
* Reporting to this position: - N/A

**Competencies**

**Achieve Results**

**Think Innovatively**
LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements
  
  
**Learn Continuously**

title: Program Assistant - VBD Technical Support Unit
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Programme Overview**
Vector Borne Diseases (VBDs) such as malaria, visceral leishmaniasis (VL, also called kala-azar), lymphatic filariasis (LF), dengue, chikungunya, and Japanese encephalitis remain major public health concerns in India.
  
  
India has achieved remarkable reductions in VBD cases and deaths over recent decades. Malaria cases have reduced from 75 million at the time of India’s independence to 200,00 in 2023-24, while deaths have reduced from 800,000 to 83 during the same period. For LF, though active transmission and infection rates have declined, the chronic manifestations remain significant. India reported about 600,00 lymphoedema cases and 125,000 hydrocele cases caused by filarial worms in 2023. For VL, cases have reduced to 500 in 2023. The Government of India has committed to the elimination of several VBDs within defined timelines- for example, eliminating malaria by 2030 and lymphatic filariasis and kala-azar ahead of global targets.
  
  
Despite these gains, these illnesses continue to contribute substantially to disease burden, morbidity, mortality and disability, particularly among populations living in rural, remote, or otherwise underserved areas. Climate change, urbanization, migration, environmental factors, and gaps in vector control and surveillance continue to challenge disease elimination efforts.
  
  
The National Center for Vector Borne Diseases Control (NCVBDC) is the nodal agency under the National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) responsible for orchestrating the government’s response to VBDs. Its roles include policy formulation, standard setting, strategic planning (including disease elimination timelines), surveillance strengthening, capacity building, coordinating multi-sectoral and inter-governmental efforts, and deploying innovations in vector control, diagnostics, and community engagement.
  
  
**Project Background**
WJCF is privileged to support NVBDCP's bold vision of accelerated elimination of VL, LF, and Malaria through embedded technical support units (TSU) for VL and LF since 2020, and for malaria since 2024. These TSUs provide support to the NCVBDC including, inter alia
  
  

* Strengthened technical and managerial support to NVBDCP management
* Enhanced disease intelligence and analytics for improved programmatic decisions-making
* Adoption of dynamic innovations across disease portfolios, and, effective and sustained investments in the space of NTDs/VBDs
* Steering partnerships and multi-sector response

**Position Summary**
WJCF seeks a highly motivated and entrepreneurial individual for the position of Program Assistant with demonstrated abilities to support LF and VL program at NCVBDC. As a member of TSU team, they will support thought and action on programmatic and surveillance data of LF and VL programmes. The position will involve mechanisms to compile, validate and comprehend data through disparate data sources, improving data quality and use by national and state actors and integrating key aspects for synthesized action. The position will report directly to the Team Lead, TSU at NCVBDC.
  
  
The Program Assistant role at WJCF involves close collaboration with the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and the WJCF-led TSU. The role primarily focuses on supporting program operations through data management, stakeholder communication, coordination, and administrative tasks. It requires organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
  
  

* Assist the TSU in ensuring regular programme data collection from the states and do follow up.
* Attend meetings and take minutes.
* Support NCVBDC in developing a comprehensive calendar of events for VBD activities at the national as well as the state level.
* Regular follow up with VBD departments and states on programmatic priorities.
* Facilitate support to the programme in providing timely response to the communication received from stakeholders and coordinate with programme divisions.
* Support the team in consolidating, updating and verifying the data received for the programme.
* Perform any other tasks as assigned by the TSU Team lead.
* Bachelor's degree with minimum 2-3 years of work experience.
* Strong written and oral communication skills with proficiency in MS Word, Excel (Formulas, Macros/VBA), PowerPoint, Internet applications and Mobile applications.
* Previous experience managing and analysing large data sets.
* Exceptional diplomatic and interpersonal skills, and ability to build relationships. Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to evaluate systems holistically and advise on effectiveness of systems or processes.
* Ability to think creatively in the face of challenges.
* Ability to work independently and proactively manage projects with minimal supervision.
* Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI).
* Knowledge of statistical methods and data cleaning techniques.
* Good oral and written communication skills.
* Data management for logistics support.
* Attention to detail.

**Last Date to Apply**
1st November, 2026

title: STEM Advisory Mentor
description:
**Company Overview:**

Rostrum Education supports students and families in their journey to gain admission to the world’s most competitive universities. With personalised mentorship, expert guidance, and a proven track record, we help students craft strong, standout applications.

In the 2025 admissions cycle, our students secured 10+ Oxbridge offers and 15+ Ivy League offers, showcasing the strength of our strategies and the quality of our mentorship. From Oxford to Harvard, Cambridge to Columbia, we help ambitious students turn their aspirations into achievement.

With Rostrum, students benefit from a strategy that can increase their chances of admission up to 5 times, helping them turn their ambition into achievement and applications into success stories.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a technically strong, curious, and student-focused STEM Advisory Mentor to support high school students in developing research projects, computational work, engineering projects, and competition submissions.

The ideal candidate is a recent graduate or Master's student with strong subject knowledge and a demonstrated project, research, or technical portfolio. You will work with students from the early stages of an idea through to a well-structured research project, technical prototype, competition submission, or publication.

This role combines STEM mentorship, research guidance, computational problem solving, and academic development.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Student Mentorship & Project Development:

* Develop, refine, and stress test physics, mathematics, computer science, data science, and engineering project ideas.
* Help students turn broad interests into focused research questions, hypotheses, methodologies, and feasible project plans.
* Support programming, debugging, data analysis, modelling, simulations, statistical analysis, and visualisation.
* Support computational and engineering projects, including prototyping, CAD, digital design, and simulations where relevant.
* Guide students through literature searches, literature reviews, research methodology, and interpretation of academic papers.
* Review research methods, datasets, analyses, results, papers, proposals, posters, presentations, and technical reports.

2. Competitions & Publications:

* Prepare students for research and innovation competitions such as IRIS, Conrad Challenge, Blue Ocean, and similar national or international STEM competitions.
* Guide students on competition strategy, project framing, technical development, documentation, presentations, and judging criteria.
* Support students interested in publishing their work, including manuscript structure, research standards, peer review, revisions, and publication ethics.
* Help students identify appropriate publication platforms designed for high school researchers, such as the Journal of Student Research and the Journal of Emerging Investigators.

3. STEM Pathways & Application Support:

* Identify relevant competitions, internships, research programmes, summer schools, external mentors, and other STEM opportunities.
* Help students explore STEM majors, minors, concentrations, and interdisciplinary academic pathways.
* Review STEM application materials, including activity descriptions, research summaries, project portfolios, and competition descriptions.
* Evaluate students holistically, considering interests, curiosity, communication, initiative, personal character, and unique perspectives alongside academic preparation.

4. Resource Development & Internal Contribution:

* Develop and facilitate STEM workshops, bootcamps, research guides, and technical learning resources.
* Contribute to internal STEM resources, mentor training, and counsellor training.
* Work with the counselling team to align STEM project work with students' overall application strategy.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Computational Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
* Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong programming or computational skills, with familiarity with Python, R, MATLAB, or similar tools.
* Experience with data analysis, statistical methods, modelling, simulations, and data visualisation.
* Experience conducting research or developing independent technical projects.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply.
* Ability to balance technical depth with age-appropriate mentorship.
* Experience mentoring or guiding students is valuable, but not essential.
* **Portfolio (required):**
  A GitHub or equivalent technical portfolio showing practical evidence of your work, such as software projects, data science analyses, computational research, mathematical modelling, simulations, machine learning projects, data visualisations, engineering projects, CAD or digital design, independent research, publications, or competition submissions.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with a highly experienced team of mentors, including former Ivy League and Oxbridge admissions officers.
* Gain hands-on experience in global university admissions consulting and STEM research mentorship.
* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
* Opportunities for career advancement and professional growth in the education sector.
* Be part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to shaping students' futures.

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst- Sexual, Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn and Child Health
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.

We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Programme Overview**
WJCF seeks to strengthen maternal and newborn care across India by strengthening systems, innovating service delivery, and empowering communities. Our goal is to address the entire continuum of care, from reproductive health and family planning to safe pregnancy and newborn care, through evidence-driven strategies, collaborative partnerships, and sustainable solutions.
  
  
Since 2018, WJCF has partnered with national and state governments to strengthen Sexual, Reproductive, Maternal, and Newborn Health (SRMNH) services across India. Our work has focused on expanding access to comprehensive abortion care, improving family planning and contraceptive uptake, strengthening antenatal and newborn care, addressing anemia, and piloting innovative service delivery models. Between 2018 and 2023, we supported states in scaling CAC services, building provider capacity, improving iron and folic acid supplementation, enhancing readiness of maternal and newborn health facilities, and closing supply chain gaps for family planning commodities. We also introduced digital health interventions and tested new approaches to improve service delivery.
  
  
In 2024-2025, WJCF collaborated with state governments to develop multi-year strategies aimed at reducing maternal and neonatal mortality and broadening access to high-quality SRH services. These strategic roadmaps, endorsed by state leadership, lay the foundation for expanding contraceptive choice, including new methods such as long-acting reversible contraceptives, strengthening facility-level MNH care, and establishing robust monitoring and evaluation systems. During this period, WJCF also deepened programmatic support by strengthening access to intravenous iron for treatment of moderate and severe anemia in pregnancy, enhancing CAC service delivery, and expanding availability of modern contraceptive methods through both public and private-sector channels. Additionally, we designed and tested alternative service delivery models for reproductive health and family planning, including leveraging e-pharmacy platforms to reach populations with limited access to SRH products.
  
  
Across all years, WJCF has worked closely with government counterparts, development partners, private-sector innovators, and frontline providers to improve access, quality, and awareness across the SRMNH continuum. Our approach combines policy support, data and analytics, operational assistance, market shaping, and scalable implementation models to deliver sustainable impact for women, adolescents, newborns, and families across India.
  
  
**Position Summary**
WJCF is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented analyst/senior analyst to support the SRMNCH program. The Analyst will work closely with government stakeholders and internal teams to strengthen data-driven decision-making, generate insights, support implementation, and contribute to the development of high-quality program materials and analyses. The role requires strong analytical skills, comfort working with large datasets, and the ability to synthesize information into actionable recommendations. The Analyst will support workstreams across both SRH and MNCH domains and assist in preparing dashboards, reports, presentations, and research products.
  
  

* Provide analytical and programmatic support across SRMNCH initiatives, including cleaning, validating, and analyzing data from multiple health information systems and sources.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and monitoring tools to track program performance at various levels.
* Conduct primary and secondary research, including desk reviews, policy analysis, and stakeholder interviews, to generate evidence and identify gaps in service delivery, regulations, and guidelines.
* Support monitoring and evaluation activities by designing tools, surveys, and frameworks to assess intervention impact and capture user feedback.
* Assist in synthesizing quantitative and qualitative insights into actionable recommendations, reports, presentations, and communication materials for internal and external stakeholders.
* Contribute to project management by coordinating implementation plans, tracking progress, and ensuring timely reporting and compliance.
* Engage with stakeholders—including government counterparts, partners, and donors—to strengthen collaboration and support strategic initiatives.
* Assess supply chain and market dynamics for SRH and MNCH products and support strategies to improve availability and access.
* Support testing of innovative service delivery models and digital health interventions to enhance uptake of SRH and MNCH services.
* Provide operational support for planning, organizing meetings, and documentation of program activities.
* Assist in scoping new opportunities and developing proposals or pitch documents in SRMNCH and allied areas.
* Bachelor’s Degree with minimum 2+ years of relevant work experience or postgraduate in a relevant field (public health/administration, economics, social work, sociology, management, population studies, etc.) with a minimum of 1+ year experience
* High level of technical proficiency with MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, and MS Word Experience of using advanced analytical tools will be a plus
* Ability to absorb and synthesize a broad range of information, including technical information, and prepare compelling presentations and reports.
* Excellent written and oral communications skills in English and Hindi
* Ability to work independently, prioritize, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Experience of working with government stakeholders and familiarity with the Indian public health system will be a plus

**Advantages**

* Willingness to travel extensively within and outside the program geography in India
* Experience in management consulting, pharmaceutical industry or other relevant private or public-sector domains
* Entrepreneurial mindset demonstrated ability to work independently on complex projects and solve challenging problems, in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with limited oversight
* Exceptional diplomatic and interpersonal skills, and ability to build strong professional relationships with a range of stakeholders in a challenging, multi-cultural environment

* Develop, support and promote OPM’s work on clean energy, natural resource management and sustainable growth in India to build future work, deliver existing projects and programmes, and contribute to OPM’s internal learning.

Key Responsibilities

* Procurement Engineering Support  Assist in preparing technical data sheets for field instruments (pressure, temperature, flow, level), control valves, safety valves, and analytical systems.  Help compile Material Requisition (MR) packages for vendor bidding.  Support the review of vendor drawings and technical offers to ensure compliance with project specifications.
* Quality Control \& Standards Compliance  Ensure all drafts and documents adhere to company drafting standards and project quality procedures.  Learn and apply relevant international engineering codes and standards (e.g., ISA, IEC, IEEE, API, ASME).  Maintain strict revision control and organization of the project master document registry. Job Requirements \& Qualifications  Education: Min. BSc. Physics  Experience: Fresher (0 to 1 year). Process industry internship experience (Oil \& Gas, Chemical, Power, Water) is a plus.  Technical Skills: o Strong fundamental knowledge of electronics, control systems, and measurement principles. o Basic proficiency in AutoCAD or MicroStation is required. o Familiarity with or academic exposure to 3D modeling environments (e.g., E3D, PDMS, SP3D) or SmartPlant Instrumentation (SPI / INtools) is highly advantageous.  Soft Skills: o High level of attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and drafting. o Excellent written and verbal communication skills for team collaboration. o Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.

description:

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**
 As a Packaging Data \& Engineering Change Engineer, you are primarily responsible for managing and administratively executing Engineering Change processes (ECN/ECR) for packaging. Additionally, you will independently manage the cross\-product Product Number Application (PNA) process within SAP. Another key component of your role is providing operational and administrative support to the global R\&D Packaging Development Workflow, taking ownership of processes and data maintenance.
