* Create plant specific views in SAP.
* Ensure completion of all technical change documentation, including design BOMs, technical drawings, and engineering approvals.
* Build, modify, and maintain complex design and production Bills of Materials (BOM) specifically for packaging configurations ("Boxed Products").
* Coordinate the creation of packaging artwork and labeling with internal stakeholders
* Maintain critical logistics and packaging master data in SAP during the ECN process, including units of measure, packaging weights, master carton dimensions, and pallet stack heights (for both in\-house production and merchandise).
* Partner with Purchasing during the change workflow to request, analyze, and track cost structures for new packaging components.
* Coordinate with Technical Quality (TQ) to trigger and set up Q\-info records in SAP for Initial Sample Inspection Reports (ISIR), enabling initial sample orders.
* Coordinate the creation and setup of production routings in SAP.
* Together with a team member, coordinate packaging samples (requesting, checking, and validating physical samples) and align on 0\-series (pilot) production runs with TQ.
* Perform final data audits on completed ECNs regarding validity dates, BOM completeness, and final status release ("Orderable").
* Product Number Applications (PNA) – Cross\-Product
* Independently administer and advance the PNA process within the SAP workflow.
* Allocate manufacturing plants, departmental responsibilities, and specific "Lab / Office" attributes in SAP MDG based on the global production strategy.
* Execute logistical change notifications required for product relocations within the Lixil Group, as well as for insourcing and outsourcing projects.
* Audit and gather data from ECN files and maintain alignment with project managers.
* Maintain comprehensive tracking worklists to ensure full visibility and documentation of all PNA workflow statuses.
* Operational \& Administrative Support in the R\&D Packaging Workflow
* Independently execute administrative and data\-driven tasks within the global R\&D packaging workflow to ensure steady project progression.
* Manage operational process steps for continuous packaging optimizations and lifecycle projects under the direct supervision of an experienced team member.
* Collaborate closely with the core team, ensuring timely escalation of issues; technical support and resolution of complex engineering questions will be provided by the technical expert in the team.
* Assist in the administrative and master\-data tracking of various R\&D packaging projects across their lifecycle (including innovation projects, such as the implementation of optimized insert concepts or transitioning to sustainable molded pulp solutions, as a sub\-task).
* Coordinate, compile, and maintain technical documentation, packaging specifications, and engineering data packages.


**Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Packaging Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Logistics, or a comparable technical discipline.
* Initial or proven professional experience in technical administration, master data management (MDG), or Engineering Change Management.
* Basic to solid understanding of manufacturing processes, logistics chains, and industrial packaging requirements.


**Technical \& IT Skills**
* Good user knowledge in SAP (specifically Material Master, BOM structures, PNA/ECN workflows, Q\-info records, SAP MDG, and CL31 queries).
* Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and MS Excel.


**Personal Competencies**
* Structured, conscientious, and proactive mindset with the ability to efficiently drive administrative processes forward.
* High attention to detail and data accuracy, essential for maintaining sensitive SAP master data and production BOMs.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills to collaborate seamlessly with supervising team members and technical counterparts across global locations.
* Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory for daily international collaboration.

title: Mechanical Engineering
description:
**Mechanical Engineering – AI Trainer**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, more technically rigorous AI models — and we need mechanical engineers to make it happen. As an AI Trainer, you'll use your deep domain knowledge to challenge, test, and refine how AI reasons through complex engineering problems.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering and artificial intelligence, contributing directly to the next generation of technical AI systems — all on a flexible, remote contract basis.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Fully Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Complex Engineering Problems — Craft advanced, multi\-step problems spanning fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, structural mechanics, FEA, heat transfer, kinematics, and materials science to rigorously stress\-test AI capabilities
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Develop precise, step\-by\-step technical solutions that serve as gold\-standard benchmarks for AI learning and evaluation
* Audit AI Reasoning — Review and evaluate AI\-generated outputs — including CAD logic, thermodynamic proofs, and material specifications — for technical accuracy, physical validity, and adherence to engineering standards (e.g., ASME, ISO)
* Identify \& Correct Reasoning Failures — Spot logical errors such as incorrect force distributions, energy conservation violations, or flawed unit analysis, and provide structured feedback to improve how the model thinks
* Document Failure Modes — Systematically record model weaknesses to help research teams harden AI reasoning across mechanical engineering domains


**Who You Are**
* Advanced Degree — Master's (pursuing or completed) or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related field
* Strong Domain Expertise — Deep knowledge in one or more core areas: solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, CAD/CAM, or manufacturing processes
* Clear Technical Communicator — Able to explain complex physical phenomena and mathematical derivations in precise, well\-structured written form
* Detail\-Oriented — High level of precision when reviewing mathematical derivations, unit conversions, dimensional analysis, and physical system constraints
* No prior AI experience required — we'll get you up to speed


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, technical writing, or quality evaluation
* Proficiency in engineering software such as SolidWorks, MATLAB, ANSYS, or similar tools
* Familiarity with FEA workflows, CFD simulation, or mechatronics systems


**Why Join Us**
* Work on genuinely cutting\-edge AI projects alongside world\-class research teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work independently on your own schedule
* Apply your engineering expertise in a novel, intellectually stimulating way
* Gain rare, hands\-on exposure to how advanced large language models are trained and evaluated

 **Amex Offers Digital Marketing (AODM) measurement domain** 
 , providing comprehensive campaign performance insights and enabling data\-driven marketing decisions.
   

  

 The Amex Offers team is seeking a candidate to support Global Marketing Measurement (GMM) Product Enablement \& Validation. Global Marketing Measurement (GMM) is a self\-service reporting application that provides marketing teams with timely visibility into Amex Offers campaign performance during and after campaign execution.

title: Program Specialist III
description:
**About The Role**
 The Global Support Operations (GSO) Agent Experience (AX) team is responsible for ensuring Uber's customer support agents have the tools, technology, and workflows needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Obsession (CO), GDX, regional Operations, and our global BPO partners to design, test, deploy, and continuously improve agent\-facing products across Uber's global support network.
   

  

 As a
 **GSO AX Program Specialist III** 
 , you will play a key role in shaping how new products and capabilities translate into effective frontline experiences. You will represent the voice of Operations and our support agents throughout the product lifecycle \- from identifying operational problems and defining business requirements, to validating solutions, leading pilots and Hawk tests, enabling global deployments across our BPO network, measuring impact, and driving continuous improvement.
   

  

 This role goes beyond supporting product launches. You will be expected to
 **own Agent Experience outcomes** 
 , influence cross\-functional product decisions, identify opportunities to improve how agents work, and build scalable approaches that enable Uber to deploy technology effectively across a complex, multi\-vendor global support ecosystem.
   

  

 As a Specialist III, you are expected to operate with a high degree of independence \- owning a portfolio of agent\-facing products or workstreams end to end, setting the approach rather than executing a defined one, and raising the bar for how GSO AX partners with Product and BPOs.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong operational judgment with product thinking, has lived the realities of a BPO/contact center environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and can influence stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, and our global BPO network.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Identify Agent Experience Opportunities \& Define Requirements**
* Partner with Operations, BPOs, Product, and other stakeholders to identify agent pain points, workflow gaps, and opportunities for technology\-enabled improvements.
* Run structured discovery \- agent shadowing, site visits, BPO listening sessions, tech error and UX issue intake \- to ground requirements in real frontline workflows.
* Translate operational needs into clear business requirements, use cases, and success criteria that Product and Engineering teams can act upon.
* Represent the voice of agents and Operations in product discussions and help ensure solutions are designed with frontline workflows in mind.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce agent effort and clicks, and improve the overall agent experience.


**Own Product Readiness, Incubation \& UAT**
* Own the operational readiness of new agent\-facing products and features, from early validation through global launch.
* Develop structured UAT, incubation, and pilot approaches that validate functionality against real\-world agent workflows and edge cases.
* Design and run pilots with BPO sites \- defining scope, agent cohorts, training, entry/exit criteria, and issue triage paths.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and BPO teams to identify issues, prioritize improvements, and determine readiness for broader deployment.
* Ensure learnings from pilots and testing translate into actionable product and operational improvements.


**Drive Product Efficacy \& Impact Measurement**
* Define success measures for new tools and capabilities in partnership with Product and Operations stakeholders.
* Lead Hawk testing and other efficacy assessments to understand how products perform in live operational environments, and own the Go/No\-Go recommendation for wider rollout.
* Evaluate the impact of tools on agent experience and operational outcomes across efficiency (AHT, agent effort), quality (QA score, defect/rework rates), customer experience (CSAT, FCR), and adoption/utilization.
* For AI\-enabled capabilities, measure containment/deflection, suggestion acceptance, answer quality, and escalation impact \- and flag quality or trust risks early.
* Build and maintain your own reporting \- pull and analyze data directly (Google Sheets, SQL, Tableau/Looker, or AI\-assisted analysis) rather than depending on analyst support for routine questions.
* Synthesize quantitative and qualitative insights to support product decisions and go/no\-go recommendations.


**Build the Product\-Operations Feedback Loop**
* Establish strong feedback mechanisms between frontline Operations, BPO partners, GDX, and Product teams.
* Aggregate and prioritize agent and operational feedback to identify recurring product opportunities and systemic issues.
* Convert frontline insights into structured recommendations that influence product roadmaps and future iterations.
* Close the loop with Operations and BPO partners by communicating how feedback has translated into product changes or decisions.


**Influence Through POD \& Cross\-Functional Engagement**
* Represent GSO Agent Experience in PODs and other cross\-functional forums.
* Build trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Customer Obsession, GDX, regional Operations, and BPO stakeholders.
* Advocate for agent needs while balancing product, technical, operational, and business considerations.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders when ownership or solutions span multiple teams, and escalate crisply when decisions stall.


**Enable Global Deployment \& Adoption**
* Partner with regional and BPO stakeholders to develop scalable deployment and adoption strategies for new capabilities across sites, vendors, languages, and lines of business.
* Work with BPO training, quality, and WFM teams to land enablement \- training materials, knowledge updates, floor support, and change communications.
* Monitor adoption and product health across markets and identify barriers to successful utilization.
* Diagnose differences in adoption or performance across regions, vendors, and sites, and develop targeted interventions.
* Capture learnings from deployments and use them to continuously improve future launch approaches.


**Advance AI\-First Agent Experience**
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve agent workflows and the way GSO manages product deployments.
* Support the rollout and evaluation of AI\-enabled support capabilities \- agent assist and copilots, automated summarization, AI\-driven knowledge retrieval, AI QA, and customer\-facing automation \- including how they change the agent's role and required skills.
* Harness AI to develop dashboards, webpages, launch trackers, playbooks, and knowledge assets that improve visibility into product health, launch readiness, and operational performance.
* Translate complex technical and product developments into clear narratives and actionable guidance for Operations and leadership.
* Champion AI\-first ways of working by automating documentation, reporting, analysis, and knowledge management where appropriate.
* Contribute to shaping the future of AI\-enabled customer support and Uber's Agent of the Future .


**What You'll Need**
**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Operations, Operations, Program Management, Customer Support Operations, UAT, or a related field.
* Direct BPO experience: Working within, operations, managing teams, or partnering with outsourced BPO/contact center operations. This includes hands\-on exposure to frontline agent workflows and day\-to\-day site realities (staffing, training, quality, floor support, adherence).
* Demonstrated experience working with external BPO vendors and site leadership to land change: running pilots or UAT with BPO agents, driving tool adoption across multiple sites or vendors, and managing performance conversations grounded in operational data.
* Experience working within customer support, contact center, or other large\-scale operational environments, and familiarity with core support metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, QA score, occupancy, adoption/utilization).
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, and drive solutions across multiple stakeholders with minimal direction.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to combine operational data and qualitative insights into clear recommendations; comfortable working in spreadsheets and dashboards independently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and operational audiences, and to present recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional, multi\-timezone environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive initiatives from problem identification through implementation and measurement.
* Working knowledge of AI\-enabled customer support tools, agent\-assist technologies, and emerging applications of AI in Operations, with practical use of AI tools in your own workflow.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting or owning technology/product launches within customer operations at global scale.
* Experience operating in a multi\-vendor BPO model \- coordinating across several outsourcing partners, sites, and geographies with differing maturity levels.
* Familiarity with BPO commercial and governance constructs (SOWs, SLAs, QBRs, capacity and ramp planning) and how tooling changes affect them.
* Experience translating operational problems into business or product requirements (PRDs, BRDs, user stories).
* Familiarity with UAT methodologies, incubation, experimentation, pilot programs, A/B or holdout testing, and product efficacy measurement.
* Experience partnering directly with Product, Engineering, Design, or Technical Program Management teams.
* Experience evaluating AI/GenAI support capabilities in production \- measuring answer quality, deflection/containment, and agent trust and adoption.
* Experience using data to evaluate product adoption and operational impact; hands\-on with SQL, Tableau, Looker, Google Sheets, or similar.
* Experience developing scalable processes, frameworks, or operating models across multiple markets or teams.
* Experience with knowledge management, agent enablement, or support content operations.
* Demonstrated interest in AI, automation, and the future of customer support.


**Ready to Ride?**
 This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.

 Knowledge Management is a sub\-function within Enterprise Technology Service Management. Our mission is to improve the technology support experience by enabling self\-service, promoting knowledge sharing, and ensuring trusted information is available when and where it is needed.
   

  

 This role will lead the day\-to\-day operations of the Service Knowledge Management function, providing leadership to a global team while partnering with Product Owners, Service Management teams, and technology stakeholders to improve knowledge quality, adoption, governance, and customer experience.
   

  

 This role requires a strong people leader who can build relationships, influence stakeholders, drive accountability, and continuously improve knowledge management practices across a complex and fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, coach, and develop a global team of Knowledge Management professionals.
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance, mentorship, and support to team members.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performing culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Support performance management, career development, and knowledge\-sharing across the team.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex operational and stakeholder\-related matters.


**Stakeholder Management \& Engagement**
* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Service Management teams, support organizations, and technology stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted advisor on knowledge management best practices and standards.
* Influence stakeholders to drive knowledge ownership, accountability, and compliance with established processes.
* Facilitate workshops, training sessions, governance reviews, and stakeholder meetings.
* Promote a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning across the organization.


**Knowledge Management Operations**
* Oversee knowledge lifecycle activities including content reviews, quality assurance, governance, and maintenance activities.
* Ensure knowledge content remains accurate, relevant, and aligned with organizational standards and policies.
* Monitor operational performance and drive remediation of knowledge quality issues, gaps, and risks.
* Coordinate knowledge management activities across multiple product and service teams.
* Support continuous improvement of knowledge processes, standards, templates, and governance practices.


**Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**
* Monitor knowledge consumption, adoption, and quality metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Produce and present operational reporting and insights to stakeholders and leadership.
* Drive initiatives that improve knowledge quality, findability, user experience, and overall program effectiveness.
* Support implementation of new capabilities, tools, and process improvements that enhance knowledge management outcomes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Strong communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and drive positive outcomes across multiple teams.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage competing demands.
* Proactive, solution\-oriented mindset with a focus on execution and results.
* Ability to work effectively within global and culturally diverse teams.


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Experience leading or supervising teams in a global environment.
* Experience managing stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of seniority.
* Experience in Knowledge Management, Content Management, Service Management, or a related discipline.
* Experience working with ServiceNow, preferably within the Knowledge Management application.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.


**Ideally, You'll Also Have**
* Knowledge\-Centered Service (KCS) certification.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher.
* Experience delivering training, communications, or community engagement programs.
* Familiarity with reporting and data visualization tools.
* Experience supporting organizational change or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Understanding of Agile ways of working.


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for a strong team leader with a passion for developing people, building trusted stakeholder relationships, and driving operational excellence.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, leads by example, creates structure and accountability, and can successfully influence diverse teams to achieve common goals. They are equally comfortable supporting day\-to\-day operations and leading initiatives that improve how the organization creates, manages, and shares knowledge.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Mentor and Curriculum Lead
description:
**About CivicDataLab**

 We work at the intersection of data, technology, design and social science to strengthen data for public good ecosystem and citizen participation in governance. CivicDataLab (CDL) harnesses the potential of open knowledge movements to strengthen the data\-for\-public\-good ecosystem and enable citizens to engage in matters of public reform. We work closely with governments, non\-profits, think\-tanks, media houses and universities to enhance their data and technology capacity to better data\-driven decision\-making at scale.
   





 Our current areas of expertise include digital public goods \& infrastructure (DPGs \& DPI), climate action, public finance, urban development, open contracting and law \& justice. We have co\-created digital public goods like open data platforms, data exchanges, AI models and citizen\-led apps for improving participatory data\-driven governance in India and other countries.
   




**What are we looking for**

 CivicDataLab is looking for a
 **Senior Mentor and Curriculum Lead** 
 to support two AI and digital technology cohorts focused on strengthening the capacity of civil society and non\-profit organisations. The role combines
 **curriculum development, training delivery, and hands\-on mentoring** 
 . The Senior Mentor will develop practical AI learning modules, conduct training sessions, and support participating organisations in applying AI and digital tools to their work.
   





 The role will work across two programmes:
   




* **AI and Digital Tools Capacity Building:** 
 Supporting civil society organisations to build practical skills and confidence in using AI and digital tools.
* **Local \& Inclusive AI:** 
 Mentoring NGOs in strengthening and extending their existing AI solutions to better respond to the needs of their users.


 Requirements
   

  


 The Senior Mentor will work closely with the CivicDataLab programme team, subject\-matter experts and participating organisations to ensure that the learning and mentoring is practical, accessible and grounded in real organisational needs.
   





**Key Responsibilities** 
  




* Lead the learning design for both cohorts, translating project objectives and participant needs into module plans, learning outcomes, exercises and assessment approaches.
* Develop curriculum across practical AI and digital tool use for CSOs, including proposal writing and documentation, data analysis and visualisation, digital communication, and workflow management.
* Adapt the learning pathway for different levels of digital literacy. Produce clear facilitator guides, demonstrations, practice materials, tool kits and resources that participants can use after the sessions.
* Work with CDL subject experts, instructional designers and guest facilitators to develop and review content. Prepare facilitators to deliver consistent, useful sessions.
* Personally conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations and hands\-on learning sessions across the two cohorts.
* Guide NGOs through diagnosis of their existing AI solutions, selection of a local\-language or voice use case, technical options, prototyping, user testing and adoption planning. Bring in specialist support where a use case requires it.
* Facilitate selected workshops, mentoring clinics and technical discussions. Help participants apply tools to their own organisational workflows and troubleshoot barriers to use.
* Build responsible AI practices into the curriculum and mentoring, including privacy, consent, bias, safety, human oversight, accessibility and testing with intended users.
* Pilot learning materials and activities, use participant feedback and assessment results to improve them, and prepare editable resources and documentation for reuse.



**Expected Outputs** 
  




* Modular AI and digital learning curriculum.
* Practical AI learning modules and supporting resources.
* Training presentations, exercises, demonstrations and facilitator materials.
* Delivery of in\-person and virtual training sessions.
* Ongoing mentoring and technical support for participating organisations.
* Practical guidance and feedback on AI and digital use cases.
* Documentation of learning, participant experiences and programme insights.
* Reusable knowledge products and resources emerging from the cohorts.



**What is Required** 
  




* At least 3\-5 years of experience in AI or data capacity building, technical mentoring, instructional design, or a closely related field, with substantial experience developing and delivering learning programmes.
* Strong working knowledge of practical AI and digital tools, including their use in documentation, data analysis, communication or organisational workflows.
* Ability to explain technical ideas to non\-technical audiences and design hands\-on learning for participants with different skills, devices and connectivity.
* Experience advising organisations on a technical use case from problem definition through tool selection, testing and adoption. Experience with language technology, voice interfaces or localisation is especially valuable.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, data protection, accessibility and the challenges of deploying technology with communities or frontline teams.
* Strong writing and editorial skills, with a portfolio of learning materials, toolkits, workshops or comparable resources.
* Experience collaborating with subject experts, product teams and programme staff, and the judgement to identify when a specialist should lead a technical decision.
* Experience working with NGOs or other public interest organisations is strongly preferred.


 Benefits
   

  

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity:** 
  

  

  


 We are committed to inclusive hiring and strongly encourage applicants from diverse and underrepresented gender and caste identities and/or socio\-cultural backgrounds to apply.
   

  




**Apply Here:** 
  

  

  


 We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply early! Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

**Other Details:**
  




* ***Duration:***
*6 months (contract\-based)*
* ***Location:***
*Delhi (In\-person)*

description:
**Associate Senior Service Delivery Officer (Regional Partner \& Technology Advocate)**
 Job \#: req38471
   

  

 Organization: World Bank
   

  

 Sector: Information Technology
   

  

 Grade: GG
   

  

 Term Duration: Open\-Ended Staff (OPEN\-OP)
   

  

 Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment
   

  

 Location: New Delhi,India
   

  

 Required Language(s): English
   

  

**Preferred Language(s)**
 Closing Date: 10/12/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
   

  

**Description**
 At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1\.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data\-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who\-we\-are/ibrd
   

  

**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
 The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150\+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload\=9\&v\=VTFGffa1Y7w
   

  

**Department Context**
 The World Bank Group (WBG) is committed to supporting country clients in achieving sustainable development outcomes, including improved health systems, economic growth, education access, climate resilience, and social equity. In this context, digital platforms and data play an increasingly critical role in how development projects are designed, implemented, and adapted.
   

  

 The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables digital enablement of the Bank's business processes through a modern, flexible, and user\-friendly digital platform that integrates and optimizes critical functions for thousands of front\-line staff. It also drives the delivery of AI\-powered business solutions to support business priorities and accelerate data\-driven decision\-making across the institution.
   

  

 To strengthen the feedback loop between the realities on the ground and the digital tools that support operations, ITSOP is seeking a Regional Partner embedded within regional operations. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to task teams, regional leadership, and product teams in identifying opportunities to optimize operations through fit\-for\-purpose technology solutions and smarter business processes.
   

  

 As ITSOP advances the reimagining and modernization of the Operations Workspace and related digital platforms, the Regional Partner will play a critical role in supporting three parallel dimensions of change: sustaining day\-to\-day business operations, helping modernization, promoting and contributing to organizational readiness and adoption, and contributing to strategic transformation initiatives. The role will ensure that regional operational realities, stakeholder needs, and field perspectives are incorporated into the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of future digital capabilities and operating models.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role combines strategic advisory, user and business engagement, and technology enablement, with the goal of helping WBG operations teams implement policies, deliver programs, and scale impact through digital tools and data\-informed practices. This role is part of our commitment to ensuring that digital platforms not only support, but enable operational effectiveness, innovation, and implementation on the ground.
   

  

**The Regional Partner Will Be a**
* Strategic thought partner to regional/country task teams in identifying operational challenges and technology needs.
* Liaison between field realities and the internal product development lifecycle.
* Facilitator of informed decision\-making around digital adoption, technology innovation, and process efficiency.


 This is a solution\-oriented role, requiring strong systems thinking, client orientation, and understanding of both the development context and the possibilities (and limitations) of technology. This role promotes a culture of innovation and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Regional Partner will play a dual\-facing role, working closely with both task teams and regional leadership, and with internal technology and product teams, carrying out the following responsibilities:
   

  

* User and Business Engagement and Operational Insight
* Serve as a trusted advisor to task teams (TTLs), project staff, and regional management on operational technology needs.
* Understand and analyze end\-to\-end business processes across sectors (e.g., health, education) to understand the full context of operations—program goals, delivery challenges, and field constraints, and identify opportunities for efficiency and digital enablement.
* Provide strategic guidance on how existing or new digital solutions can support evolving operational requirements and policy implementation.
* Surface unspoken or emerging needs based on\-the\-ground observation, interviews, and data insights.
* Recommend improvements to business processes through the application of digital tools, automation, or data\-informed workflows.
* Identify patterns or recurring challenges across countries or sectors that can be addressed systemically.
* Advise regional teams on implementation strategies for operational policy changes that require digital adaptation.
* Support regional stakeholders through business and technology transformation initiatives by assessing impacts, gathering requirements, validating future\-state processes, and ensuring operational realities are reflected in transformation planning and execution.
* Technology Advisory and Bridging
* Partner with product managers and solution architects on the design and evolution of digital platforms by providing business context, use cases, and field insights.
* Act as a bridge between regional business teams and central product development teams, translating complex operational problems into clearly scoped technical solutions.
* Evaluate existing technological solutions that may address observed needs, recommend fit\-for\-purpose adaptations where needed.
* Support prioritization by providing business impact framing, user insights, and field validation to product managers.
* Monitor and facilitate technology adoption, performance, and user satisfaction within the region and provide feedback for continuous improvement.
* Change Management and Implementation Support
* Provide thought partnership with regional teams in designing business processes that are both policy\-compliant and technology\-enabled.
* Ensure alignment between institutional operational policies and technical implementation across platforms.
* Work with business and technical teams to promote the adoption of new tools and enhancements, drawing on field insights to shape communication, training, and support strategies.
* Support organizational learning by sharing case studies, user stories, and actionable feedback from the field.
* Support the implementation of new digital tools, features, or policies by facilitating change management, user communication, and engagement activities.
* Performance Monitoring \& Reporting:


 Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for innovative initiatives. Track progress, measure impact, and report outcomes to management.
   

  

* Knowledge Management:


 Document lessons learned, best practices, and case studies. Contribute to the Bank’s innovation knowledge base and support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Selection Criteria
   

  

* Master’s degree in computer science/STEM with 8 years relevant experience or bachelor’s degree in computer science with a minimum of 10 years relevant experience.
* Relevant areas of experience include (i) development or multilateral operations, (ii) technology advisory, consulting, or technology innovation, (iii) digital transformation and large\-scale business modernization initiatives, including organization change and technology adoption, and (iv) field program implementation
* Demonstrated expertise in emerging technologies, systems thinking, acting as a liaison, change management, evangelization, and innovation methodologies (e.g., AI, design thinking, agile)
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* Experience working in large, complex organizations or international development settings
* Familiarity with the World Bank’s operations, governance, and organizational structure preferred
* Understanding of the World Bank’s operational frameworks and platforms (e.g., the Operations Platform) preferred
* Experience in field\-embedded roles that require active collaboration with country teams and task teams in\-region. Multilingual capabilities are a plus.
* Certified in SAFe Agilist, Digital Transformation, Organization Change Management, Design Thinking, or other industries preferred


**Core Competencies**
* Operational Excellence: Deep understanding of business processes related to development operations (e.g., project design, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation). Ability to interpret and apply operational policy in a digital transformation context.
* Client Orientation: Experience working with multidisciplinary teams, including technical teams, field\-based staff, and senior leadership. Deep empathy for field teams and country contexts; able to represent their needs with credibility and nuance.
* Analytical and Systems Thinking: Ability to assess complex operational environments and propose realistic, innovative, and scalable digital solutions.
* Digital Acumen: Familiarity with enterprise platforms, digital transformation, AI, and data\-driven decision\-making; not necessarily a technical expert, but a confident translator of technology for non\-technical audiences.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present technical content to non\-technical audiences. Capacity to write clear documentation, briefs, and presentations tailored to varied stakeholder groups.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, and diverse cultural contexts across geographical boundaries.
* Problem Solving and Innovation: Capacity to ideate and test new approaches; consultative mindset with a strong focus on user value and long\-term impact. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


 As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
   

  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI\-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision\-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict\-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.


**WBG Culture Attributes**
* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.


 World Bank Group Core Competencies
   

  

 WBG Five Managerial Competencies Include only for managerial positions
   

  

 The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.

 *World Bank* 
 and

 including our values and inspiring stories.

title: Content Writer
description:
CONTENT WRITER \& CONTENT STRATEGIST – HITFAME
 
 Location: Delhi NCR
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 Experience: 2–6 Years
 



 Department: Content \& Marketing
 



 Industry: Entertainment \| Media \| Technology \| Creator Economy
 


 ABOUT HITFAME
 
 HitFame is an AI\-powered entertainment and creator growth platform connecting actors, singers, influencers, artists, models, filmmakers, photographers, dancers, and creators with opportunities, collaborations, brands, and the wider entertainment ecosystem.
 



 HitFame enables talent to showcase their work, discover opportunities, build their personal brand, connect with industry professionals, and grow their careers through technology and AI.
 



 As HitFame continues to scale, content will play a critical role in building our brand, engaging our users, driving growth, and establishing HitFame as a strong voice within the entertainment and creator ecosystem.
 


 ABOUT THE ROLE
 
 We are looking for a creative, versatile, and highly driven Content Writer \& Content Strategist who can take ownership of content across the entire HitFame ecosystem.
 



 This is not a role limited to writing blogs.
 



 The person will be responsible for creating content for:
 


* HitFame Mobile App
* Website
* Social Media
* Advertising \& Marketing Campaigns
* News \& Editorial
* Articles \& Blogs
* User Communication
* Push Notifications
* In\-App Communication
* Reels \& Video Scripts
* Brand Communication
* Product Communication
* Subscription \& Conversion Communication



 The ideal candidate should be able to understand a brief, identify the target audience, develop the right messaging, and turn ideas into content that is clear, engaging, creative, relevant, and business\-focused.
 



 You should be equally comfortable writing a high\-converting ad copy, an entertainment news article, an SEO blog, an Instagram caption, an in\-app message, a Reel script, or long\-form industry content.
 


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. 📱 HITFAME APP CONTENT \& PRODUCT COMMUNICATION
 
 The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining high\-quality content across the HitFame mobile application.
 



 This is a core responsibility of the role.
 



 Content responsibilities will include:
 


* App onboarding screens
* Home\-screen content
* Profile\-related prompts
* Feature descriptions
* Opportunity\-related communication
* Premium \& Professional plan content
* Subscription and upgrade communication
* In\-app promotional banners
* In\-app pop\-ups
* Push notifications
* User alerts and announcements
* Empty\-state messages
* Tooltips and in\-app guidance
* User education content
* CTA messaging
* User activation communication
* Engagement and retention communication
* New feature launch communication
* Campaign\-specific in\-app communication
* Messages encouraging users to create content and complete their profiles
* Communication encouraging users to explore opportunities
* Upgrade and conversion communication
* Premium and Professional user journeys
* FAQ and help\-related content



 The candidate must be able to create short, clear, engaging, and action\-oriented microcopy that improves user experience and helps users understand the value of HitFame.
 



 The objective is not simply to put words on a screen.
 



 The candidate should understand:
 



 What should the user see?
 



 What should the user understand?
 



 What action should the user take?
 



 The content should contribute to user experience, engagement, activation, retention, and conversion.
 


 2\. ✍️ ADVERTISING \& MARKETING CONTENT
 * Write compelling ad copies for Meta, Google, YouTube, Instagram, and other digital platforms.
* Develop multiple copy variations for A/B testing.
* Create headlines, hooks, CTAs, descriptions, and promotional messaging.
* Develop conversion\-focused content for HitFame Premium and Professional plans.
* Create content for app downloads, user acquisition, subscriptions, lead generation, and brand campaigns.
* Work closely with the Digital Marketing and Performance Marketing teams on campaign messaging.
* Develop creative concepts and campaign communication.


 3\. 🌐 WEBSITE CONTENT
 
 Take ownership of content across the HitFame website, including:
 


* Homepage
* Landing pages
* Product pages
* Subscription pages
* Feature pages
* Campaign landing pages
* About pages
* FAQs
* User guides
* SEO pages
* Talent\-related pages
* Blog and editorial sections



 Work with the marketing, product, design, and technology teams to ensure website content supports both user experience and business objectives.
 


 4\. 📰 NEWS \& EDITORIAL CONTENT
 
 Develop engaging and publication\-ready entertainment and creator\-economy content, including:
 


* Entertainment news
* Celebrity news
* Industry updates
* Creator economy stories
* Talent\-related stories
* Industry trends
* Interviews
* Explainer articles
* Listicles
* Trending stories
* Opinion\-led articles
* Entertainment features



 The candidate should be capable of researching topics independently and converting them into accurate, engaging, readable, and well\-structured content.
 


 5\. 📝 ARTICLES \& BLOGS
 * Research, write, edit, and publish high\-quality articles and blogs.
* Develop SEO\-friendly long\-form content.
* Conduct basic keyword and topic research.
* Create content around entertainment, creators, talent, social media, technology, AI, career opportunities, and industry trends.
* Maintain editorial quality, accuracy, readability, and consistency.
* Repurpose long\-form content into social posts, reels, carousels, and short\-form videos.


 6\. 📲 SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT
 
 Develop content for HitFame's social media platforms, including:
 


* Instagram
* Facebook
* YouTube
* LinkedIn
* X
* Threads
* Snapchat
* Other relevant digital platforms



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Captions
* Posts
* Carousels
* Reels
* Stories
* Hooks
* Polls
* Engagement content
* Campaign content
* Community communication
* Promotional content

title: Biochemist
description:
**Biochemist – AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
 Your deep expertise in biochemistry is exactly what the next generation of AI needs. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, more scientifically rigorous models — and we need PhD\-level biochemists to make it happen.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your scientific knowledge directly shapes how AI reasons about protein folding, metabolic flux, enzyme kinetics, and beyond. No AI background required — just deep domain expertise and a sharp analytical mind.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Craft advanced biochemistry problems spanning nucleic acid chemistry, proteomics, structural biology, and drug\-target interactions to rigorously test AI performance
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Develop precise, step\-by\-step technical solutions that serve as benchmarks for high\-level scientific reasoning in AI systems
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated biochemical pathways, molecular structures, and mathematical reasoning for technical accuracy and adherence to scientific standards
* Identify and Fix Reasoning Errors — Spot logical flaws like incorrect stoichiometry, misapplied stereochemistry, or flawed mechanistic reasoning, and provide structured feedback to improve AI thinking


**Who You Are**
* PhD\-level expertise in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a closely related field (completed or in final stages)
* Strong foundational knowledge in areas such as structural biology, enzymology, cellular metabolism, or bioinformatics
* Ability to communicate highly technical concepts clearly and concisely in written form
* High attention to detail when reviewing chemical equations, molecular diagrams, and experimental logic
* No prior AI experience required — we'll provide everything you need to get started


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, evaluation, or quality assurance workflows
* Familiarity with computational biochemistry tools such as PyMOL, AlphaFold, or BLAST
* Background in scientific writing, peer review, or technical editing


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and scientists
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and collaboration with a global expert community
* Meaningful impact — your expertise helps ensure AI gets the science right
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

description:
**What you'll own**

 Explain rates, eligibility, fees, loan\-to\-value, balance transfer, and lender differences in language a borrower can use to make a decision. Do not trade precision for a catchy line; say what depends on the person's situation.

 Work with the SEO lead on questions people ask, page structure, keywords and metadata. Write for the reader first, but make the answer easy to find, including when the search begins with a question rather than a product name.

 Take a brief from research to published copy, manage parallel deadlines, edit your own work, and use performance and funnel feedback to improve it. If readers arrive but do not understand or move forward, investigate why.

 Use tools to move faster on outlines and variants. Your judgment stays yours: what to verify, what a borrower needs, and what not to publish.

**Specialist \- Delivery Excellence**

description:

 The Asia Group is now accepting applications for a Sr. Associate, Technology Policy to join our South Asia practice in New Delhi. This position will support the South Asia practice based across New Delhi, Mumbai, and Washington D.C. on The Asia Group’s portfolio of engagements for the AI Impact Summit scheduled in February in New Delhi. 
   

  

 Headquartered in Washington, D.C., The Asia Group (“TAG”) is a strategic and capital advisory firm that positions clients – ranging from Fortune 100 multinationals to innovative startups – for success in established and emerging markets across the Indo\-Pacific region. Our diverse team possesses decades of government and private sector experience with a work ethos that emphasizes teamwork, collegiality, creativity, entrepreneurialism, and mentorship. 
   

  

 Sr. Associate will work closely with the technology team and play key roles in supporting the firm’s research, analysis, and engagement with stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have substantive experience and expertise in the Indian technology and AI policy landscape. Excellent writing skills, the ability to communicate professionally with external stakeholders, and a genuine desire to learn are pre\-requisites.

title: Associate Writer – International University Admissions & Essays
description:
Associate Writer \- University Admissions \& Essays
 
  





 📍
 **Location:** 
 New Delhi
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 0–1 Year \| Fresh Graduates Welcome
 



 🏢
 **Work Mode:** 
 Full\-Time, On\-site
 



 📅
 **Working Days:** 
 Tuesday–Sunday
 



 ✍️
 **Function:** 
 Writing \& Editorial / University Admissions
 



 🎓
 **Focus:** 
 US \& UK University Applications
 



  




 About the Company
 
  





 We are hiring for an established
 **career counselling and global university admissions advisory firm based in New Delhi** 
 .
 



  





 The organization works closely with ambitious students and families to help them navigate academic and career decisions and build compelling applications for highly selective universities across the
 **US and UK** 
 , including Oxbridge and Ivy League institutions.
 



  





 As the organization continues to strengthen its admissions team, it is looking for talented young writers and editors who want to use their writing skills in work that can genuinely influence a student's academic journey.
 



  




 About the Role
 
  





 We are looking for an
 **Associate Writer – University Admissions \& Essays** 
 who has an exceptional command of written English and understands that great writing isn't about making everyone sound the same.
 



  





 You'll work closely with students on
 **personal statements, university essays, SOPs, activity descriptions, CVs and other application material** 
 for universities across the US and UK.
 



 Importantly,
 **you will not write essays for students** 
 . Your role is to help students discover what they actually want to say, structure their thinking, strengthen their drafts and communicate their experiences authentically in their own voice. That's a core principle of the organization's editorial approach.
 



  




 Job Roles \& Responsibilities
 
  




 1\. Student Brainstorming \& Story Development
 
  




* Conduct guided brainstorming sessions with students.
* Help students identify meaningful experiences, perspectives and ideas worth writing about.
* Ask thoughtful questions that help uncover stronger stories.
* Help students translate experiences into clear narrative directions.
* Ensure the student's individual personality and voice remain central throughout the process.



  




 2\. Essay Review \& Feedback
 
  




* Review drafts of university essays, personal statements and SOPs.
* Provide clear, structured and actionable written feedback.
* Identify what is working, what needs improvement and why.
* Help students strengthen structure, argument, storytelling and overall impact.
* Give honest feedback in a constructive way that encourages students rather than discouraging them.



  




 3\. Editing \& Quality Control
 
  




* Line\-edit student writing for clarity, grammar, structure and tone.
* Ensure essays remain within required word and character limits.
* Evaluate whether responses actually address the university's prompt.
* Maintain consistency while preserving each student's natural writing voice.
* Manage multiple drafts, versions and feedback cycles accurately.



  




 4\. University \& Program Research
 
  




* Research universities, academic program, faculty, courses and campus opportunities.
* Help students develop specific and credible
 **“Why this university?”** 
 essays.
* Ensure application writing reflects genuine research rather than generic statements.
* Work with the wider admissions team to understand each student's university strategy.



  




 5\. Complete Application Review
 
  




* Review personal statements, SOPs, essays, activity lists and CVs as part of the complete application.
* Ensure different components complement rather than unnecessarily repeat one another.
* Help maintain a coherent story across the student's overall application.
* Identify inconsistencies, gaps or areas requiring further refinement.



  




 6\. Editorial Research \& Knowledge Building
 
  




* Maintain and contribute to internal prompt banks.
* Build annotated examples and editorial resources.
* Document useful writing and feedback approaches.
* Contribute to style notes and resources that improve editorial quality across the wider team.



  




 Key KPIs
 
  





**Writing \& Editorial Quality** 



* Quality, clarity and usefulness of feedback provided on student drafts.
* Accuracy of grammar, structure, tone and editing.
* Ability to preserve the student's authentic voice while improving their writing.
* Quality and consistency of final application material.



**Student Development** 



* Effectiveness of brainstorming and feedback sessions.
* Ability to help students independently improve their drafts.
* Quality of communication and rapport with students.
* Timely completion of feedback cycles.



**Application Quality** 



* Alignment of essays with individual university prompts.
* Accuracy and specificity of university/program research.
* Consistency across essays, SOPs, activity lists and CVs.
* Adherence to required word limits and deadlines.



**Ownership \& Execution** 



* Ability to manage multiple students and drafts simultaneously.
* Discipline in maintaining document versions and deadlines.
* Responsiveness and follow\-through.
* Attention to detail and minimal avoidable errors.



  




 What We're Looking For:
 
  




* Bachelor's degree completed or completing in
 **2026** 
 ; a humanities background is a plus.
* 0–1 year of experience; exceptional fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* **Exceptional written English** 
 and a natural instinct for editing.
* Strong understanding of tone, structure, grammar and storytelling.
* An ear for individual voice\-you can improve someone's writing without making it sound like you.
* Ability to give honest feedback with tact and empathy.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong discipline around deadlines, word counts and document versions.
* Comfortable using Google Docs, including comments and Suggesting mode.



  




 We'd Especially Like to Hear From You If:
 
  




* You've written for a student publication, journal, magazine or blog.
* You've studied, completed an exchange program or applied abroad yourself.
* You've tutored writing.
* You've participated in debating or MUN.
* You genuinely enjoy reading \- and can probably talk about what you're reading for far too long.



  




 Why Join?
 
  





 This is designed as an entry point into a
 **proper editorial career path** 
 , rather than simply a content\-writing job.
 



  





 You'll begin with structured training in essay strategy, editorial standards and feedback frameworks. You'll then work on real student drafts under the supervision of senior editors before gradually taking ownership of feedback cycles for a small group of students. Strong performers undergo a formal progression review around the 12\-month mark.
 



  





 The organization also offers:
 



  




* Structured training from day one.
* Mentorship from professionals with admissions experience across Oxbridge, Sciences Po and Ivy League institutions.
* A defined progression path:
 **Associate → Editor → Senior Editor → Team Lead/Technical Director** 
 .
* **31 days of annual leave** 
 \- 15 earned, 8 sick and 8 casual.
* Complimentary lunch every Saturday and Sunday.
* The opportunity to do writing work that directly shapes real students' applications and stories.

* Estimation and Cost Engineering
* Construction Materials and Material Management
* Procurement and Contract Management



 Candidates with a
 **B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering combined with strong relevant experience** 
 in Quantity Surveying, Estimation, Contracts, Procurement, Cost Control or Construction Project Management may also be considered.
 



 The educational requirement is important because the Solution Consultant must be able to understand and discuss technical construction workflows and not operate merely as a generic SaaS salesperson.
 


 Core Domain Knowledge Expected
 
 The candidate should have academic or practical understanding of several of the following:
 


* BOQ preparation and interpretation
* Quantity take\-off
* Measurement and quantity reconciliation
* Estimation and costing
* Rate analysis
* Budget versus actual quantities
* Construction specifications
* Material requirement planning
* BOQ\-to\-BOM interpretation
* Material consumption
* Material reconciliation
* Procurement planning
* Purchase requisitions
* RFQs
* Vendor quotations
* Technical and commercial comparison
* Purchase Orders
* Goods Receipt / GRN
* Material inspection
* Vendor management
* Contracts and tendering
* Project planning
* Site execution
* Progress measurement
* Contractor / subcontractor management
* Project cost control



 The candidate does
 **not need operational experience across every area** 
 , but should have sufficient technical grounding to understand these concepts quickly and hold credible discussions with construction professionals.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Understand customer construction workflows, operational pain points, business requirements and commercial objectives.
* Analyse how customers currently manage BOQs, quantities, materials, procurement, project execution, subcontractors, progress and cost control.
* Understand BOQ structures, item descriptions, quantities, units of measurement, specifications, material requirements and their relationship with execution.
* Understand the relationship between:



**BOQ → Quantity → Material Requirement → Procurement → Consumption → Progress → Cost** 



* Develop relevant customer\-specific use cases and solution narratives based on actual construction and business requirements.
* Conduct customised product demonstrations and simulations using realistic construction projects, BOQs, materials and procurement scenarios.
* Configure demo scenarios that reflect the customer's actual operating environment instead of conducting generic feature demonstrations.
* Translate Bildwell's product capabilities into clear operational, financial and commercial value propositions.
* Demonstrate how better quantity visibility, material planning, procurement and execution control can improve project margins and reduce operational leakage.
* Engage with customer teams including founders, CXOs, project heads, quantity surveyors, estimators, procurement teams, commercial teams, project managers and site teams.
* Work closely with Sales to qualify opportunities and identify the customer's actual business problem before proposing a solution.
* Support Sales in solution design, opportunity qualification, proposals and commercial discussions.
* Prepare solution presentations, use cases, demo flows, process diagrams, business scenarios and supporting sales collateral.
* Capture customer feedback, requirements, functional gaps and industry\-specific requirements in a structured manner.
* Translate customer requirements into clear functional requirements for discussion with the Product and Engineering teams.
* Identify whether a customer requirement should be addressed through configuration, workflow changes, product functionality or future product development.
* Build reusable industry\-specific demo scenarios and solution assets for different construction segments.
* Develop expertise across contractor categories such as civil contracting, interiors, fit\-outs, MEP, design \& build, turnkey projects, EPC and other project\-based construction businesses.


 Ideal Profile
 * 3–6 years of experience in SaaS Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, Business Analysis, Product Consulting, Construction Technology, Quantity Surveying, Estimation, Procurement, Project Management or related functions.
* M.Tech / M.E. in Civil Engineering with specialisation in Construction Engineering \& Management, Construction Technology \& Management, Quantity Surveying, Contracts \& Cost Management or a related discipline is strongly preferred.
* Experience in ConstructionTech, PropTech, Construction ERP, Project Management Software or B2B SaaS would be highly valuable.
* Strong understanding of construction workflows involving BOQs, quantities, procurement, materials, project execution and cost control.
* Ability to read and understand a BOQ and discuss its operational and commercial implications.
* Ability to understand construction terminology, quantity logic and procurement workflows without relying entirely on the customer to explain technical concepts.
* Strong analytical ability and structured problem\-solving approach.
* Strong presentation, communication and storytelling skills.
* Ability to understand a business problem and convert it into:



**Problem → Use Case → Workflow → Solution → Demo → Business Value** 



* Comfortable engaging with founders, CXOs, business heads, project teams, quantity surveyors, procurement professionals and functional teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Commercially aware, structured, curious and hands\-on.
* Comfortable working in a growing product company where solution consulting will also contribute to product discovery and market intelligence.


 What This Role Is Not
 
 This is
 **not a scripted product\-demo role** 
 where the candidate simply walks customers through software screens.
 



 The candidate is expected to understand:
 


* What is the customer's current process?
* Where is the operational or commercial problem?
* What construction, quantity or procurement logic is involved?
* How should Bildwell address that problem?
* How should the solution be demonstrated?
* What measurable value can the customer derive from it?


 Success in the Role
 
 The right candidate should be able to move a customer conversation from:
 



**“Here is what the product does.”** 




**to:** 




**“Here is how your current construction, quantity, material or procurement problem can be solved, how the workflow would operate in your business, and what operational or commercial value it can create.”** 




**Over time, the Solution Consultant should become capable of understanding a customer's construction business sufficiently well to design a relevant Bildwell solution without requiring every workflow to be explained by the Product team.** 



 Why Join Bildwell
 
 This role provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of:
 



**Construction Domain Expertise \+ SaaS \+ Business Consulting \+ Product Strategy** 




**You will work directly with customers, Sales and Product teams and help shape Bildwell's solution\-selling methodology, industry use cases and product evolution.** 



* **Join Bildwell and help build the solution\-selling engine for a growing ConstructionTech SaaS business.**

 We're a mental health startup working with the adolescent population, the whole school, and college kids trying to build a support system around young people before a crisis point, not just after one.

title: Senior Program coordinator/ Program Officer - Technical and Operation
description:
**Overview**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

**About The Program**
 Jhpiego provides strategic technical assistance to the Government of India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP) to accelerate TB elimination through health systems strengthening, implementation research, digital innovations, and evidence\-based interventions. Working closely with the Central TB Division (CTD), State TB Cells, the National Health Mission (NHM), and development partners, Jhpiego supports the delivery of high\-quality, people\-centered TB services across the continuum of care.
   

  

 The program implements several national and multi\-state initiatives, including the Pro TB Impact Project, which strengthens TB service delivery at the primary healthcare level by integrating routine TB screening into Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAMs) and maternal health services, promoting differentiated care for high\-risk TB patients, and establishing learning labs to generate evidence for scalable interventions. Jhpiego also leads the Cough Syrup Sales Surveillance Initiative, an innovative pharmacy and AYUSH\-linked surveillance model that leverages digital technologies, community engagement, and referral systems to enable early identification of individuals with presumptive TB and ensure timely linkage to diagnostic and treatment services under NTEP.
   

  

**About The Position**
 Jhpiego is seeking a dynamic and motivated professional to support the implementation and coordination of national and state\-level TB initiatives.
   

  

 The incumbent will provide technical, operational, and program management support across multiple TB projects, ensuring effective implementation in accordance with approved work plans, timelines, donor requirements, and Jhpiego policies. The position requires independent management of assigned workstreams, coordination with government and implementation partners, preparation of high\-quality technical documentation, monitoring of project deliverables, and support for day\-to\-day project operations.
   

  

 The successful candidate should possess strong organizational, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Program Coordination and Implementation Support
* Independently coordinate selected project activities in line with work plans and timelines.
* Track deliverables, identify risks, and proactively escalate delays with recommended mitigation.
* Provide technical and operational support to field teams to ensure activity quality and adherence to standards.
* Contribute to development of technical briefs, implementation notes, and program presentations.
* Stakeholder and Relationship Management
* Liaise with district/state stakeholders, internal teams, and external partners for smooth program execution.
* Build effective working relationships to enable timely communication, joint reviews, and activity follow ‑
* Represent the project in selected technical discussions, review meetings, and coordination forums.
* Meetings, Reviews and Documentation
* Lead coordination of program meetings, technical reviews, and trainings at national/state/district levels.
* Prepare high ‑ quality minutes, tracking sheets, action plans, and follow ‑ up matrices.
* Support development of donor reports (monthly/quarterly/annual), ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Operations, Logistics and Finance Coordination
* Independently handle logistics, and procurement coordination as per organizational
* Track budgets, GRFs, activity expenses, purchase requests, and settlements.
* Maintain updated records of procurements, inventory, and key documentation.
* Monitoring, Data and Knowledge Management
* Maintain trackers, dashboards, and databases for monitoring deliverables and program outputs.
* Support data collation and validation from field teams.
* Document learnings, best practices, and case studies to contribute to knowledge management.
* Other Responsibilities
* Provide cross\-team coordination support for training, workshops, and reviews.
* Undertake additional tasks aligned with project goals as assigned by the supervisor.


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s in business administration/ post graduate diploma/ master’s in social work/ MA/ MCom/ PG Diploma/ MSc or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of relevant experience in program coordination, project management, or implementation support, preferably in public health or development programs.
* Experience working with donor\-funded projects and government stakeholders is desirable.
* Prior experience with the NTEP or TB\-related programs will be an added advantage.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong program coordination and ability to independently manage assigned workstreams.
* Result\-oriented mindset with strong follow\-up and closure skills.
* Excellent relationship management and interpersonal communication.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
