title: Medical Writer
description:
**Job Title: Medical Writer** 




**Total Experience \- 3\+years in corporate sector** 




**Department:** 
 Medical Affairs / Scientific Communications
 



**Education:** 
 MBBS / BDS /MDS
 



**Role Objective / Purpose** 



* To develop high\-quality scientific content and documentation across therapeutic areas by conducting in\-depth literature reviews, synthesizing data, and delivering clear, accurate, and audience\-appropriate materials.
* The role involves contributing to both short\- and long\-term projects in the consumer healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors, including medical, safety, pre\-clinical, clinical, regulatory, educational, and promotional content.
* Additional responsibilities include editing, proofreading, reviewing, referencing, and verifying content to ensure adherence to high medical writing standards.
* The role ensures timely delivery of project milestones while maintaining quality, compliance, and business value.



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Literature Reviews and Evidence Mapping** 



* Conduct comprehensive secondary research/literature reviews and prepare overarching summaries using effective search strategies across scientific databases (e.g., PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library) and open\-source platforms.
* Analyze and interpret clinical and scientific data to extract actionable insights.
* Stay current with trends, treatment guidelines, and regulatory updates in both OTC and Rx domains.



**Medical and Scientific Content Development** 



* Leverage scientific expertise to create high\-quality communication materials in the OTC and Rx space.
* Research, write, edit, organize, interpret, curate, and quality\-check various types of scientific content across multiple formats and channels.
* Prepare, review, and edit a range of scientific documents, including:
* Literature reviews
* Manuscripts for peer\-reviewed journals
* Abstracts, posters, and slide decks for scientific conferences
* Treatment guideline summaries
* Publication summaries and white papers
* Ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and compliance with applicable guidelines (e.g., ICMJE, CONSORT).



**Content Review and Quality Assurance** 



* Review medical, promotional, and scientific materials in accordance with internal SOPs and external guidelines.
* Verify references and ensure content is plagiarism\-free.
* Ensure clear, factual, and effective presentation of data and discussions.
* Maintain and apply templates, formats, and styles to ensure compliance with industry and client standards.



**Project Execution** 



* Understand and define client requirements during project initiation, including objectives and timelines.
* Develop scientifically accurate and medically relevant content across therapeutic areas, adhering to branding and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring quality and client satisfaction.
* Respond to and deliver ad\-hoc client requests within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with medical writing colleagues, the graphics team, and clients as needed.



**Other Responsibilities** 



* **Mentorship:** 
 Actively mentor team members to support effective task execution and goal achievement.
* **Values and Behaviors:** 
 Consistently demonstrate WNS values and foster positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* **Personal Development:** 
 Identify learning and development needs in collaboration with the line manager and pursue relevant training opportunities.



**Key Performance Indicators** 




**Process\-Related** 



* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Quickly build subject matter expertise in assigned therapeutic areas.
* **Efficiency:** 
 Develop effective search strategies, organize data for analysis, and prepare medical and scientific content.
* **Accuracy:** 
 Validate sources, identify data gaps, and ensure scientific rigor.
* **Quality:** 
 Deliver well\-structured, grammatically sound, and visually engaging documents using appropriate templates and tone.



**People\-Related** 



* Demonstrate strong teamwork, collaboration, and professionalism.
* Actively participate in team meetings, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and training initiatives.



**Required Competencies \& Skills** 




**Must Have** 



* Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical, OTC, and consumer healthcare landscape.
* Clear grasp of medical, scientific, and statistical terminology and concepts.
* Robust knowledge of various types of clinical studies, the structure, and formats of different manuscript types (e.g., SLR, TLR, Meta\-analysis), along with their relevance and application in evidence synthesis and utilization.
* Proven experience in scientific writing and literature analysis.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and online research tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking abilities, and the capacity to work independently.
* Demonstrated accountability, adaptability, and effective time management.



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with regulatory documentation and compliance in US/EU markets.
* Exposure to text mining, data visualization tools, and scientific storytelling.
* Experience with reference management (e.g., EndNote, Zotero, Mendeley) and statistical (e.g., RevMan, SPSS, GraphPad Prism, R, SAS) tools.
* Knowledge of proprietary tools such as DataVision, PubPro, and Veeva Vault.

title: EHS and Quality Systems Executive
description:
**About the Organisation** 
 : Karo Sambhav is a leading sustainability and circular economy organization focused on enabling responsible waste management and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance across India. The company works with producers, recyclers, government bodies, and consumers to build transparent, technology\-driven systems for the collection, recycling, and recovery of electronic waste, plastic waste, batteries, and other regulated materials. With a strong focus on environmental impact, compliance, and scalable sustainability solutions, Karo Sambhav helps organizations meet regulatory obligations while driving long\-term circular economy initiatives.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : The Quality Systems \& EHS Executive will lead the Quality Management System (QMS) and certification programs for a high‑volume recycling/ITAD facility in North India. This role ensures compliance with
 **ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3, e‑Stewards, EPR requirements,** 
 and customer‑specific quality protocols, while driving continuous improvement across operations.
 



  





 The position requires strong experience in quality systems, audits, documentation, and regulatory compliance, with the ability to work in fast‑paced recycling environments involving e‑waste, metals, plastics, and IT asset disposition.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Quality Systems \& Certification Leadership** 



* Build, implement, and maintain a robust QMS aligned with ISO 9001 and recycling‑sector standards.
* Lead certification and surveillance audits for
 **ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3,** 
 e‑Stewards, and brand‑mandated audits.
* Own document control: SOPs, WI, formats, change management, training records, and version control.
* Conduct internal audits, supplier audits, and process audits; maintain audit calendars and closure reports.
* Drive CAPA, RCA, FMEA, and PDCA across all departments.
* Ensure material traceability, chain‑of‑custody, downstream vendor compliance, and data integrity for recycling and ITAD workflows.
* Prepare and maintain customer‑facing quality documentation, including compliance reports, certificates, and audit evidence.
* Lead customer audits, brand audits, and OEM compliance reviews.



  





**2\. Regulatory \& Compliance Management** 



* Ensure compliance with E‑Waste Management Rules, Hazardous Waste Rules, EPR obligations, and SPCB/CPCB requirements.
* Maintain risk registers, compliance matrices, and legal registers relevant to North India regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate with SPCB/CPCB, auditors, and brand compliance teams for inspections and submissions.
* Ensure proper documentation for manifest tracking, waste storage, disposal, and vendor approvals.



  





**3\. Operational Quality \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Implement in‑process quality checks, sampling plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards for dismantling, segregation, shredding, and ITAD workflows.
* Collaborate with operations to ensure process standardization, error‑proofing, and adherence to SOPs.
* Use data analytics to track NCR trends, defect rates, process deviations, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead training programs for QMS, audit readiness, documentation discipline, and compliance culture.
* Support digitalization of quality workflows (checklists, dashboards, NCR systems).



  





**4\. EHS Support** 



* Support implementation of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 within the integrated management system.
* Assist in risk assessments, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, and contractor safety.
* Ensure alignment between quality, environmental, and safety documentation.
* Support waste handling, storage, and disposal compliance as per SPCB norms.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* **Mandatory:** 
 Hands‑on experience with
 **ISO 9001** 
 and at least one of:
 **ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3, e‑Stewards, IATF 16949** 
 .
* 5–7 years of experience in quality systems, audits, and compliance in recycling, e‑waste, ITAD, electronics, automotive, or manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of Indian regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with audit management, documentation systems, and QMS software preferred.
* Quality Systems\- ISO 9001, internal audits, CAPA, RCA, FMEA, PDCA.
* Soft Skills \- Documentation discipline, stakeholder management, training, cross‑functional collaboration.
* Compliance \- EPR, e‑waste rules, hazardous waste rules, SPCB/CPCB norms.
* Technical \- SOP writing, sampling plans, inspection methods, traceability.
* Certifications \- R2v3, e‑Stewards, ISO 14001/45001, OEM/brand audits.

title: Investigation Evidence and Documentation Officer
description:
To support PETA India’s Cruelty Investigations Department by carefully reviewing investigation notes, evidence, photos, videos, and related documents; identifying potential legal violations; conducting desk research and helping identify legal, practical, documentation, confidentiality, equipment, or other issues investigators should know before embarking on an investigation; drafting clear factual and legally sound reports; writing and updating departmental SOPs for all areas of investigation work and for the duties carried out by this role; helping ensure that investigation materials are organised, secure, accurate, and useful for legal action, complaints to authorities, campaign work, media outreach, and internal decision\-making; and maintaining investigation equipment so investigators are properly equipped for fieldwork. The position will primarily support investigations and will also assist departments with the organisation and cataloguing of photo and video materials. The role acts as a liaison between the investigators and other departments, keeping confidentiality paramount.
 



**Term of Employment:** 




 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 




 Delhi
 



**Reports To:** 




 Director
 



 Primary Responsibilities and Duties
 



 Investigation Note Review and Evidence Assessment
 


* Review investigators' notes and logs to ensure accuracy, completeness, clarity, and usefulness.
* Flag missing information, inconsistencies, gaps, or issues requiring clarification.
* Review photos, videos, documents, and other evidence to identify key facts and potential violations.
* Identify possible breaches of animal protection laws, regulations, licences, court orders, or related requirements in consultation with supervisors and legal colleagues.
* Support preparation of documentation suitable for complaints, legal review, campaigns, media work, and organisational action.
* Track follow\-up needs, including missing information, evidence, legal concerns, and reporting requirements.



 Pre\-Investigation Research and Preparation
 


* Conduct desk research to support investigations before fieldwork.
* Identify relevant legal, regulatory, licensing, documentation, confidentiality, safety, access, and equipment considerations.
* Research laws, guidelines, court orders, industry practices, locations, entities, complaints, and public records as required.
* Prepare briefs, checklists, questions, and issue summaries to guide investigators.
* Help ensure investigators understand relevant legal considerations.
* Update plans, SOPs, templates, and checklists based on recurring issues and lessons learned.



 Report Drafting and Case Documentation
 


* Draft clear, factual investigation reports, summaries, timelines, factsheets, evidence lists, and briefing documents.
* Prepare materials for legal, media, campaign, government, and internal purposes.
* Ensure reports remain evidence\-based and free from speculation.
* Obtain missing details required to make reports complete and credible.
* Assist with materials for complaints, legal notices, letters, campaign proposals, media pitches, and related actions.
* Maintain organised records of reports, evidence references, correspondence, and supporting documents.



 SOP Development and Process Documentation
 


* Develop, update, and maintain SOPs covering investigations, desk research, evidence handling, reporting, filing, confidentiality, equipment use, and cross\-department coordination.
* Create and maintain checklists, templates, logs, instructions, and guidance documents.
* Work with investigators, legal colleagues, and departments to ensure SOPs reflect current practices and requirements.
* Review SOPs regularly and incorporate lessons learned.
* Ensure access to current SOPs, templates, filing guidance, and procedures.



 Investigator and Department Liaison
 


* Serve as a liaison between investigators and departments regarding information, evidence, documents, photographs, videos, and follow\-up requests.
* Help ensure investigation findings are understood and used responsibly.
* Clarify evidence and documentation requirements for legal, campaign, media, and advocacy purposes.
* Limit circulation of sensitive materials to authorised individuals and maintain confidentiality.
* Track and coordinate cross\-department requests.



 Investigation Equipment and Field Readiness
 


* Maintain investigation equipment and supplies.
* Manage inventory of cameras, phones, recording equipment, batteries, chargers, storage devices, and related materials.
* Ensure equipment is functional, charged, labelled, accounted for, and field\-ready.
* Coordinate repairs, replacements, purchases, returns, storage, and sign\-outs.
* Track issued equipment and follow up on missing, damaged, or faulty items.



 Evidence and Investigation Material Management
 


* Organise, label, index, and maintain investigation\-related photos, videos, documents, notes, and logs.
* Maintain filing systems, folders, indexes, spreadsheets, and records.
* Review visual materials to identify evidence, locations, dates, species, violations, and source information.
* Preserve original files, supporting notes, copyright information, and context.
* Ensure sensitive materials are securely stored and accessible only to authorised personnel.



 Photo and Video Library Support
 


* Support organisation and filing of photographs, videos, captions, and related materials.
* Assist other departments with photo and video organisation when required.
* Ensure files include source, date, location, ownership, copyright, permissions, and usage restrictions where available.
* Create searchable filing systems by issue, species, location, case type, department, campaign, or source.
* Help colleagues locate suitable materials while complying with approval, copyright, usage, and confidentiality requirements.
* Ensure sensitive, graphic, restricted, or copyrighted materials are handled appropriately.



 Legal, Campaign, and Cross\-Department Support
 


* Work with supervisors and legal colleagues to assess potential cruelty, illegal activity, improper practices, or non\-compliance.
* Prepare factual summaries, factsheets, and briefings for internal and external use.
* Support complaints, advocacy, corporate outreach, government engagement, media initiatives, and public awareness efforts.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding investigations, sources, whistleblowers, evidence, operational plans, unpublished materials, and internal discussions.



 General
 


* Follow all organisational policies, confidentiality requirements, and SOPs.
* Maintain accuracy, professionalism, discretion, and sound judgement.
* Work responsibly with sensitive or graphic materials involving animal cruelty.
* Manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
* Perform other duties assigned in support of investigations, evidence management, SOP development, equipment readiness, desk research, and animal protection work.



 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in law, criminology, journalism, public policy, social work, animal protection, communications, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in investigations support, research, legal research, case documentation, evidence review, reporting, advocacy, journalism, NGO work, SOP development, equipment coordination, or similar fields preferred.
* Excellent written English with strong report\-writing and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical ability to identify facts, gaps, inconsistencies, research needs, and potential legal or cruelty\-related issues.
* Knowledge of animal protection laws and enforcement processes in India preferred, or willingness to learn.
* Strong organisational skills with experience managing digital files, SOPs, records, and equipment inventories.
* Good judgement, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information.
* Ability to work with disturbing or graphic materials.
* Strong computer skills, including shared drives, spreadsheets, document\-management systems, and photo/video filing systems.
* Ability to work effectively across departments.
* Fluency in English required; Hindi and/or other Indian languages desirable.
* Support for PETA India's philosophy and ability to advocate professionally for its positions.
* Adherence to a healthy vegan lifestyle.
* Commitment to the organisation's objectives.



**How to Apply:** 




 To apply for a position with People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) India, please complete this form.

title: Manager, Knowledge Management Services, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work \- guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic, self\-motivated knowledge management professional to join our growing KM Services team. As part of A\&M’s Global AI and Knowledge Organization, KM Services is at the center of an exciting firm\-wide transformation in how A\&M works and derives value from its intellectual property. The team is focused on building a mature knowledge management practice, including strengthening relationships with business stakeholders; breaking down siloes; and improving how consulting teams capture, organize, share, and find critical knowledge. In addition to supporting people\-to\-people and people\-to\-content use cases, the team has a critical role in building the data and information layer needed to power business\-relevant AI agents and tools. The successful candidate will own the KM relationship for a portfolio of India business units, partnering closely with those businesses to improve their existing KM processes, understand their evolving needs, and connect them to the global KM strategy and toolkit. This is a high\-visibility role for someone who wants to help business units get more value from their knowledge while also contributing directly to global KM and AI initiatives. The role will report to the EMEA \& India KM Services Director
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Partner with A\&M Business Units on KM Initiatives
* Own the day\-to\-day KM relationship for India business units, with the opportunity to expand the portfolio over time
* Serve as the primary liaison between assigned business units and the central KM team, identifying opportunities to extend each business unit’s use of KM services and maximize KM adoption and value
* Lead projects to build and refine business\-unit KM processes and tools, including coordinating timelines and partnering with KM services, KM technology, and other corporate groups on execution
* Monitor and provide routine support for business\-unit KM processes and tools (e.g., knowledge libraries, taxonomies, capture processes, search, and communities)
* Provide advice and recommendations to business units based on internal and external KM best practices.
* Contribute to KM Knowledge and Expertise
* Partner with KM colleagues to design and build global capabilities and tools (e.g., expert profiles, conversational knowledge search, agentic knowledge capture) and help extend them to new areas of the business
* Support KM team members on initiatives both within and beyond the immediate region, contributing to a cohesive global KM capability
* Share knowledge of processes, approaches, methods, and tools/platforms with team colleagues so the team can leverage its collective experience across the globe
* Provide insight into business needs, initiatives, and end\-user experience to help ensure global KM service offerings remain relevant and aligned to overall strategy
* Support the growth and evolution of the KM team by applying KM best practices in ways that strengthen the success of the overall KM support model
* AI Risk \& Audit
* Identify internal and external KM trends and best practices; communicate and promote these to business\-unit KM contacts
* Champion KM best practices and encourage knowledge sharing and adoption of new tools throughout the region and firm


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in a knowledge management role
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent work/technical experience in Business Studies, Business Administration, or Management
* Experience leading projects from inception to completion, including collaborating with stakeholders on timelines and expectations and handling change management
* Experience in a professional services or consultancy firm
* Proven experience working with professionals of all staff classes, up to C\-level
* Experience with KM technology (e.g., SharePoint libraries, AI\-enabled search and discovery tools)
* Fluent English required. Additional languages (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean) are a plus but not required
* Consultative approach when partnering with the business
* Experience with KM and content management approaches (e.g., communities, skills and experience platforms, document libraries, taxonomy and metadata, search, curation, content analytics)
* Analytical reasoning and solution\-focused problem solving, with the ability to connect the dots and scale KM efforts across a portfolio of business units
* Capable of synthesizing information and driving results in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to balance multiple projects and prioritize effectively
* Excellent communication and listening skills, with the ability to present complex ideas and solutions to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated history of operating with urgency, responsiveness, and a client\-first focus
* Exceptionally close attention to detail
* Resilience and an ability to persevere in order to break down resistance and accomplish long\-term goals


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

description:

 Experience: 1–3 years
 



 Salary: Upto ₹6 LPA (depending on experience and skills)
 



  





**About MatchToCollege** 




 MatchToCollege is an AI\-powered higher education and career discovery platform helping students discover colleges, universities, courses, entrance exams and career opportunities.
 



  





**We are looking for a Content Writer who understands both content and SEO and can create accurate, engaging, student\-focused content that performs on Google.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Create high\-quality, original and engaging content for
 **college/university listings, blogs, admissions campaigns, social media and marketing materials** 
 .
* Research and write content related to
 **courses, programs, admissions, eligibility, campus life, placements, student experiences and career opportunities** 
 .
* Develop SEO\-friendly
 **blogs, landing pages, FAQs, course descriptions, college pages and other website content** 
 .
* Create content around
 **MBA, BBA, MCA, BCA, B.Com, CAT, CUET, NEET, higher education, admissions, colleges, universities and careers** 
 .
* Conduct thorough research and ensure all education\-related information is
 **accurate, relevant and up to date** 
 .
* Write student\-focused content that is clear, informative and aligned with MatchToCollege's brand voice.
* Conduct
 **keyword research, search\-intent analysis and competitor/SERP research** 
 before developing content.
* Identify content opportunities based on
 **search volume, ranking potential, student queries and content gaps** 
 .
* Create SEO\-friendly
 **titles, H1/H2/H3 structures, meta titles, meta descriptions, FAQs and URL slugs** 
 .
* Optimise existing content to improve
 **Google rankings, impressions, CTR and organic traffic** 
 .
* Understand and monitor
 **Google Search Console data** 
 , including clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and indexing status.
* Identify basic
 **indexing, duplicate\-content, internal\-linking and technical SEO issues** 
 and coordinate with the SEO/technical team.

 **internal linking** 
 between relevant college, course, exam and article pages.

* Interview
 **faculty, students, alumni and industry professionals** 
 when required and convert insights into compelling content.
* Develop
 **social media copy, campaign content, emailers and video/YouTube scripts** 
 as required.
* Edit and proofread content for
 **grammar, clarity, consistency, readability and factual accuracy** 
 .
* Use AI\-assisted content tools responsibly for
 **research and drafting** 
 , while maintaining originality, accuracy and human editorial quality.
* Manage multiple content assignments and consistently deliver
 **high\-quality work within deadlines** 
 .



  





**🔍 SEO \& Technical Knowledge Required** 




  





 The candidate should have practical understanding of:
 



  





**Keyword Research** 



* Primary \& secondary keywords
* Long\-tail keywords
* Search volume
* Search intent
* Keyword difficulty
* Keyword mapping
* Competitor keyword research



  





**On\-Page SEO** 



* SEO titles
* Meta descriptions
* H1/H2/H3 structure
* URL slugs
* Internal linking
* Image optimisation
* FAQs
* Content optimisation



  





**Google Search** 



* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics / GA4
* Indexing and de\-indexing
* Search queries
* Impressions
* Clicks
* CTR
* Average position
* Organic traffic
* Ranking analysis



  





**Basic Technical SEO** 



* Sitemap
* Robots.txt
* Canonical tags
* Duplicate content
* Thin content
* Crawl/indexing basics



  





**🎓 Desired Skills** 



* Excellent written and verbal
 **English communication** 
 .
* Strong
 **research, storytelling and proofreading** 
 skills.
* Good understanding of
 **SEO and digital content** 
 .
* Ability to simplify complex academic information for
 **students and parents** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **student search behaviour and education\-related queries** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **WordPress/CMS** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **Google Search Console and Google Analytics** 
 .
* Familiarity with SEO/content tools such as
 **Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Keyword Planner, etc.**
* Ability to work with large volumes of content without compromising quality.
* Strong attention to detail and factual accuracy.
* Experience in the
 **education/college/EdTech sector** 
 will be an added advantage.



  





  





**⭐ What We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking for someone who only knows how to write good English.
 



  





**We want someone who thinks beyond writing:** 




 What is the student searching for?
 



 Why are they searching for it?
 



 What keywords have search demand?
 



 What is Google currently ranking?
 



 What information is missing?
 



 How can we create something more useful?
 



  





**For us, content is not just about publishing articles.** 




  





**Content \= Search Demand \+ Student Intent \+ Accuracy \+ SEO \+ Business Impact.** 




  





 📊 How We'll Measure Success
 



 Your performance will not be measured only by the number of articles published.
 



  





 We'll look at:
 



**Content Quality \+ Indexing \+ Rankings \+ Impressions \+ Clicks \+ CTR \+ Organic Traffic \+ Student Engagement**

 You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:

The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management, continuous improvement, and operational health of the learning technology stack that powers learner experiences and program delivery.
   

  

 This includes supporting the LMS, key SaaS integrations (e.g., Marketo), reporting and data flows, and custom operational tooling.
   

  

 You will work closely with programming teams, vendors, and firm Learning Technology colleagues to gather requirements, identify enhancement opportunities, maintain platform reliability, and coordinate delivery of technical improvements. You will help define and maintain the product roadmap for the GSR learning technology ecosystem, recommending priorities and enhancements based on user needs, operational considerations, and platform opportunities. You will help with major roadmap decisions, strategic tradeoffs, and platform evolution initiatives will be developed in partnership with and syndicated through the Learning Technology team to ensure alignment with broader firm technology strategy. Your success requires strong technical judgment, effective vendor and stakeholder coordination, and the ability to balance operational excellence with continuous platform improvement in support of the Global Social Responsibility (GSR) mission\-driven learning programs.
   

  

 You will support platform performance, resilience, integrations, security, and vendor\-orchestrated delivery while partnering across program teams, firm functions, and external providers to deliver a high\-quality learner experience at scale.
   

  

 You will help define and maintain the technical product roadmap across the LMS, integrations, reporting, and operational tooling by gathering requirements, prioritizing enhancements, evaluating technical solutions, identifying automation and process improvement opportunities, assessing risks and dependencies, and contributing recommendations for future platform capabilities in partnership with the Learning Technology Product Manager.
   

  

 You will serve as the day\-to\-day steward of the GSR learning technology ecosystem by monitoring platform health, coordinating incident response, supporting root\-cause analysis, maintaining visibility into operational risks and dependencies, and driving continuous service improvement.
   

  

 You will support learner, program, and operational data flows by translating reporting requirements into technical solutions, improving data quality and reporting usability, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
   

  

 You will manage day\-to\-day platform operations, including configuration, integrations, release coordination, change management, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and lightweight technical enhancements while improving platform maintainability and supporting adoption of new capabilities.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary day\-to\-day contact for technology vendors by coordinating issue resolution, managing vendor\-delivered enhancements, monitoring service performance, supporting sourcing and renewal decisions, and ensuring alignment with firm technology governance, architecture, and security standards.

title: Senior Specialist- Value Chain Optimisation
description:

 As a Senior Specialist in Value Chain Optimization, you will be a key member of our Global team, focusing on technology solutions and proprietary hardware. Your role will have a broad impact across the technology value chain, where you will:
   

  

* 
+ Implement governance for Value Engineering (VE), Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analyses (FMECA), and Root Cause Analyses (RCA), including reporting standards, follow\-up actions, and handover processes after project completion.
+ Prepare management reports and decision materials for VE, FMECA, and RCA projects.
+ Drive VE initiatives across the portfolio to reduce costs and lead times for technology offerings.
+ Lead hardware robustness initiatives with experts from Global Supply, Global Commercial, and Research and Development (R\&D), including Technology Product Managers, Technology Chief Engineers, Technology Managers, and other specialists.
+ Facilitate RCA sessions to identify root causes, mitigation, and prevention measures for complex problems or critical customer complaints.
+ Train and coach colleagues in facilitation and application of Value Chain Optimization methodologies, ensuring knowledge transfer and capability building across the organization.


 Your work will directly support the optimization of our technology value chain, enhance project outcomes, and strengthen our ability to deliver innovative solutions to customers worldwide.
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 To thrive in this position, you will combine a strong technical foundation with excellent interpersonal and organizational skills. You are comfortable navigating complex technical, industrial, or engineering environments and have a track record of facilitating collaboration and driving results across diverse teams.
   

  

**Specifically, You Will Bring**
* 
+ Proven experience in facilitation, networking, project controls, project support, or management reporting.
+ Strong stakeholder management, cross\-functional communication, and presentation skills.
+ Deep understanding of governance, reporting, risk management, and follow\-up processes.
+ Hands\-on experience leading Value Engineering (VE), Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analyses (FMECA) initiatives.


 Your approach is structured and analytical, yet proactive, enthusiastic, and pragmatic. You are skilled at building relationships, mentoring, and coaching others, with expertise in Lean and systematic problem solving. Your ability to create structure across multiple projects and interfaces sets you apart.
   

  

 Additionally, you are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with Power BI, SAP, or similar tools is an advantage. A relevant degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, and formal training in facilitation methodologies or portfolio management will be considered beneficial.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
 At Topsoe, we’re problem solvers. In every role, across every office, you’ll find people passionate about finding the right answers. For over 80 years, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, always focused on solving some of the world’s biggest challenges together. We believe great results start with collaboration and respect, where every idea is heard and can drive real change. You’ll join a team of dedicated experts, united by a commitment to perfecting our craft and delivering real impact. We don’t just promise change – we make it happen.  We prioritize the safety and well\-being of our employees and are committed to maintaining a safe work environment where everyone looks out for each other's health and safety

As part of this collaborative and innovative group, you will help optimize the value chain across complex technology deliveries—from engineering design and proprietary hardware to site services, commissioning, and start\-up support. Working closely with Research and Development (R\&D) and cross\-functional teams, you will contribute to scaling innovative solutions within Low Carbon, Renewables, and Clean Air. Our team's success is built on strong technical expertise, a commitment to continuous improvement, and the drive to enhance capabilities, efficiency, and competitiveness across the global value chain.
   

  

**How You Can Apply**

**Application deadline:** 
 07\-10\-2026
   

  

 You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
   

  

 To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

 Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

 We offer world\-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low\-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

title: Senior Associate, Knowledge Management, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work \- guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 At Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M), the Senior Associate, Knowledge Management drives data discoverability through AI by managing complex metadata ecosystems across cloud\-based platforms. Operating from our Delhi Global Capability Center (GCC), this professional ensures that high\-value professional services knowledge assets remain flawlessly structured, compliant, and searchable across diverse environments during continuous platform migrations and enrichment exercises. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between structured library taxonomy and cloud data architecture, managing metadata lifecycles across collaborative, storage, and data warehouse layers
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Vendor Assessment \& Enterprise Implementation: Advise on and actively participate in vendor assessments, evaluations, and enterprise\-wide implementations of taxonomy, ontology, and graph management systems
* Knowledge Graph Development: Design, build, and scale semantic knowledge graphs to map interconnected business concepts, industry verticals, and global advisory practices
* Taxonomy\-to\-Ontology Management: Transform flat data taxonomies into complex ontologies by defining, maintaining, and governing relationships, classes, and properties between distinct digital assets
* Multi\-System Metadata Management: Design, map, and enforce metadata schemas across fragmented repository layers including SharePoint Online, Snowflake, Box, and others as identified in day\-to\-day operations
* Metadata Migrations: Plan, execute, and validate metadata migrations between and within cloud platforms, ensuring zero data loss, schema alignment, and continuous asset taxonomy
* System Interoperability: Coordinate cross\-platform indexing to ensure assets stored across relational data warehouses (Snowflake), content repositories (Box), and collaboration hubs (Teams/SharePoint Online) remain structurally unified
* Data Cleansing \& Reconciliation: Audit existing datasets to correct broken inheritance, fill missing metadata fields, and harmonize legacy taxonomies with global master data standards


**Qualifications**
* Experience Level: 3–5 years of direct metadata, semantic web, or data migration experience is required; 5\+ years is highly preferred
* Education: Bachelor’s degree required. Completed or ongoing Master’s\-level coursework in Library \& Information Science (MLIS), Information Technology, Data Management, or a related technical discipline is highly preferred
* Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to effectively interface, interview, and collaborate with subject\-matter experts across a wide variety of consulting specializations (e.g., corporate restructuring, transaction advisory, private equity)
* Semantic Capabilities: Solid understanding of semantic web concepts (such as RDF, OWL, SKOS, or graph structures) to manage relational data modeling.
* System Expertise: Proven experience managing metadata structures within SharePoint Online (Managed Metadata Service), Snowflake (object tagging/data cataloging), and Box (custom metadata templates)
* Migration Tooling Collaboration: Familiarity collaborating with technical IT/infrastructure resources to manage mapping configurations via Sharegate or similar migration software (direct standalone administration of these engineering tools is not required)
* Coding/Scripting (Optional): Prior coding experience (such as SQL for Snowflake environments, PowerShell, or graph query languages like SPARQL/Cypher) is an asset but not required.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

 Duration of Position : 06 Months or co\-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier
   

  

**Brief On The Organization**
 The Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) is working towards building a healthier India. It is helping to address the limited institutional and systems capacity in India by strengthening education and training, advancing research and technology and facilitating policy and practice in the area of Public Health. PHFI is headquartered in New Delhi with national presence through its constituent units of regional Indian Institutes of Public Health (IIPHs) and Centers of Applied Research in core public health themes. The Foundation, established in 2006 as a public private initiative, is governed by an independent board comprising of senior government officials, eminent Indian and International academic and leaders, civil society representatives and corporate leaders. For more information, please visit the website w
 **ww.phfi.org** 
 .
   

  

**Project Brief**
 The Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) serves as a Sub\-Recipient (SR) under the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GFATM) for the period April 2024 to March 2027, to implement key capacity\-building initiatives under the National AIDS Control Program Phase V (NACP\-V). The project officially commenced on May 1, 2024\. PHFI is responsible for implementing activities under three major components:
   

  

* SR Activity Management HUB
* Capacity Building – Central Region
* Capacity Building – North Region


 As the SR for the SR Activity Management HUB, PHFI will manage and coordinate sub\-recipient activities and provide institutionalized oversight and technical support. This includes performance monitoring, financial management, risk mitigation, and facilitating capacity\-building interventions. The HUB plays a critical role in ensuring horizontal integration at the SACS and NACO levels and acts as a central technical agency for strengthening community systems (CSS), DISHA, and community\-led monitoring (CLM).
   

  

 In the Central and North Regions, PHFI will directly implement capacity\-building activities in line with the project agreement and work plans. These include training, technical assistance, and supportive supervision aimed at enhancing service delivery in HIV prevention, care, and support. The SR ensures effective resource management, collaboration with the Principal Recipient (PR) and stakeholders, and alignment of programmatic goals across all implementation sites.
   

  

 PHFI’s role across these three components emphasizes accountability, technical excellence, and a coordinated approach to achieving the goals of the HIV program under GFATM.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Coordinator (Capacity Building Unit) supports the planning, coordination, implementation, and monitoring capacity\-building initiatives under the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) and other public health projects. The Associate Coordinator will also assist in monitoring project progress, facilitating communication among stakeholders, contributing to data analysis and report reporting.
   

  

**Deliverables**
* Support the planning, coordination, and implementation of national, regional, state, and district\-level capacity\-building activities, including training, workshops, orientations, and review meetings.
* Coordinate with National Program Divisions, State AIDS Control Societies (SACS), government departments, implementing partners, technical agencies, and other stakeholders to facilitate timely execution of project activities.
* Assist in developing, reviewing, updating, and disseminating training curricula, facilitator guides, participant handbooks, presentations, job aids, and other learning resources.

* Maintain an updated evidence and learning bank to support proposal development and strategic program discussions.

* Support effective utilization of program budgets and track significant variances, risks and implementation implications.
* Work with relevant teams to ensure that implementation learning and emerging challenges are documented and translated into actionable improvements.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  





**Required:** 




  




* Master’s degree preferred in Education, Development Studies, Public Policy, Management, Communications or a related field.
* 7–12 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in program implementation, program management, proposal development, fundraising, consulting, development sector or related fields.
* Demonstrated experience of managing or coordinating large\-scale programs/projects involving multiple locations and stakeholders.
* Strong demonstrated experience in proposal writing and concept note development, including the ability to independently develop high\-quality narrative content.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong ability to synthesize complex information into clear, structured and compelling documents.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and coordinating multiple inputs to deliver time\-bound outputs.
* Strong analytical, project management and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with budgets, implementation plans, project trackers and performance reports.
* Strong proficiency in preparing presentations, briefing notes, reports and other professional communication materials.
* Experience in the development/social impact/education sector would be an advantage.

* Excellent writing and communication: Able to develop clear, compelling and well\-structured proposals, concept notes and program documents.
* Structured thinker: Able to break down complex problems, connect information across functions and develop practical solutions.
* Strong project management: Able to manage multiple priorities, timelines, stakeholders and deliverables simultaneously.
* Collaborative and influencing: Comfortable working across functions and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
* Analytical and detail\-oriented: Able to work with qualitative and quantitative information and identify key insights, gaps and risks.
* Proactive problem solver: Anticipates implementation challenges and takes initiative to address them.
* Adaptable and resilient: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and tight deadlines.
* High ownership and accountability: Demonstrates discipline, follow\-through and commitment to quality.
* Passion for equity and education: Strong alignment with Room to Read’s mission of improving learning outcomes and advancing gender equality.

**Room to Read is a child\-safe organization; all personnel are expected to adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy and Child Protection Code of Conduct.**

 • Collect and analyze data from various sources to support research initiatives related to economic and trade policies, industry trends, global economic forecasts. • Conduct in\-depth research and data analysis for the focus areas. • Contribute to the creation of research reports, policy papers, and articles of the highest quality and relevance. • Organize, manage, and document research materials to support ongoing projects at CRF. • Provide logistical and administrative support for events, seminars, and workshops.

**Rotary International Overview**
 Rotary unites people from all continents and cultures who take action to deliver real, long\-term solutions to pressing issues facing our communities. Each year, Rotary members invest more than $300 million and 16 million volunteer hours to improve lives and create positive change in the world. In exchange for hard work and dedication in support of Rotary’s clubs and humanitarian initiatives, our employees receive competitive salaries, flexible schedules, comprehensive benefits, and job enrichment. To learn more, visit http://www.rotary.org.

* Encouraging our employees to demonstrate accountability and a proactive attitude.
* Being professional in our interaction with customers
* Respecting, recognizing and appreciating individual performance while working in a team.

 As a global network that strives to build a world where people unite and take action to create lasting change, Rotary values diversity and celebrates the contributions of people of all backgrounds, regardless of their age, ethnicity, race, color, abilities, religion, socioeconomic status, culture, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.
   

  

**General Overview**
 Manage the end\-to\-end approval, documentation, due diligence, and processing of CSR projects, including due diligence of club and project compliance, accurate and sending timely information for booking of corporate contributions, coordination with internal teams, and facilitating disbursement of approved grant payments.

* Thinking critically and be a problem solver.
* Being Team\-oriented and able to work independently.
* knowledge of computer applications (Word, Excel and other applicable programs).
* Written and oral communication
* Public speaking
* Showing attention to detail
* Good knowledge of managing corporate contracts
* Able to manage the load at peak period


**You Are Open To**
* Travel


**You Will Be Responsible For**
* Review the grant proposal received from the corporate and/or a Rotary club or district through the designated software/platform or pre\-approval process. Assess project relevance, beneficiary need, budget reasonableness, measurable outcomes, sustainability and alignment with CSR requirements and RFI policies.
* Maintaining CSR data up to date for data analysis and team reporting
* Review and approve CSR India grant applications, ensuring that all required compliance and supporting documentation is complete before approval.
* Develop a business presentation tailored to business requirement along with RFI due diligence with donors highlighting RF(I) projects and expertise in handling the projects.
* Work with the corporate and/or Rotary clubs and districts in finalizing the MOUs and statutory agreements. Meeting with donors to finalize and cease the clauses as per the current guidelines
* Works with Rotary Zonal/regional and district leadership to strengthen Rotarian’s knowledge of Foundation programs, particularly CSR specific projects in the region.
* Develops and delivers presentations at Regional, Zonal, District and club events and other meetings as assigned.
* Review and approve of the CSR India grants application and make sure all the compliance requirements are met
* Whet the agreements between corporate and RFI as also implementing club(s) in case of a tripartite agreement before putting up to Secretary, RFI for signatures on behalf of RFI.
* Work in tandem with the Financial Services (FS) team at SAO for contribution booking and grant payment processing as required.
* Ensure accurate and timely booking of corporate contributions and facilitate the timely processing and disbursement of approved grant payments.
* Ensure that all statutory, financial and program documentation is complete and properly maintained for audit and compliance purposes.
* Respond to CSR grant queries from Rotarians and coordinate all the activities between WHQ staff (if any) and project contacts.
* Works with club/ districts to resolve all outstanding issues for project approval and make sure grants are compliant \& complete. Follow through with the clubs/district to expedite the pending documents/information.
* Work closely with grants team on the overdue reports for new application approvals
* Provide timely updates to corporate donors for all grants funded by them.
* Be thoroughly informed on current Rotary Foundation programs and policies with a view to providing accurate information to Rotarians, Rotary Senior and zonal Leaders and HQ colleagues.
* To develop CSR resources like Newsletter, Annual Report, RFI website and CSR Brochure
* Work closely with the reporting manager to understand the priority tasks and manage in coordination with the team
* Adhere to team benchmarks
* Other duties as assigned.


**Leadership Attributes**
* Engagement: Foster relationships by hearing, recognizing, and valuing others.
* Communication: Be open to receiving ideas from diverse viewpoints and able to communicate messages so that they are universally understood.
* Productivity: Able to generate results that moves Rotary toward achieving its goals.
* Accountability: Have a clear sense of ownership and take personal responsibility for actions.
* Innovation: Move Rotary beyond traditional ways of thinking
* Adaptability: Respond to changes willingly and recognize when to adjust based on the situation.

 Rotary does not provide VISA sponsorship or relocation assistance.

title: Consultant, Biodiversity
description:
**ERM** 
 is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
   

  

 Our
 **Consulting Delivery Hub** 
 (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high\-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
   

  

 As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
   

  

**Why this role matters?**
 As a
 **Biodiversity Consultant** 
 , you will support ERM's global Capital Project Delivery (CPD) work by delivering discrete biodiversity workstreams and producing high\-quality baseline, impact assessments and reporting outputs across major infrastructure, renewables, transmission \& distribution, hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage, mining and diversified energy projects. You will work within the CPD Nature \& Biodiversity sub\-team. This role is critical to scaling ERM's biodiversity delivery capacity.
   

  

**What your impact is?**
* Deliver biodiversity baselines and ecological impact assessment chapters that meet UK/Irish regimes.
* Manage discrete workstreams, coordinating CDH and regional inputs to deliver on time, on budget and to ERM quality, technical and Health \& Safety standards.
* Act as a trusted day\-to\-day point of contact for regional Task Leads on biodiversity workstreams, presenting findings clearly.
* Support bids, proposals and thought leadership, and drive continuous improvement of templates, methodologies and CDH–region ways of working.


**What will you bring?**
* Bachelor's degree in ecology, zoology, environmental science, conservation, biological sciences or a closely related discipline; a relevant MSc or Master's degree is desirable.
* 3\-5 years relevant working experience.
* 2\-3 years of consulting, research or NGO experience, with a demonstrable track record of delivering biodiversity baselines chapters on infrastructure, energy or development projects.
* Sound working knowledge of UK, Irish and international frameworks.
* Strong report\-writing skills for scoping reports, biodiversity chapters, technical appendices.
* Working knowledge of GIS platforms (ArcGIS Pro / QGIS) to interpret habitat mapping, constraints and designated sites, and to produce clear figures for reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong quality and attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently within scope, budget and time constraints across time zones.


**Preferred Skills \& Competencies**
* Prior experience delivering biodiversity chapters for NSIPs (DCO), TWAO, s.36 Electricity Act or comparable major infrastructure regimes.
* Experience working in a global delivery, shared service or hub environment across time zones, alongside regional consultants.
* Familiarity with automation, AI\-enabled tools or digital habitat survey to support baseline, assessment and reporting workflows.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Draft scoping reports and biodiversity chapters.
* Manage discrete workstreams end\-to\-end — including scoping, planning, delivery, technical/QA review and client communication — and coordinate CDH inputs with regional Ecology Leads, Sub\-Team Leads and Project Managers.
* Contribute to bids, proposals, thought leadership and internal capability building — including standardising templates, method statements, tracker tools and technical guidance.
* Maintain current knowledge of UK, Irish and international biodiversity policy, guidance and metrics.
* Adhere to ERM's Health \& Safety, ethics and quality management systems in all project work, including field surveys, sub\-contractor management and CDM compliance.

title: Program Associate - Generalist

**About the role** 




 The AEC industry is changing, but the way professionals prepare for that change hasn't always kept up.
 



 At Novatr, we're building learning experiences that help AEC professionals understand not just what the industry looks like today, but where it is headed.
 



  





 We're looking for a
 **Program Associate \- Generalist** 
 to be part of that journey.
 



 This is a role for someone who enjoys being at the centre of things: understanding a problem, talking to the right people, figuring out what needs to happen, building a solution and making it better along the way.
 



  





 You'll work closely with mentors, learners and internal teams across learning, content, research, operations and program execution.
 



  





 You don't need to come in knowing everything. You do need to be curious enough to learn, thoughtful enough to ask the right questions, and driven enough to take things forward.
 



  





**What you'll work on:** 




**Help build learning experiences** 



* Work with mentors and internal teams to create assignments, activities, resources, and other learning materials.
* Help turn complex ideas and real\-world industry knowledge into simple, useful learning experiences.
* Support curriculum structuring, presentations and documentation.
* Listen to learner feedback and identify ways to improve the experience.



  





**Understand what's changing in AEC** 



* Research how the industry is evolving and what skills professionals will need next.
* Explore new technologies, workflows, career paths and ways of working across the built environment.
* Bring relevant insights into our programs and learning experiences.
* Question existing approaches and suggest better ones.



  





**Work with people across the ecosystem** 



* Collaborate with industry mentors and professionals to bring real\-world perspectives into our programs.
* Interact with learners and understand their needs, questions and challenges.
* Coordinate with internal teams to make sure ideas move from discussion to execution.
* Build strong working relationships across different teams and stakeholders.



  





**Make things happen** 



* Support the end\-to\-end execution of learning programs.
* Track timelines, milestones and deliverables.
* Identify gaps before they become problems.
* Take ownership of tasks and drive them to completion.
* Help build and improve processes as we grow.



  





**What you must bring:** 




**A strong understanding of the built environment** 




**Yo** 
 u should come from one of these or a closely related background:
 


* Architecture
* Civil Engineering
* Structural Engineering
* MEP
* Construction
* Design \& Technology
* Other Built Environment discipline



  





 You don't need to be an expert in every area.
 



 What matters is that you understand the world of AEC and are curious about how it is changing.
 



  





**How you think and work:** 




**We're looking for someone who:** 



* Is curious and asks thoughtful questions.
* Can take ownership without needing constant direction.
* Enjoys solving problems and figuring things out.
* Communicates clearly and works well with different people.
* Can research, organise, and make sense of information.
* Is comfortable juggling multiple priorities.
* Pays attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
* Enjoys building things from scratch and improving what already exists.
* Wants to understand the industry beyond their own role or discipline.



  





**Good to have:** 




**These aren't requirements, but they would be a great addition:** 



* Experience in program, project, or operations coordination.
* Experience creating content, presentations, or documentation.
* Exposure to learning, training, or mentoring.
* Experience working with AEC professionals or multidisciplinary teams.
* Familiarity with AEC technology or digital workflows.
* Exposure to AI or productivity tools.
* Experience with research or industry analysis.
* Experience building processes or systems.
* Strong visual communication or presentation skills.



  





**Who could be a great fit?:** 




 Maybe you're an architect who enjoys organising people and ideas as much as designing.
 



  





 Maybe you're a civil engineer who has always been curious about the bigger picture beyond the project you're working on.
 



  





 Maybe you've realised that your favourite part of your work isn't necessarily the technical execution, but figuring out how things work, improving them, and helping other people do better.
 



  





 Or maybe you're early in your career and looking for a way to use your AEC background without being limited to one conventional career path.
 



  





 We're open to different levels of experience.

title: Program Associate - BIM
description:
📍 Atrium Place, Udyog Vihar
 



  





**About the role** 




 AEC is changing quickly. The way projects are designed, coordinated and delivered today is very different from what many of us were exposed to during our education.
 



  





 At Novatr, we're working to bridge that gap by helping AEC professionals understand and work with the future of the industry.
 



  





 As a Program Associate \- BIM, you'll be part of the team building that experience.
 



 This isn't a role where you'll simply work on BIM projects. You'll work closely with industry mentors, learners and internal teams to help create learning experiences that are practical, relevant and connected to how the industry is actually evolving.
 



  





 You'll bring your understanding of AEC and BIM into learning, research, program execution and problem\-solving, while getting a much broader view of the industry and the people shaping its future.
 



  





**What you'll work on:** 




**Build better learning experiences** 



* Work with mentors and internal teams to create assignments, activities, resources and other learning materials.
* Help translate technical and industry concepts into learning experiences that are clear and useful for professionals.
* Contribute to curriculum structuring, presentations and documentation.
* Review and improve learning experiences based on learner feedback and industry needs.



  





**Stay close to where AEC is heading** 



* Research how AEC teams are working today and how those workflows are evolving.
* Explore emerging technologies, tools and approaches that could influence the industry.
* Bring relevant industry observations and ideas into our programs.
* Help us experiment with better ways of teaching and delivering programs.



  





**Work closely with people** 



* Collaborate with industry mentors and professionals to bring real\-world context into our programs.
* Interact with learners and understand the challenges they face.
* Coordinate with internal teams to keep programs moving smoothly.
* Help resolve learner and program\-related challenges with ownership.



  





**Own program execution** 



* Support the end\-to\-end execution of learning programs.
* Track milestones, deliverables and timelines.
* Coordinate across mentors, learners and internal teams.
* Identify gaps, solve problems and improve processes along the way.



  





**What you must bring:** 




**A strong foundation in BIM** 




 You should have genuine, hands\-on familiarity with:
 


* BIM workflows
* Revit
* Navisworks



 You don't need to know everything about BIM. We care more about whether you understand how these tools and workflows are actually used and can apply that understanding thoughtfully.
 



  





**How you think and work:** 




**We're looking for someone who** 



* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Is curious about how the AEC industry is changing.
* Can break down a problem and figure out a way forward.
* Communicates clearly with different kinds of people.
* Is comfortable researching, learning, and working with incomplete information.
* Can manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.
* Enjoys building things, improving processes, and making things work better.



  





**Good to have:** 




**These aren't requirements, but they would be a great addition:** 



* Experience with Civil 3D
* Experience with ETABS
* Experience with STAAD.Pro
* Exposure to BIM coordination
* Understanding of construction documentation
* Experience working on real\-world AEC projects
* Experience creating presentations, documentation, or learning content
* Exposure to AI or productivity tools
* Experience coordinating projects, teams or stakeholders



  





**Who could be a great fit?** 




 You could be an architect, civil engineer, structural engineer, or someone from a related built\-environment background.
 



  





 You may have spent your career working on projects and are now curious about what lies beyond the traditional project role.
 



  





 Or you may be earlier in your career and already have a strong foundation in BIM, along with the curiosity to understand the industry beyond the software you use.
 



  





 We're not looking for someone who checks every box.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who can bring their AEC perspective, learn quickly, take ownership, and help us build something that didn't exist in the same way when we were students.
 



  





**What you'll gain:** 



* Exposure to real\-world AEC workflows and the people shaping them.
* Hands\-on experience in program and project execution.
* The opportunity to work closely with experienced AEC mentors and professionals.
* Exposure across learning, content, operations, product, and industry partnerships.
* Experience building systems and processes in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* A chance to contribute to how the next generation of AEC professionals prepares for the industry.
